title: Abteilungsleiter in der Einrichtungsberatung (m/w/d) Rastatt
descriptionHtml:
In deiner Rolle als Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) für unsere Fachabteilung (Shop-in-Shop) wirst du Teil eines erfolgsorientierten Teams in einem international agierendem Familienbetrieb. Gemeinsam mit uns gestaltest du die Zukunft der Einrichtungsberatung, indem du Kunden dabei unterstützt, die besten Teppichlösungen zu finden und ihre Wohnräume stilvoll zu gestalten. Deine Arbeit trägt maßgeblich zur Mission bei, hochwertige Einrichtungserlebnisse zu bieten, die Kunden begeistern und nachhaltig beeindrucken.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst professionelle Beratungsgespräche zu Teppich-Kollektionen für unsere Fachabteilung (Shop-in-Shop)
  • Du planst und bestellst verschiedene Einrichtungsalternativen nach den Wünschen der Kunden
  • Du pflegst die Ausstellung deiner eigenen Abteilung und überwachst den Lagerbestand
  • Du überwachst und kontrollierst die Preisauszeichnung
  • Du platzierst und beschilderst Werbeware zu Aktionszeiträumen
  • Du nimmst bei Bedarf auch Termine bei Kunden vor Ort wahr

Qualifikation

  • Du begeisterst dich für Wohnungseinrichtung und hast Freude am Beratungsgespräch mit Kunden
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Verkaufserfahrung, idealerweise mit Know-how für Einrichtungen, Möbel, Teppiche oder Textilien
  • Du setzt dich engagiert ein, bist kontaktfreudig und handelst kundenorientiert
  • Du hast ein sicheres, freundliches und positives Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen
  • Du zeichnest dich durch Verkaufsgeschick und Organisationstalent aus

Benefits

  • Einen abwechslungsreichen, interessanten und verantwortungsvollen Arbeitsplatz bei einem seit 30 Jahren beständigen und international erfolgreichen Familienbetrieb
  • Ausgezeichnete persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und langfristig berufliche Zukunftsperspektiven
  • Ein attraktives Gehalt, das deinem Talent und deiner Leistung entspricht und je nach Qualifikation sowie Berufserfahrung im Bereich von 35.000 bis 55.000 Euro (brutto) pro Jahr liegt
  • Attraktive Rabatte zu Mitarbeiterkonditionen bei über 800 Partnerfirmen in den Bereichen Auto, Finanzen, Reisen, Freizeit, Mode, Sport, Tickets, Wohnen, Food, Technik, Mobilfunk und Regionales
  • Vergünstigungen im Bistro, mit frisch gebackenen Brötchen, einem genüsslichen Mittagessen oder Spezialitäten der hauseigenen Konditorin, außerdem kostenfreies Wasser, Kaffee und Tee
  • Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung und ausgezeichnete Lage

Deine Bewerbung und Fragen kannst du ganz einfach online, mit nur wenigen Klicks, einreichen. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von 7 Tagen nach Bewerbungseingang bei dir zurück.

title: Account Executive, Corporate
descriptionHtml:
As a Corporate Account Executive at Airtable you will have the opportunity to work closely with a variety of clients and accounts. Each client has unique needs and you act as a trusted business advisor, helping them effectively leverage our product to drive maximum impact for their business. 

Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. This opens up all sorts of exciting possibilities for our Sales team in terms of who our potential customer is. As a result, the demand for our product has outpaced the capacity of our sales team.

Please note, this is a hybrid role based in London, England, UK.

What you'll do

  • Pioneer the Future: Be the trailblazer—Make impact on the ground shaping our Corporate sales strategy and operations in various new regions.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Enjoy full ownership of building and scaling the commercial and mid-market customer base, with the freedom to shape your approach and make a real impact.
  • Strategic Sales Cycle: Manage the end-to-end sales process—from discovery to close, including demos, negotiations, and building lasting relationships.
  • Shape Customer Success: Build trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and drive business transformation through our solutions.
  • Become an Airtable product expert, delighting prospects with a phenomenal educational experience, and helping cross-functional teams with product feedback and user insights

Who you are

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • 3+ years in a SaaS sales role with a track record of success, minimum 2+ years closing experience
  • Experience as a customer account manager as well as a new logo hunter
  • Strong business acumen that includes prior experience managing multiple concurrent client relationships, anticipating change, adjusting priorities accordingly, and working effectively as a team
  • Self-starter comfortable with some ambiguity, demonstrating a willingness to learn/ramp quickly and be a creative problem solver for the larger Airtable team
  • You embody a growth mindset and seek out opportunities to constantly learn and grow. Extreme curiosity to learn about the product, the industry, and your customer’s businesses.
  • Strong operational mindset, eager to build processes for yourself and the team to maximize productivity
  • Bonus Points if French Speaking; There is an opportunity to cover the French region, including companies up to 3000 FTE. As the first person on this team, you have an unlimited opportunity to build this region.

What We Offer 

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, that’s why we’ve built a benefits package designed to help you thrive both inside and outside of work.

  • Strong £OTE, ramp up and recoverable draw
  • Travel: £7,500 annual allowance to cover your commute.
  • Healthcare: Top-tier private medical, dental, and vision coverage through AXA, with heavily subsidised plans available for dependants.
  • Family planning: Up to £7,200 per year through Carrot to support your path to parenthood, plus a minimum of 16 weeks fully paid maternity or paternity leave.
  • Childcare: Save up to 42% per child annually through our Workplace Nursery salary sacrifice scheme.
  • Pension & protection: 9% company pension contribution.
  • Health & wellness: £150 every month to spend on whatever helps you feel your best, from fitness and mindfulness to hobbies and self-care.
  • Free lunch: Enjoy a varied, catered lunch every day you’re in the office.
  • Home office: £750 one-off allowance to create a workspace that works for you.
  • Time off: 25 days annual leave, plus 4 company-wide Recharge Days and additional time off between Christmas and New Year as part of our Winter Break.
  • Give back: 5 paid Volunteer Days each year to support causes you care about, individually or with your team.

At Airtable, we embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We strive for Airtable to be a pleasant and supportive place to work, and to attract and retain a diverse team of talented people.  We take great pride in holding everyone accountable for treating each other with dignity and respect. 

Airtable is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability which inhibits your ability to complete any part of the application process, please complete our Accommodations Request Form and let us know how we may assist you.

title: Account Executive DACH - Mid-Market (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Agicap

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.

Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.

We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.

These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

Home page

Customer Stories

Our Values


About the Account Executive - Mid-Market role:

We are growing our Team in Düsseldorf! In daily collaboration with the Business Development team, Outbound SDR, Inbound SDR, and Partnership Managers, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new logos. As a Mid Market Account Executive at Agicap, you will be responsible for driving sales and expanding our customer base within the mid-market segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients, and closing deals to achieve your sales targets.
You will be responsible for:
  • Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
  • Identifying and targeting mid-market companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
  • Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
  • Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
  • Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
  • Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
  • Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
  • Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

    • What we are looking for:
  • Native/Bilingual level of German
  • 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
  • Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
  • A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
  • Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
  • A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
  • A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

    • 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
  • Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
  • Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
  • Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
  • Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
  • Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
  • Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
  • Strong financial situation
  • Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
  • A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
  • Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

    • Our benefits:
    - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components. - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy. - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France. - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app. - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service. - Team Culture: Be part of a dynamic environment with global offsites (like our recent annual seminar in Chamonix-Mont-Blanc) and local team events. AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: Account Executive, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join as a founding member of the EMEA sales team for our Advertising Solutions business. You’ll thrive in a zero-to-one environment, helping build and scale a new, fast-growing business at Discord. You’ll bring strong experience across gaming, advertising/media/marketing, a consultative approach, and the ability to build a meaningful recurring book of business. This role is London-based and focused on building partnerships with top-tier Mobile and XP Gaming companies across EMEA (publishers, studios, and their media agencies).

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a named/account list and new business pipeline across EMEA, with emphasis on top-tier Mobile and XP Gaming companies and their agencies. 
  • Identify clients’ marketing needs and develop solutions/proposals that deliver measurable value. Prospect and source new marketing opportunities with game publishers, studios, and media agencies. 
  • Build and deepen senior relationships with key decision-makers (Marketing, UA/Growth,Brand, Media, Partnerships).
  • Lead complex sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, solutioning, forecasting, negotiation, and close.
  • Help clients achieve business and marketing goals through Discord’s solutions; act as a strategic partner on marketing and media plans.
  • Deploy and execute effective, repeatable sales motions; apply an account planning process to prioritize accounts, grow revenue, and navigate multi-threaded stakeholder groups.
  • Create and deliver compelling presentations and proposals using internal and external insights and data.
  • Develop product fluency: become an expert in Discord solutions and tailor recommendations to varying client needs.
  • Represent Discord credibly across the gaming, media, marketing, and advertising ecosystem - internally and in relevant industry forums.

What you should have

  • 7+ years of direct experience in digital advertising / media sales / brand marketing / media buying within the gaming ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering against revenue, pipeline, and account growth targets, including closing new business.
  • Strong experience managing gaming clients throughout the funnel, with deep understanding of their challenges and objectives.
  • Proven ability to build relationships with senior marketing decision-makers at game publishers/studios and their agencies - especially within Mobile and XP Gaming.
  • Commercial strength: experience negotiating and structuring standard and nonstandard-buying agreements.
  • Analytical mindset: ability to interpret performance data, surface insights, and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Comfort operating cross-functionally (Sales, Client Success, Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance) to unblock clients and deliver outcomes.
  • Familiarity with the marketing and ad tech ecosystem; ability to capture product needs and contribute to scalable go-to-market feedback loops. Excellent communication and executive presence - able to influence, challenge, and build trust. 
  • Willingness to travel across EMEA for in-person client meetings & events. 

Nice to have

Existing relationships with major EMEA gaming publishers/studios, leading Mobile Gaming companies, and/or key holding-company and independent media agencies. Experience selling emerging or innovative ad products in a high-growth environment. Passion for gaming and strong knowledge of the EMEA gaming landscape.

This is an international position in London, England, United Kingdom employed by an international PEO.

This position is commission-based and is eligible for variable incentive. The On Target Earnings (OTE) range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will be eligible for benefits. Salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. 

On Target Earnings£164,000—£184,500 GBP

Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multi-platform, multi-generational and multi-player platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

title: Account Executive (x/f/m) im Außendienst / Bergisches Land
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt. Als Account Executive (x/f/m) im Vertriebsgebiet Dreieck Solingen, Bergisch Gladbach und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag.

Du gewinnst neue Zahnarztpraxen für Doctolib und begleitest sie auf dem Weg zu einer effizienteren, digitaleren Organisation. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du kombinierst die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kund:innen über bereitgestellte Leads, telefonisch und vor Ort, mit der Bearbeitung eingehender Inbound-Anfragen. Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Ersttermine zu vereinbaren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln.

  • Erste Verkaufsgespräche und Bedarfsermittlung: Du führst erste Gespräche mit Zahnärzt:innen und Praxisteams, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und identifizierst ihren individuellen Bedarf.

  • Full-Cycle-Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsermittlung, Produktpräsentation und Verhandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Pipeline, Umsatz und Wachstum: Du baust Deine Pipeline eigenständig auf und verantwortest die Entwicklung Deines Vertriebsgebiets.

  • Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du zeigst potenziellen Kund:innen den konkreten Mehrwert unserer digitalen HealthTech-Lösung für ihren Praxisalltag.

  • Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie.

  • Strukturierte Übergabe nach Vertragsabschluss: Nach dem Abschluss übergibst Du Deine neuen Kund:innen strukturiert an unser Projektmanagement-Team. Dort werden sie anschließend vollständig betreut und bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitet.

Die Position ist vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen ausgerichtet. Eine laufende Bestandskundenbetreuung gehört nicht zu Deinen Aufgaben.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.

  • Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Außendienst und im Neukundengeschäft

  • Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du hast bereits eigenständig Pipeline aufgebaut und neue Kund:innen gewonnen

  • Beratungsstärke: Du kannst erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verständlich und kundenzentriert vermitteln

  • Energie und Überzeugungskraft: Du trittst sicher und professionell auf, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und lässt Dich auch von Rückschlägen nicht entmutigen

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher ausdrücken

  • Internationale Kompetenz: Für interne Trainings, All-Hands und die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kolleg:innen sind Englischkenntnisse hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Regionale Verfügbarkeit: Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst das Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch). Du bist bereit, regelmäßig Kundentermine in dieser Region wahrzunehmen. Ein Wohnort in der Region oder in erreichbarer Nähe ist hilfreich, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung

  • Flexibilität und Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt, direkt bei Zahnärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt

Erfahrung im SaaS-, HealthTech- oder Healthcare-Vertrieb ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Entscheidend sind Deine Erfahrung im B2B-Neukundenvertrieb, Deine Eigenständigkeit und Dein Wille, Dinge voranzutreiben.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Einen Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung, versteuert nach der 1 %-Regelung

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen, unter anderem Zahnreinigung

  • 28 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes volle Beschäftigungsjahr, maximal 30 Tage

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 %

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm mit einem zusätzlichen Monat Elternzeit

  • Kostenlose Mental-Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner Moka.care

  • Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen, unter anderem durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung und psychologische Unterstützung

Der Interview-Prozess

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team, remote, 35 Minuten

  2. Interview mit deinem Regional Manager, remote, 60 Minuten

  3. DoctoDay: Verbringe einige Stunden mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

  4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

Job Details

  • Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit

  • Region: Vertriebsgebiet Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach, rechtsrheinisch, mit Office in Düsseldorf

  • Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei Doctolib nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos oder Dein Alter verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen.

Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Mid-market)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. title: Account Manager EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Horizon Trading Solutions is an independent global technology company focused on electronic trading, supporting agency and principal business activities across equities and derivatives.

For over 20 years, we have equipped leading capital market participants with algorithmic trading technology and direct connectivity to more than 80 exchanges worldwide.

We are currently looking for an Account Manager EMEA to strengthen to drive sustainable revenue growth and increase the value of Horizon’s existing client accounts by developing structured account plans, identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, securing renewals and strengthening relationships with key decision-makers. The Account Manager acts as the commercial owner of each account and coordinates internal teams to turn client knowledge into profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Grow the Existing Client Portfolio

  • Develop and manage an account plan for each priority account, covering growth potential, stakeholder mapping, key challenges, competition, opportunities and actions.
  • Identify, qualify and convert upsell, cross-sell, geographic expansion and functional expansion opportunities.
  • Build a reliable, documented expansion pipeline and keep it regularly updated in the CRM.
  • Prepare business cases and commercial proposals, and lead negotiations and contracting through to closing.

2. Secure Retention and Renewals

  • Anticipate renewals and churn risks, with a retention plan shared with the relevant teams.
  • Monitor product usage, client satisfaction, value delivered and commercial pain points across the portfolio.
  • Lead account reviews and executive business reviews, providing actionable recommendations.

3. Build Executive Relationships

  • Build lasting relationships with sponsors and decision-makers across business, IT, trading, operations and procurement.
  • Understand each client’s strategy, organisation and priorities in order to develop new use cases.
  • Represent the voice of the client internally while protecting Horizon’s commercial interests.

4. Coordinate Internal Execution

  • Coordinate Client Services, Customer Delivery, Product, PreSales, Legal and Finance around the account objectives.
  • Ensure clear handovers and follow through on commitments made to clients.
  • Share market signals, client needs and competitive insights that can inform the product roadmap.

5. Manage Performance

  • Track growth, retention, pipeline, forecast, stakeholder coverage and margin indicators.
  • Produce evidence-based forecasts, explain variances and recommend corrective actions.
  • Contribute to commercial discipline, sales methodologies and the team’s continuous improvement.

Expected Outcomes Within 12 Months

  • 100% of priority accounts have an approved account plan that is updated quarterly.
  • Achievement of the annual recurring revenue and/or revenue expansion target across the assigned portfolio (quantified target to be defined).
  • A qualified expansion pipeline maintained at a level consistent with the annual objective (recommended benchmark: at least 3x the target).
  • Renewal rate and net revenue retention in line with agreed objectives, with no strategic renewal identified too late.
  • Multi-threaded mapping of decision-makers and influencers across all strategic accounts.
  • Reliable monthly forecast, up-to-date CRM data, and clearly documented risks and opportunities.

What we are looking for

  • At least five years of experience in account management, sales or complex B2B business development.
  • Experience in finance or capital markets is mandatory: investment banking, brokerage, asset management, fintech, financial software or a comparable environment.
  • Demonstrable results in growing existing accounts, complex negotiations and managing long sales cycles.
  • Ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, including at executive level.
  • Understanding of SaaS/licensing models, recurring revenue, renewals and account profitability.
  • Exposure to trading technology, software platforms, APIs/connectivity or IT projects would be a strong advantage.
  • Professional fluency in French and English is essential; another European language would be an advantage.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Growth mindset and results orientation
  • Knowledge of financial markets and understanding of client challenges
  • Account planning and prioritisation skills
  • Influencing, active listening and relationship-building skills
  • Commercial negotiation and value-based selling
  • Cross-functional collaboration and strong execution
  • CRM discipline, forecasting and data-driven management
  • Technological curiosity, autonomy and an entrepreneurial mindset

title: Account Manager WhatsApp & CRM Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über chatmarks

Bei uns arbeitest du dort, wo der Markt erst noch hinkommt.

Als einer der ersten Anbieter für WhatsApp Marketing im DACH-Raum haben wir den Kanal für Marken wie Jack Wolfskin und Marc O’Polo mitgeprägt. Heute sind wir absolute Experten auf diesem Gebiet.

Mit unserem CORE Framework gehen wir den nächsten Schritt und verändern, wie Marken Subscriber für ihr CRM gewinnen. Für dich heißt das: Du lernst Ansätze, die die meisten Agenturen noch gar nicht kennen. Und du arbeitest trotzdem in einem klaren, fokussierten Feld statt in wechselnden Experimenten.

Wir sind kein Fließband. Wir betreuen bewusst wenige Kunden, dafür eng und mit vollem Fokus auf Ergebnisse: mehr Subscriber, bessere Flows, mehr Wiederkäufe.

Wir wachsen gerade stark. Mit unserer neuen Leistung CORE (Compound Owned Revenue Engine) holen wir für Shops mehr Umsatz aus Traffic, für den sie schon bezahlt haben. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der unsere Kunden führt und mit uns wächst.

Deine Aufgaben

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Kundenportfolio, vom Kick-off bis zur langfristigen Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du führst Kick-offs, Workshops und Review-Calls mit unseren Kunden.

  • Du baust WhatsApp- und CRM-Kanäle auf und entwickelst sie weiter: Subscriber-Gewinnung, Pop-ups, Willkommensstrecken, Automationen und Newsletter.

  • Du planst und führst A/B-Tests durch, wertest Ergebnisse aus und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab.

  • Du koordinierst die Umsetzung und hältst nächste Schritte konsequent nach.

  • Du erkennst Wachstumspotenziale beim Kunden und machst daraus Zusatzleistungen.

  • Du machst aus zufriedenen Kunden Case Studies und Empfehlungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Idealerweise 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im CRM-, E-Mail- oder WhatsApp-Marketing, im E-Commerce, in einer Agentur oder im Account Management.

  • Du verstehst, wie Online-Shops Umsatz machen: Conversion, Retention, Customer Lifetime Value.

  • Du sprichst sicher mit Marketing-Leads und Geschäftsführern.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen und Tests statt in Bauchgefühl.

  • Erfahrung mit Klaviyo, chatarmin, charles, Brevo oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus.

  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch; gutes Englisch ist ein Plus.

Außerdem passt du zu uns, wenn:

  • du Verantwortung willst und dich nicht hinter Aufgabenlisten versteckst.

  • du strukturiert arbeitest und deine Zusagen einhältst, auch remote.

  • du Feedback annimmst und umsetzt.

  • du Lust hast, in einem kleinen Team schnell richtig gut zu werden.

Das bieten wir dir

Pionier-DNA statt Standard. Wir machen nur Dinge, die nicht jeder kann. Unser Ziel ist, das CRM unserer Kunden drei Level nach vorne zu bringen. Dafür denken wir unkonventionell und nutzen Hebel, die die meisten Agenturen gar nicht auf dem Schirm haben.

Große Marken ab Tag 1. Jack Wolfskin, Marc O’Polo, BILLA, Tchibo, PURELEI, BLACKROLL. Du arbeitest nicht an Testprojekten, sondern direkt mit dieser Gewichtsklasse.

Du baust mit. Wir sind ein kleines Team, und du bist Teil des Kerns. Du bist eng in die Entwicklung von chatmarks eingebunden: neue Leistungen, Prozesse, Strategie. Dadurch lernst du extrem schnell und entwickelst ein echtes unternehmerisches Mindset.

Volle Eigenverantwortung. Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du deine Kundenprojekte komplett eigenständig. Es gibt keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen und keine Meeting-Marathons. Du entscheidest, wie du dein Ziel erreichst.

Menschen vor Prozessen. Wertschätzung und Freiheit sind uns extrem wichtig. Wir arbeiten als Gründer intensiv an uns selbst, sprechen offen über Fehler und Überlastung und führen mit Empathie statt mit Druck. Bei uns musst du nicht funktionieren. Du darfst Mensch sein, und genau das ermöglicht echte Höchstleistung.

Vergütung

Das monatliche Gehalt liegt bei EUR 3,800–4,500.

Auch als Junior

Du hast weniger Erfahrung, bist aber hungrig? Bewirb dich trotzdem, wenn du schon im E-Commerce gearbeitet hast (z. B. mit eigenem Shop, im Marketing eines Shops oder in einer Agentur), eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hast und in kurzer Zeit viel lernen willst. Wir arbeiten dich ein.

SO LÄUFT’S AB

  • Du bewirbst dich mit wenigen Klicks über Join

  • Wenn dein Profil passt, melden wir uns innerhalb von 3 Werktagen für ein erstes Kennenlernen (30 Minuten, per Video).

  • Danach folgt ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit einer Praxisaufgabe.

title: Advisory Data Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Advisory Data Architect to own data design across our advisory engagements. This is a platform and design-authority role with a hands-on edge, combining finance-focused business understanding with modern data architecture, platforms and governance. You will define how data - across a client’s business - is structured, governed, and served so that AI, analytics, and management reporting are reliable and scalable. As a Senior Manager, you will lead architecture decisions, guide engineers, shape client data strategy, architecture, governance, and be accountable for the coherence and quality of the data estate you design.

This is a client-facing role within our AI Advisory team, setting the data architecture that our engagements — and our clients' AI ambitions — are built on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define target-state data architectures for clients — models, storage, pipelines, and access patterns — balancing rigour with delivery realism.

  • Establish data modelling standards and curated domain layers across the a variety of systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, Manufacturing) and data sources, with end-to-end lineage and provenance sufficient for audit and controls.

  • Map and integrate finance source systems (ERP, EPM, sub-ledgers, and consolidation tools) into governed, analytics-ready models.

  • Design the finance data foundations for applied AI/ML: governed retrieval sources for RAG, feature stores, and the architecture that keeps AI systems fed with trustworthy, reconciled finance data.

  • Set patterns for secure, compliant finance data platforms — access control, data sensitivity, segregation of duties, isolation, and alignment to standards such as ISO 27001.

  • Provide architectural direction for cloud data platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability, ensuring designs are cost-aware and operable.

  • Define the data lineage and controls that support responsible production AI — monitoring, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Translate ambiguous business and client problems into clear architectural decisions and scoped roadmaps under delivery pressure.

  • Own key technical trade-offs and communicate them clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and senior client sponsors.

  • Mentor data engineers, raise the technical bar across the team, and contribute reusable patterns, reference architectures, and accelerators.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Significant experience designing and delivering data architectures for production systems, with evidence that your designs have shipped and run - not remained on paper.

  • Deep expertise in data modelling, warehouse/lakehouse design, and data governance.

  • Hands-on background in SQL and Python, and fluency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks).

  • System-level judgement on how data architecture shapes AI outcomes: designing governed sources for RAG, structuring data for retrieval and orchestration, and deciding where structured outputs and tool use fit.

  • Ability to set standards and lead engineers while remaining close to implementation.

  • Strong stakeholder skills, including engaging senior client sponsors and explaining architectural trade-offs clearly.

Strong Preference

  • Experience architecting the data layer behind AI or analytics products in production.

  • Informed views on the trade-offs between fine-tuning, RAG, and long-context approaches, and how each changes data architecture requirements, including context window economics and prompt caching.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability for data platforms.

  • Awareness of MCP and tool-orchestration concepts and their implications for composable, data-driven AI systems.

  • Fluent use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), with a clear view of where they help and where human design judgement must lead.

  • Security and compliance experience (e.g. ISO 27001 alignment, access control design).

  • Consulting or advisory background, owning problems end-to-end rather than a single workstream.

Nice to Have

  • Evidence of self-directed building — side projects, internal tools, or startups.

  • Exposure to finance data, PE/M&A, or portfolio-company environments.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS/Azure architect-level credentials).

Additional Information

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

title: Aerodynamics Methodology and Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Role

As an Aerodynamics Methodology & Software Engineer at Harmattan, you will bridge the gap between aerospace physics and high-performance software engineering. Your mission is to professionalize our internal computational ecosystem, manage our HPC/Cloud infrastructure, and transform research-grade scripts into production-ready engineering software. You will act as the lead architect for our agentic AI workflows, developing custom MCP servers and LLM-ready repositories to automate complex simulation loops and design optimisations. You are the engineer of the automated toolchains that allow our team to iterate on UAV designs with unprecedented speed and fidelity.

Responsibilities

  • Software Professionalization: Refactor research scripts and "specialist tools" into modular, high-performance, and maintainable Python/C++ libraries. Implement robust unit-testing and documentation standards. Make sure the team members follow the structure when developing code.

  • AI-Augmented Engineering & Orchestration: Architect agentic workflows and custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to bridge LLMs with internal CFD solvers and databases; codify engineering tribal knowledge into SKILLS.md or CLAUDE.md files to enable AI-driven code refactoring, automated simulation setup, and intelligent data analysis.

  • MDAO Toolchain Integration: Architect a unified design environment by developing APIs and automated workflows that link disparate tools (e.g., OpenVSP, XFoil, and OpenFOAM) into seamless optimization loops.

  • Infrastructure & Scalability: Manage and optimize our calculation infrastructure, including Linux-based HPC clusters (Slurm) and/or Cloud computing (AWS/Azure).

  • Aero Database (ADB) Management: Design the data architecture for storing and retrieving high-dimensional aerodynamic results, ensuring the GNC and flight physics teams have "single-source-of-truth" access to vehicle performance data.

Requirements

  • Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or Informatics with a proven track record in the aerospace sector.

  • Aerospace Background: Familiarity with the aerospace physics, data structures and I/O of industry tools such as OpenFOAM, ANSYS, XFOIL, OpenVSP, or QProp.

  • Advanced Programming: Expert proficiency in Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) and ideally C++.

  • Modern AI & Agentic Systems: Proven ability to develop LLM-integrated tools and MCP servers that automate engineering tasks; experience maintaining "AI-ready" repositories using structured instruction files and building neural surrogate models to accelerate physical simulations.

  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Knowledge of Git/GitLab (CI/CD, Runners) and Linux/Unix environments. Experience with Bash scripting and Cloud-scale computing (AWS).

Nice-to-Have

  • Numerical Methods: Hands-on experience using CFD or other physical solvers.Able to select appropriate physics models (for example turbulence models), configuring numerical schemes, and fine-tuning solvers.

  • Machine Learning in Data Science: Knowledge in setting up surrogate models and tools for engineering practices (surrogate models)

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Afstudeerstage technische bedrijfskunde: energietransitie en energie-armoede
descriptionHtml:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact.

Dit wordt jouw stage

Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede

Wat ga je doen?
Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn.

Je houdt je bezig met:

  • Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent;

  • Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden;

  • Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data);

  • Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen;

  • Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen?

Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie.

Dit is jouw team

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam


Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

Dit breng je mee

  • Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie;

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

  • Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

title: AI Transformation Director
descriptionHtml:
About Riplo

Riplo is a VC-backed, AI-native advisory and technology firm serving private equity across the deal lifecycle. We combine deep diligence expertise, forward-deployed AI teams and our own AI platform to give PE funds and their portfolio companies sharper answers and working AI, faster. We are growing quickly, winning work with leading funds and expanding the team, and this hire is a key part of that next phase.

  • Advisory: thematic research, commercial due diligence (CDD), AI due diligence, AI value creation, AI build solutions and exit readiness.

  • Solutions: forward-deployed AI teams that turn AI value creation plans into working software and measured value inside portfolio companies.

  • Software: building the operating layer for consulting.

  • Clients: mid-market and large-cap PE funds and their portfolio companies across the UK, Europe and the US.

  • Operating model: flat and AI-leveraged. Senior people work directly on the programme, supported by AI rather than layers of juniors.

  • Team: a blend of DD consultants, PE portfolio operators, AI advisors and AI engineers, with advisory and engineering working side by side.

Our team and culture

AI is rewriting the rules of consulting and of how portfolio companies operate. Most advisory firms are waiting to see what happens. We decided to be the ones making it happen.

We are a small, senior team that moves fast, sets a high bar and genuinely enjoys building Riplo together. Every person here shapes what Riplo becomes.

We build side by side in the office 4–5 days a week, because the best ideas come from being in the room together. If you want to sit at the table with us, roll up your sleeves and build something that matters, we want to meet you.

AI Transformation Director, Solutions · London (in office 4–5 days a week) · Full-time

This is not a typical transformation role. You will be a key hire working side by side with our Founding Head of Solutions, leading embedded AI transformation programmes inside PE-backed portfolio companies, standing up and running their AI Transformation Office, and helping build Riplo's Solutions practice from the ground up.

You will own the programme from week 1: governance, roadmap, use-case selection and the path from first build to measured value. Most programmes start with a list of 100+ ideas; your job is to turn that into 5 to 6 quantified use cases with named owners, get the first live within 6 weeks, evidence value against a baseline, and hand over a running office to a permanent owner.

You will have the autonomy of a founder, the exposure of a partner, and the tools of an AI-native firm. Your work will show up directly in portfolio company P&Ls, in fund value creation plans, in our product and in how Riplo grows.

What you'll do

Lead AI transformation programmes

  • Stand up the client's AI Transformation Office: decision rights, delivery process, monthly AI SteerCo and executive sponsorship.

  • Build and own the AI roadmap for the next 6+ months, sequenced with the client's data and platform foundations.

  • Run the use-case staircase end to end: select by week 3 on value, readiness and sponsorship; specify the redesigned workflow by week 4; get working tools in front of real users by week 6; measure results against baseline.

  • Sequence builds so each one reuses the capability the last one created, making every later use case faster and cheaper.

  • Gate every build on a named business owner, a baseline, a funded run cost and a route into daily use, with monthly cost and value reporting to the SteerCo.

Drive adoption and capability

  • Own adoption, not just delivery: enablement strategy, training, stakeholder engagement and usage dashboards that move AI from experimentation to daily workflow.

  • Compress how client teams build software, embedding agentic practices from spec to release and coaching engineers through the change.

  • Build the client's own capability, with a plan to move at least half of AI engineering capacity in-house within 6 months.

  • Write the operating model, governance and roadmap for the permanent owner, overlap their first month and hand over a running office.

Lead forward-deployed teams

  • Lead embedded teams of AI architects, forward-deployed engineers and PE operators, keeping strategy and production code in one team.

  • Translate business problems into tractable AI solutions, bridging executives, domain experts and engineers.

  • Present progress and evidenced value to portfolio company leadership, operating partners and deal teams.

Build the practice

  • Scope and write proposals and RFP responses, and support pitches to new and existing funds.

  • Turn each programme into reusable playbooks, assets and platform features that make the next transformation faster than the last.

  • Produce thought leadership on AI value creation (sector notes, case studies, LinkedIn content).

  • Build relationships with operating partners, portfolio company executives and technology partners.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years across strategy consulting, PE value creation and enterprise AI or software delivery, including time at a top-tier consultancy, an enterprise AI vendor or in a PE-backed operating role.

  • A track record of leading AI or digital transformation at enterprise or portfolio company scale, from strategy through to adopted, production systems.

  • Measurable outcomes you can point to: adoption moved from near zero to the majority of a workforce, products shipped, or value evidenced against a baseline.

  • C-suite and investor credibility: you have aligned CEOs, CFOs, operating partners and technology leaders around priorities, funding and trade-offs.

  • Hands-on technical depth: you understand LLMs, agentic tooling, data platforms and the software development lifecycle well enough to lead architects and engineers, and you have built with them yourself.

  • Commercial judgment: you tie every AI initiative to productivity, revenue or enterprise value, and you have owned presales, proposals or a P&L.

  • Proven leadership of cross-functional teams of data scientists, engineers and solution architects under tight timelines.

  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools daily and can show how they make your work faster and better.

Who you are

  • Founder mindset: this is your business to own and grow. You treat Riplo's success as your own.

  • Outcome-obsessed: you measure success in adoption and evidenced value, not decks delivered or tools launched.

  • Proactive: you see what needs doing and do it before being asked.

  • Builder: you would rather ship a working tool in week 6 than perfect a strategy in week 12.

  • Ownership mindset: you take initiatives from idea to delivery and own outcomes, not just tasks.

  • AI-first: you look for the AI-enabled way to do every step, and keep refining it.

  • Calm under pressure: you lead with clarity when timelines are tight, stakeholders disagree and the path is ambiguous.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you thrive in a small, fast-moving team without rigid structure.

Why Riplo

  • Build something from the ground up: join early and help define what AI-native transformation looks like for private equity.

  • Real impact, fast: your programmes move portfolio company P&Ls and feed directly into fund value creation plans.

  • Senior from day one: lead client SteerCos, shape proposals and own executive and fund relationships.

  • Work at the frontier: lead our own AI engineers and platform inside client businesses, not just talk about AI.

  • Grow with the firm: a clear path to take on more as Riplo's Solutions practice scales.

  • Competitive package: salary, bonus and equity (details discussed at interview).

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Du berichtest direkt an den CTO und verantwortest eigene strategische Arbeitspakete. Der Chief of Staff behält das Gesamtbild, du gehst in die Tiefe.

  • Du bist im engen Austausch mit Produktteams, Fachbereichen und Landesgesellschaften.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst rund 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit, in denen du Themen analysiert und vorangebracht hast, etwa im Inhouse Consulting, in einem Strategie- oder Transformationsstab, im Tech-Bereich eines Unternehmens oder in der Beratung.

Zur Einordnung: Wir suchen Berufserfahrene, die selbst anpacken. Programmleitung oder Führung sind hier die Perspektive, nicht die Voraussetzung.

Wir bieten

  • Eine steile Lernkurve: Strategie, Organisation und Technologie zugleich, mit eigener Verantwortung.

  • Echte Sichtbarkeit: Deine Arbeit landet direkt beim CTO und im Vorstand.

  • Ein attraktives Paket aus Fixgehalt und variablem Anteil.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
descriptionHtml:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket.
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading

Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

  • Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.
  • Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

  • Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field
  • Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships.
  • Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked
  • Think like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions
  • You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 
  • EU citizenship or valid EU working permit required.

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.

Why Picnic?

  • Grow as we grow. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.
  • Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)
  • Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.

When are you joining? 

  • Fall Edition 2026
    Start dates: September, October
    *earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question
  • Spring Edition 2027
    Start dates: February, March
    *earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question

📍 Location: Full-time in Paris, with period trips to NL and DE

There is no deadline: Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride. 

Picnic Perks

🚲Health and Transportation
Through our partnerships with Malakoff Humanis and OpenUp, you have the opportunity to enroll in our company health insurance plan, as well as free and easy access to professional psychologists, workshops, and practical tools. Additionally, if you commute to work using public transportation, we reimburse 50% of your subscription cost.

🍉Food
Since we are located in the center of Paris, there is no on-site cafeteria. However, you will receive meal vouchers worth €11 per day to explore all the delicious restaurants nearby. Our small kitchen is also stocked with tasty snacks and refreshments.

📈Personal and Professional Development
You will have the opportunity to develop your skills not only through exciting projects and a dynamic environment but also via training programs offered by Lepaya.

🏖️All the rest
You get 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional rest days (RTT) based on the number of days worked in the year. Picnic provides you with a laptop, a phone, and a paid SIM card.
🚀Access to exclusive deals and perks through our Works Council (CSE) and our partner Swile (gift cards, concert tickets, cinema discounts, and more)

FAQ

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

title: Android Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Application Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Application Software Teams

We’re seeking an exceptional Application SW Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Execute software bring-up on customer hardware platforms (e.g. NVIDIA Drive, Qualcomm Ride).

  • Port and configure Linux-based systems, QNX, and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments.

  • Integrate and validate drivers, middleware, and boot-time configurations.

  • Collaborate with Verification & Release teams to integrate hardware into CI/CD, HIL, and test infrastructure.

  • Work with OEM and Tier 1 teams to resolve hardware-specific integration issues.

  • Implement system-level diagnostics, logging, and secure boot configuration.

  • Develop automation for setup, flashing, health checks, and test execution on target hardware.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the bring-up and early validation of our AI software stack on customer hardware platforms, ensuring seamless performance across diverse SoCs and operating systems. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Verification, Release, and OEM partners to ensure smooth integration and reliable delivery.

 

🙌 You should apply if

In order to set you up for success as an Application Software Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

  • 8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience.

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python.

  • Deep understanding of Linux-based embedded systems (Yocto, systemd, bootloaders, device trees).

  • Familiarity with QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments and the ability to configure and debug them on target hardware.

  • Experience with bring-up on automotive-grade SoCs (e.g., NVIDIA Orin, Qualcomm SA8295/SA8650, Renesas, TI).

  • Comfortable working with hardware debuggers, flashing tools, serial consoles, and board support packages (BSPs).

  • Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C.

  • Hands-on experience integrating embedded platforms into CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.

Desirable

  • Exposure to automotive verification environments (e.g., HIL systems, Vector toolchains, custom CI rigs).

  • Experience working in a safety-critical domain with an understanding of ISO 26262, boot-time determinism, and watchdogs.

  • Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates, and system-level cybersecurity topics.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Jenkins, Git, and artifact management tools like JFrog Artifactory.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial Call / Recruiter Screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.

  • Competency Interview: programming and code review.

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: system integration, system design and linux.

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.
