title: Engineering Manager – United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: EU Public Affairs Senior Consultant (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for an EU Public Affairs Senior Consultant to join the Public Affairs team in Paris.

title: Fördermittelberater / Berater Forschungszulage (m/w/d) - 100 % remote
descriptionHtml:
Forschung im Mittelstand scheitert selten daran, dass die Ideen ausgehen. Sie endet dann, wenn das Budget ausgeht. Hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Sie setzen sich mit den Entwicklern an den Tisch, hören zu und arbeiten aus ihrer Arbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Sie kalkulieren es, formulieren es und bringen es durch die Prüfstelle. Das Mandat gehört Ihnen, die fachliche Entscheidung auch.

Genau dafür gibt es fundloop. Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung über die steuerliche Forschungszulage zu finanzieren, und haben dafür eine eigene Software gebaut, die Ihnen bei dieser Arbeit den Rücken freihält. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, ohne Beratungsapparat über sich und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

Sie beraten Unternehmen bei der inhaltlichen Ausgestaltung und Strukturierung ihrer Förderprojekte in Forschung, Entwicklung und Innovation. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Förderprojekte formen: Aus dem, was ein Unternehmen tatsächlich entwickelt, schneiden Sie ein sauber abgegrenztes Vorhaben zu - Technische Neuheit, wissenschaftliche und technische Unsicherheit und Arbeitspakete.
  • Fachlich bewerten: Sie beurteilen früh, ob ein Vorhaben förderfähig ist. Auch dann, wenn die Antwort Nein lautet.
  • Projektkosten selbstständig prüfen und kalkulieren: Personalaufwand, Auftragsforschung und Eigenleistungen, plausibel hergeleitet und GoBD-konform dokumentiert, mit Blick auf eine spätere Betriebsprüfung.
  • Mit der Prüfstelle kommunizieren: Sie führen den Austausch mit der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage in Stufe 1 und beantworten deren Rückfragen. Die steuerliche Einreichung in Stufe 2 verantwortet der Steuerberater des Mandanten, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten.
  • Mandate führen: Kickoff, Interviews mit Entwicklern und Technikern, Unterlagen einsammeln, Termine halten.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Naturwissenschaften, Technik oder Wirtschaft.
  • Forschungsbackground - Im Gespräch mit Technikern erkennen Sie, was wirklich neu ist und was gut gemachte Routine.
  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit Fördermittelanträgen, etwa Forschungszulage, ZIM, KMU-innovativ oder EU-Programme. Sie kennen den Unterschied zwischen einem schön geschriebenen Antrag und einem, der einer Prüfung standhält.
  • Sie sehen Chancen, gehen Herausforderungen aktiv an und arbeiten auf Lösungen hin, statt Probleme zu verwalten.
  • Selbstständige und verbindliche Arbeitsweise. Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen, dafür strukturieren Sie Ihre Fälle eigenständig.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Anträge, Projektbeschreibungen und Behördenkommunikation auf Deutsch entstehen. Englisch ist von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote - Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, beim Mandanten oder bei uns in Düsseldorf.
  • Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden, unbefristet, Start ab sofort.
  • Eine Rolle zum Gestalten. Sie entscheiden mit, wie unsere Delivery aussieht, statt Prozesse zu erben, die jemand anders gebaut hat.
  • Werkzeuge, die Sie wirklich unterstützen. Unsere Software begleitet jeden Schritt eines Mandats, damit Ihre Zeit in die fachliche Beurteilung geht.
  • Kurze Wege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Beratungsapparat, keine Pyramide, keine Zwischenebenen.
  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie Förderanträge nicht als Formularübung verstehen, sondern als Fachfrage, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen, im zweiten sprechen wir über einen echten Fall aus der Praxis. Danach entscheiden wir zügig.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien.

Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet.

Was dich erwartet

Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft.

  • End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams.
  • Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme.
  • Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug; als Senior sorgst du dafür, dass die Systeme im Betrieb messbar und beherrschbar bleiben – über Dataset-basierte Evaluations, Logging/Tracing und Observability.
  • Der Rückfluss ist Teil des Jobs: Was sich im Feld als wiederkehrendes Muster erweist, kodifizierst du mit deinem Team in unseren Produkten, Skills und Playbooks. Dein Projektwissen bleibt nicht beim Kunden liegen - es macht das nächste Deployment schneller.
  • Kunde auf Augenhöhe: Du entwickelst in Workshops ein gemeinsames Bild von Problem, Chancen und Lösung, triffst Trade-off-Entscheidungen zwischen Scope, Tempo und Qualität - und sprichst auch an, was der Kunde nicht hören will, wenn es das Ergebnis schützt.
  • Sichtbarkeit: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen in Whitepaper, Talks und unsere AI-Produkte ein - mit Unterstützung unserer technischen Redaktion.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Du hast LLM-Systeme in Produktion gebracht - nicht nur prototypisiert: RAG-Implementierungen, Vector Databases, Agent-Frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK o. ä.), Evals und MLOps.
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende, gewachsene Enterprise-Architekturen - inklusive der unbequemen Teile (Auth, Legacy, Compliance).
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Inference-Infrastruktur (vLLM, GPU-Serving), Kubernetes und On-Prem-/Private-Cloud-Deployments.
  • Die Kompetenz, AI-Konzepte Fachbereichen und C-Level anschaulich zu vermitteln - und die Standfestigkeit, Ownership für Entscheidungen zu übernehmen.
  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.
  • Bereitschaft, phasenweise beim Kunden vor Ort zu arbeiten (projektabhängig, remote-embedded als Regelfall), plus Workshops und Konferenzen 1–2× im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands.

Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung und Kompetenz vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich.
  • Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit.
  • Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück.
  • Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.
  • Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad.

title: Founding Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Founding Engineer at SANOVIO, you will play a key role in building the AI-powered procurement infrastructure that tackles one of the biggest and most complex cost problems in European healthcare.

This is a fast-paced, hands-on role for engineers with high agency, strong technical depth, and a founder mindset. We’re looking for a full-stack generalist with a strong frontend affinity. You excel at designing user flows and implementing them in React and TypeScript, while owning outcomes end-to-end across backend, data, AI-enabled workflows, and cloud deployment. You thrive amid uncertainty and incomplete requirements, move quickly, and still care deeply about architecture, clean code, and long-term quality.

If you are a passionate builder who thrives at the intersection of full-stack development and AI, this is your opportunity to work closely with the founders, shape the product, and help us scale toward €10M ARR in 2026.

Tasks

  • Owning end-to-end product workflows, from frontend UX to backend systems, data pipelines, and edge cases

  • Building world-class frontend experiences in React and TypeScript alongside scalable, reliable backend systems

  • Designing and owning AI-enabled systems, including embeddings, retrieval, and agents that create real operational leverage

  • Developing and operating data pipelines for large-scale unstructured data

  • Making pragmatic technical decisions on architecture, tools, and frameworks to balance speed and quality

  • Deploying, running, and maintaining software in cloud environments with a “you ship it, you run it” mindset

  • Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with scalable, reusable components and APIs

  • Collaborating across the stack and raising the engineering bar through reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership

General Profile

We are looking for stellar engineers with a strong background in full-stack software engineering and AI, and the potential to grow and lead teams in the future. 3–5 years of experience is a plus, but we hire for skill, ownership, and output.

  • Generalist engineer with a frontend affinity, capable of building across backend, data, and AI

  • End-to-end product ownership, driving ideas from concept to customer-ready production

  • Proactive execution in ambiguous environments, turning unclear requirements into shipped software

  • High-speed delivery paired with a focus on clean code and scalable architecture

  • Close iteration with users and clients, including collaboration across different cultures

  • Strong problem-solving ability and fast adoption of new technologies

  • Motivation to build excellent software in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Willingness to work in-person in Munich with a higher intensity than a traditional 9–5 role

Technical skillset

  • Strong experience with full-stack software engineering, especially React and TypeScript, with excellent understanding of constructing user flows

  • Solid backend engineering skills, ideally with Node.js, and experience designing APIs and data model

  • Proven track record of architecting and building production-grade software systems

  • Cloud and DevOps experience with Docker

  • AI experience is a plus, especially embeddings and retrieval, structured outputs and tool calling, evals, and agentic workflows beyond prompt engineering

Leadership and communication

  • You naturally take responsibility and enjoy leading

  • You’re one of the strongest engineers in the team and make everyone else better

  • Everyone can come to you for advice on how to fix their hardest problems

  • You communicate clearly and are credible with technical stakeholders and clients

Bonus if you

  • Can share a portfolio of projects, shipped products, or a GitHub with meaningful work

  • Have experience scaling systems from early usage to larger production workloads

  • Have built workflow-heavy B2B products, internal tools, or operations software

  • You are business proficient in Chinese

Benefits

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly Wellness budget

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you need to do your best work

  • International scope & travel

  • Flexible work setup with time-zone responsibility

  • Meaningful compensation package including cash, performance bonus, and shares (Actual offers and compensation are based on specific job duties, experience, performance, total rewards structure, and other considerations).


About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce SANOVIO.

Step 2: Technical interview

The technical interview consists of two parts:

  • A take-home exercise, including a short presentation

  • A system design interview

For the take-home exercise, we’d provide you with a task. You’ll have 2–3 hours to complete it, focusing on a real SANOVIO workflow and user flow in React and TypeScript, with a light end-to-end angle such as API integration, data modeling, edge cases, and clean architecture. Later, you’ll present your results to us.

Step 3: Personal Fit

Meet another co-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & Reference Checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. At the same time, we’ll ask you to provide 2–3 references so we can gather additional insights into your strengths and working style.

title: Founding Sales
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write software, but you will run your prospecting, preparation, follow-up and business-case analysis on agents rather than by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding, and as a founding sales leader you will partner with Dan, our CEO, to win deals now and to put in place the process, tooling and playbooks that make the next ones predictable.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Full-Cycle Sales: Partner directly with our CEO to craft and execute a detailed go-to-market plan that hits aggressive growth targets. Manage the entire sales process from initial outreach through contract signature. Qualify leads, run discovery, deliver compelling demos, navigate technical and commercial objections, and close deals. Own the number.

  • Build the Pipeline Machine: Instrument a multi-channel demand generation engine including events strategy, AI BDR outreach, targeted ABM campaigns, and creative outbound. You'll leverage emerging sales tools and AI to punch above our weight.

  • Master the Product Story: Own our sales demo and product positioning strategy. Work closely with Deployment Strategists to ensure demos resonate with different personas and value props. You should be able to run a killer demo yourself.

  • Navigate Complex Sales: Sell into freight forwarding operations, IT, and executive buyers. Handle technical conversations, security reviews, and integration discussions. Know when to bring in technical resources and when to close solo.

  • Manage Commercial Relationships: Own the customer relationship post-sale through onboarding and expansion. Work with the Deployment team on smooth handoffs. Identify upsell and expansion opportunities.

  • Build Sales Foundations for Scale: Establish our sales tech stack (CRM, engagement tools, analytics). Create repeatable playbooks, sales collateral, and battlecards. Document what works. Build the foundation that enables the first 10 sales hires.

What we look for

  • Proven Sales Closer: Deeply motivated by winning deals and hitting numbers, with a track record of hitting quota in B2B SaaS or logistics tech. You've closed complex deals with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles, and you know your conversion rates, pipeline velocity and deal cycle times because you instrument what you do.

  • 0-to-1 Builder: You've sold at an early-stage company where nobody handed you a playbook, so you wrote one. You can zoom out to shape GTM strategy with the CEO, then zoom in to write the cold email and prep the demo, and you're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration.

  • Logistics Domain Knowledge: Prior experience selling into freight forwarding, logistics or supply chain is highly valuable. If you don't have it, you've shown you can become a domain expert quickly and speak credibly with industry buyers.

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing AI, automation, APIs and integrations with technical buyers. You can hold your own on system architecture, security and data flows without needing engineering on every call.

  • Founding Team Mentality: Willing to do what it takes to win, whether that's working a trade show floor, building a custom demo environment or getting a contract over the line yourself. You thrive in the chaos of early-stage startups.

Why join

As the first commercial hire you will shape how Nexcade sells, who it sells to and what the product becomes, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will sell directly to the businesses that will run on what we build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. The sales playbook and stack, the demand engine, the partner channel and the expansion motion from one module to the next are not built yet, and would be yours.

title: Frontend Engineering Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Frontend Lead Engineer to own the front end at Omnea.

Our design system is growing fast, our front-end architecture is becoming more complex, and right now ownership of these things is distributed. You'd be the person who takes this to the next level.

You'll work across every product team. You'll own the design system, own the front-end architecture, and set the standard for how we build interfaces. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. The front end has to scale with it.

This is a craft role with real leverage. Almost every engineer at Omnea ships front end. What you build determines how well they do it.

Procurement is a harder interface problem than it sounds. Approval workflows that branch and re-route, dense tables people live in all day, intake forms that adapt to what someone is buying. Getting this right is the difference between software people tolerate and software people actually like using.

What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?

  • Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers and product designers from top technology businesses and startups.

  • Own the Design System. You'll own our design system outright: components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Design to turn intent into reusable, high-quality primitives.

  • Own the Front-End Architecture. Deployment strategy, performance, build tooling, and the conventions everyone else follows. You'll set the direction rather than inherit it, working alongside the engineers and designers closest to each surface rather than owning it in isolation.

  • Leverage Across Every Team. You'll work with all of our engineering teams on their most front-end-heavy projects. The work you do multiplies across the whole org.

  • A Real Design Partnership. Every cross-functional team at Omnea has a dedicated Product Manager and Product Designer. You'll be the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships, and the person designers come to when they want to know what's possible.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript everywhere, React and Next.js on the front end, and Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, so you can refactor the design system without fear. Behind it sits Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions, with Datadog for observability.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.

  • Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.

  • Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.

  • Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.


About You

  • You're deep in React. You've built complex, production React applications and you understand the framework properly, not just the API surface. Rendering behaviour, state, performance, and where things break at scale.

  • You've owned front-end infrastructure. Rendering strategies, build tooling, bundle performance, and the architectural decisions underneath a large application.

  • You've built or owned a design system. Not just consumed one. You've made the calls on component APIs, driven adoption across teams, and dealt with the messy reality of migration and versioning.

  • You have taste. You care how things look and feel, you notice when something is only 90% right, and you can hold a genuine conversation with designers rather than just implementing tickets.

  • You know CSS deeply. Layout, styling architecture, and building interfaces that hold up across breakpoints, themes, and edge cases. You treat accessibility and motion as part of the craft rather than a checklist at the end.

  • You're a strong engineer first. Your depth and your interest sit in the front end, and that's the point of this role. But you're fluent in TypeScript generally and comfortable working beyond the browser when a problem calls for it.

  • You're motivated by impact. You care about what your work actually achieves, not just how it's built. You thrive with the autonomy to make meaningful decisions and take real ownership of outcomes.

  • You're a team builder. You're excited by maximising team performance, whether that means learning from others or taking the time to explain, give feedback, and level up those around you.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. This role is new. Its shape will be partly yours to define, and you're happy tackling problems without a predefined solution, backed by an experienced team.


Nice-to-Haves

  • You've worked at design-led companies or somewhere with a genuinely high bar for interface quality.

  • You've performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. You've gone above and beyond the norm.

  • You love engineering. It's more than a job. You've contributed to open source or worked on side projects just because you enjoy it.


Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it's like to build at Omnea.

>> R&D Candidate Hub: https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4

While this is a front-end specialist role, we expect a core level understanding of TypeScript beyond the browser, so you should be comfortable writing general TypeScript in an exercise that will feel more full-stack than front-end. We assess this as part of our pair programming stage, which is the same standard exercise we run for every engineer. Beyond that baseline, we're looking for genuine depth in React, front-end architecture, and design systems.

The process varies slightly by level but generally includes:

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent team (30 mins, remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge, language-agnostic (1 hour, remote)

  3. Onsite interviews at our Victoria office (~3 hours)

    • Engineering Culture interview with an Engineering Manager or Team Lead (45 mins)

title: Fullstack Engineer - Mid Level - Actions Team
descriptionHtml:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our Actions team in building the core infrastructure that powers our plugin platform. You'll create the UI components, integration layers, and security mechanisms that enable our customers to extend the platform with custom integrations while maintaining safety and flexibility across our 1,500+ customer base. This is essential infrastructure work that shapes how our customers scale their integrations.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and like-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We believe that team events during working hours play a vital role in building an exceptionally effective team, and we encourage them
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the “You build it, you run it” approach and take pride in it

The Team

The Actions team sits at the heart of Staffbase's AI ambitions. We're the team that gives Navigator — our AI assistant and the main entry point into Staffbase — the ability to actually do things: submit a form, complete a task inside an integration, or take an action on a user's behalf through the agent. If Navigator is the brain, we build the hands.

That means two big things. First, we enrich what the AI can see and act on, our plugins, our widgets and the wider Staffbase platform so the assistant can do real work, not just talk about it. Second, we build the extensions that connect to the tools people already use, like Workday, Personio, ServiceNow and Microsoft.   We're not just shipping features, though. A core part of our mission is building the extensibility framework that lets others build too.  

What you'll be doing

  • Building a UI component library that generated apps can assemble from, turning components like payslip views and approval flows into maintained, reusable pieces instead of regenerated artifacts
  • Creating the connection layer between generated apps and customer source systems—HR platforms, time-tracking and scheduling systems, and a long tail of vendors with thin or undocumented APIs
  • Defining extension points (widgets, menus, sidebars) so plugins declare where they surface and what they connect to in a single, clean configuration
  • Designing and implementing a cross-integration authentication solution that lets customers run multiple integrations without forcing employees to log in repeatedly
  • Shipping plugins on the platform yourself, staying a consumer of what we build so we catch gaps early

What you need to be successful

  • Strong knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend work, Kotlin or Go and TypeScript experience for backend services
  • Real experience integrating third-party APIs, especially the challenging ones—inconsistent auth, partial documentation, legacy and on-prem systems
  • Deep understanding of multi-tenancy security and data isolation; you care about scope checks and preventing cross-tenant leaks
  • Good judgment about what to standardize and what to leave flexible—drawing that line in the right place is central to this role

Nice to have experience 

  • You are comfortable with edge and serverless runtimes like Cloudflare Workers
  • You have built a plugin system, SDK, or developer platform before
  • Developed a design system or component library that other teams depended on
  • Real-world experience with OAuth and enterprise SSO
  • Experience treating AI code generation as a product surface, not just a personal tool

What you'll get

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support-we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day- you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack, with at least 3 years of professional software engineering experience. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

title: General Ledger (GL) Accountant
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world's most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We're a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting — from sports to political markets, delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

We're also growing: we're pursuing licensing with the CFTC to expand into the US market, a significant step in our ambition to become a truly global exchange. Joining now means being part of that next chapter, not just maintaining what's already built.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

The Team

Finance makes sure Smarkets has accurate, timely numbers to run the business, satisfy regulators, and stand up to investor scrutiny — across multiple jurisdictions and licences. Two things keep us busy:

  • Reporting & Control — close, statutory accounts, audit, and the controls framework behind a dual UKGC/CFTC regulated business

  • Systems & Transformation — building out reporting on top of our ERP and automating away the manual stuff

A typical week: run a clean close and turn it into a board-ready pack, write a technical paper on a tricky accounting area, ship an automated process and make it audit-ready.

About the Role:

We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive GL Accountant to take ownership of our core accounting operations and general ledger. In this role, you will play a key part in driving the accuracy of our monthly close, ensuring robust balance sheet integrity, and delivering clear financial reporting for internal and external stakeholders.

This is an operational accounting role where you will own the integrity of the General Ledger end-to-end: keeping ledgers accurate, resolving complex accounting issues, and ensuring audit readiness.

What you will do:

  • Own and maintain the General Ledger (GL), ensuring all financial transactions are accurately recorded and mapped

  • Execute the month-end close (m/e) process efficiently and accurately to tight timelines

  • Perform comprehensive balance sheet and account reconciliations, identifying and resolving any variances

  • Prepare and process VAT, tax returns and payroll

  • Prepare monthly management accounts and deliver insightful variance analysis

  • Assist with cash flow forecasting

  • Support the preparation of year-end financial statements and liaise with external auditors

  • Act as a key liaison to investigate and resolve departmental accounting issues across the business

  • Assist in driving internal control improvements and supporting automation within our AI-driven ERP environment

Role Requirements:

  • Part-qualified or newly qualified ACCA/ACA/CIMA, with a strong foundation in core accounting principles

  • Proven hands-on experience in general ledger management and month-end close processes

  • Strong technical skills in balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and financial controls

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving finance team with high standards of data accuracy

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, capable of resolving cross-departmental queries

  • Experience with ERP systems and process automation tools is a plus

  • Experience in a regulated industry (betting, gaming, financial services, or similar) is a plus

 

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do - guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn’t you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

 

Perks & Benefits
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious - united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth,and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally.

These include:

  • Stock Options: Vest over 4 years - your success is our success.

  • Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life’s most important moments.

  • Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks — because great work starts with great food.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

  • Holiday: 25 days paid leave + bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.

  • Team Energy: Regular socials, hackathons, and events — because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand.

What happens next​

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process, and we want to make sure we're right for you as much as the other way around.

  1. Initial screening — a quick chat with our recruiter about your experience and the role

  2. Experience & mindset interview — a conversation about your background and what drives you

  3. Competency interview — with the hiring manager and team

  4. Lunch & leadership team — lunch with the wider team, plus time with members of our leadership team

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer and celebrate diversity in all its forms. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate your needs.

title: Global Client Director
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

The best global media plans don’t simply roll out across markets—they connect a clear global direction with what works locally.

At WPP Media, we’re looking for a Global Client Director to bring that connection to life for a key international client. You’ll lead the day-to-day account operations and media planning delivery across markets, creating clarity, momentum and quality from brief through to measurement.

As part of our Global Client Solutions team in the Netherlands, you’ll work closely with the Senior Client Leadership Director, Client Manager and specialists across strategy, investment, activation, data and measurement. You’ll also bring diverse market teams together, helping them deliver connected, locally relevant work.

What you’ll do

Lead planning across markets

  • Own the end-to-end media planning process, establishing clear planning cycles, ways of working, timelines, milestones, responsibilities and approval processes.
  • Turn client briefs into actionable media briefs. Challenge gaps and align objectives, audiences, budgets, KPIs, deliverables and timings before planning begins.
  • Translate global strategy and priorities into clear direction for local markets, creating consistency where it adds value while allowing for local insight and relevance.
  • Bring strategy, audience insights, channel planning, investment, activation, data and measurement teams together to shape integrated recommendations.
  • Review and challenge market plans, ensuring they’re strategically sound and clearly explain channel roles, audiences, investment levels, phasing and expected outcomes.

Keep delivery and learning on track

  • Own the planning calendar and keep global and local teams aligned on deadlines, dependencies and next steps.
  • Maintain visibility of media budgets, ensuring investment decisions and changes are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Identify risks, missing inputs and potential delays early—and take action to keep delivery moving.
  • Embed KPIs and measurement requirements into plans from the start, then turn results and market learnings into improvements for future planning.
  • Continuously improve planning templates, workflows and governance to raise quality, consistency and efficiency.

Lead the client relationship and support growth

  • Act as a senior day-to-day client contact, providing clear updates on planning progress, decisions, risks and next steps.
  • Build strong relationships across client marketing, media, procurement and specialist teams, involving the right people at the right stages.
  • Listen to client feedback and turn it into practical actions. Resolve issues proactively and escalate when needed, while keeping ownership clear.
  • Support the Client Growth Plan by identifying opportunities to improve and expand the services WPP Media provides.
  • Partner with commercial and investment leads on scope, resourcing, forecasting and profitability. Spot additional requirements early and ensure they’re appropriately scoped.
  • Identify where WPP Media’s tools, platforms, data and specialist capabilities can strengthen the client’s planning and delivery.

A global mindset

Every market is different. Media landscapes, consumer behaviour, costs, channel maturity and local requirements vary from country to country. You’ll know how to create a consistent approach without applying a one-size-fits-all plan.

You’ll also bring markets together—sharing best practice and making sure individual market learnings help improve planning across the wider account.

What you’ll bring

  • At least five years’ experience in client leadership, account management or media planning, ideally working with international or multi-market clients.
  • A strong understanding of the end-to-end media planning process, from brief and strategy through channel planning, investment, activation and measurement.
  • Experience coordinating planning processes, budgets, timelines and deliverables across multiple markets.
  • The confidence to review and challenge media plans, and translate strategic direction into practical requirements for local teams.

title: Go-To-Market Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at HRtechX

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why HRtechX

HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.

HRtechX is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Du liebst es, mit Menschen zu arbeiten, Teams zu stärken und im operativen Tagesgeschäft den Überblick zu behalten?

Bei Picnic übernimmst du eine zentrale Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Herne sorgst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere Abläufe reibungslos laufen und jede Bestellung zuverlässig auf den Weg geht. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste Liefersystem Europas – mit 100% elektrischer Auslieferung bis an die Haustür unserer KundInnen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Ansprechperson, Coach und Rückhalt für dein Team aus 5 Teamleitenden und über 150 Lagermitarbeitenden. Du führst auf Augenhöhe, hörst zu, erkennst Potenziale und schaffst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich alle gesehen und wertgeschätzt fühlen.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du auch an trubeligen Tagen einen kühlen Kopf, priorisierst Aufgaben vorausschauend und hältst die Fäden im Tagesgeschäft sicher zusammen.
  • Abwechslung: Dich erwartet eine ausgewogene Mischung aus direktem Austausch auf dem FC Shopfloor (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und konzeptioneller Arbeit im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Du schaust genau hin, wo es im Alltag hakt, holst dir Feedback von deinen Teamleitenden und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team praxistaugliche Lösungen, die unsere Abläufe Schritt für Schritt besser machen.
  • Verantwortung: Du denkst bereichsübergreifend mit, packst an, wo Unterstützung gebraucht wird, und arbeitest eng mit den anderen Operations Supervisors zusammen, um das FC gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, o.ä. ist willkommen. Dazu bringst du erste Erfahrung in der Logistik, im Lagerbetrieb oder in einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld mit.
  • Menschen stehen für dich an erster Stelle. Du bist empathisch, kommunikativ, fair und behältst auch in herausfordernden Gesprächen eine ruhige, lösungsorientierte Haltung.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst klare Entscheidungen und hast Freude daran, ein Team langfristig zu begleiten und stabil aufzubauen.
  • Du fühlst dich auf dem Shopfloor genauso wohl wie im Office, erkennst im Alltag schnell, wo Abläufe noch runder laufen können, und setzt pragmatische Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team um.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, im 2-Schicht-System zu arbeiten (6:00–14:30 Uhr & 14:30–23:00 Uhr, inkl. samstags).

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

title: Graduate Partnership Executive
descriptionHtml:
About us

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Lululemon and many more use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The Graduate Opportunity at Fospha

Joining Fospha’s graduate programme means stepping into a fast-paced environment where you’ll gain real responsibility and exposure from day one. In Partnerships, graduates work directly with some of the world’s biggest digital platforms - like TikTok, Meta, and Snapchat - playing a key role in strengthening relationships, enabling joint initiatives, and driving partner success.

  • Hands-on exposure to our Partnerships: Working directly with the platforms such as Tiktok, Meta and Snap, you will build commercial acumen, develop strategic communication skills, and gain a deep understanding of how the digital advertising ecosystem works.
  • Cross-Functional Exposure: With support, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to make a visible impact early on, it’s the ideal launchpad for ambitious graduates looking to break into the world of ad tech and strategic partnerships.
  • Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Relationship Building, Market Research & Product and Financial Management.

The Role:

As a Partnerships Executive, you'll join a high-impact team focused on enabling, scaling, and deepening Fospha’s relationships with the platforms that power digital marketing.

This is a graduate-level role designed to develop future leaders. You’ll be hands-on with major ad platforms, supporting both strategic execution and day-to-day coordination. You’ll also work closely with internal teams - especially Marketing, Product and our Customer Teams - to make sure our partners have what they need to help customers grow.

Key responsibilities:

  • Supporting our partner managers in coordinating with Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap and others
  • Preparing decks, talking points and training sessions to enable partner sales teams
  • Tracking and reporting on partner performance and engagement
  • Liaising across internal teams to keep initiatives moving and aligned
  • Owning communications or enablement efforts for specific territories or smaller partners
  • Researching and initiating contact with emerging or long-tail partners
  • In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen Ai hub!

What are we looking for?

We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. You should apply if you:

  • Are an excellent communicator – written, verbal, and visual
  • Are highly organised and detail-oriented
  • Are curious about how marketing, measurement and partnerships work
  • Can handle multiple workstreams and work well under light-touch supervision
  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments
  • Want to make a real commercial impact from day one

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Meta, or other digital marketing tools
  • Familiarity with platforms like Notion, HubSpot, Google Sheets
  • Any internship or part-time experience in partnerships, sales, marketing or client-facing roles
  • Like shopping and are a customer of retail brands

Our Values and Principles

You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

  • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
  • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
  • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
  • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
  • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

What we can offer you

  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year
  • Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
  • Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

The Process

  • 15-minute screening call with a member of the Talent Team
  • 30-minute Hiring Manager interview
  • Task and Panel interview
  • Final Exec interview

Top tip: Make sure to thoroughly research Fospha and tell us why you would be a great fit for the role!

descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people? Are you curious or passionate about creating events? If so, you might be our Graduate sales executive.

About us

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our Graduate sales executive, you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building the greatest global conferences by providing you with exceptional training and products. We want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone. You’ll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • A competitive salary and generous OTE
  • An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses
  • A chance to work closely together with our leadership team on conference strategies
  • Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally

Your Responsibilities

Your mission would be towork closely with our lead generation and senior sales team to generate meetings for our global partnerships managers. In order to be successful, your main duties will include:

  • Meeting booking: Work with a team of analysts to both review potential leads and set up meetings for our sales team. You are expected to use a range of outreach methods (phone, email, LinkedIn etc) in order to set meetings with quality prospects
  • Expertise Development: Over time, hone your expertise in generating new business meetings with senior prospects, becoming an essential part of our growth journey
  • Sales Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our sales representatives, helping them fill their diaries and grow our impressive sponsor roster globally

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you can demonstrate:

  • Sales passion: Have a relentless drive and desire to work in an outbound sales role with a view to rapidly progressing your career with us
  • Target driven: Have worked in a fast-paced commercial environment and enjoy meeting targets
  • Team Spirit: Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations
  • Communication Maestro: Showcase stellar verbal and written communication skills

Startdate

Flexible, Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work. You must have a UK work permit

title: Graduate Tax Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.

No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.

What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.

And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

 

The Job

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.

  • Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

  • Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

  • Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

  • Ship tools people use: build tax tools on live financial data, from first idea to everyday use.

  • Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve.

 

Why you'll want it

A qualification, paid for. Learn tax on the job from specialists across multiple disciplines, with your professional qualification funded.

The whole function, not one corner. Planning, launches, processes and returns: you'll see how tax works across a high-growth fintech, start to finish.

Real outcomes, early. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you own real work early and take on more as soon as you're ready.

A CV with both halves. You'll come out knowing tax, and knowing how to build the AI-enabled systems behind it in a regulated business.

 

Is this you?

You have, or are on track for, a first-class degree in a numerate subject (or equivalent experience). You're graduating in 2026 or 2027, or you're up to two years into your career.

You write strong SQL plus Python or similar, and you've used AI workflows on large datasets in practice.

You think in systems, and you can explain technical work to people who don't write code.

And you're genuinely curious about tax, with the drive to qualify.

 

Never studied tax? That's the part we teach. Send your CV, even if it isn't polished yet.
