title: Lead Propellant Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Lead Propellant Manager to lead the development, qualification, scale-up, and productionisation of the solid propellants used in our propulsion systems. You will provide technical direction across formulation, processing, characterisation, material qualification, and manufacturing readiness.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone with significant experience in solid propellants, energetic materials, chemical processing, or a closely related field. You will work closely with propulsion, manufacturing, test, quality, and supply-chain teams to turn propellant concepts into safe, repeatable, and high-performing propulsion hardware.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead propellant development from formulation and laboratory trials through characterisation, scale-up, qualification, and production readiness.

  • Set technical direction for propellant chemistry, processing, material selection, performance, ageing, and compatibility.

  • Establish and improve procedures for safe, repeatable propellant manufacture, handling, testing, and storage.

  • Lead investigations into formulation issues, non-conformances, unexpected results, process variation, and material compatibility.

  • Coordinate propellant activities across propulsion engineering, manufacturing, test, quality, procurement, and suppliers.

  • Build the team’s technical capability through mentoring, documentation, process improvement, and the development of robust engineering methods.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience in solid propellant development, energetic materials, chemical processing, or a closely related field.

  • A degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, polymer science, energetic materials, or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of propellant formulation, processing, characterisation, material behaviour, and experimental design.

  • Experience taking propellant formulations or chemical processes from laboratory development toward repeatable production.

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical work, make sound engineering decisions, and manage competing priorities.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a methodical approach to safety, quality, traceability, and technical documentation.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, catalysts, or other energetic materials.

  • Propellant testing, including burn-rate measurement, thermal analysis, rheology, mechanical testing, ageing, or compatibility studies.

  • Scale-up, process qualification, production support, or continuous improvement in a chemical or aerospace manufacturing environment.

  • Experience supporting rocket motor development, static-fire testing, qualification, or flight programmes.

  • Explosives licensing, hazardous-materials controls, chemical safety, or regulated laboratory and production processes.

  • Supplier qualification, incoming-material inspection, non-conformance management, quality systems, or Python-based data analysis.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

title: Lead Support Paie & DSN
descriptionHtml:

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour un gestionnaire de paie, une question sans réponse un jour de clôture, c'est une paie en retard. La qualité du support est ce qui fait la confiance d'un cabinet dans son logiciel de paie.

Notre support est hybride : Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA, apporte la première réponse, et notre équipe prend le relais dès qu'un gestionnaire de paie a besoin d'un humain. Pour accompagner l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets, nous structurons une équipe Support dédiée, et tu en prends la tête.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu construis et pilotes l'équipe Support d'Alassio : tu garantis à nos cabinets des réponses rapides et justes, et tu restes toi-même au contact des cas de paie et de DSN les plus délicats. Tu fais de la qualité du support un standard tenu, quel que soit le volume.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Construire l'équipe : participer aux recrutements des Spécialistes Support Paie et des Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN, les intégrer et les faire monter en compétences

  • Piloter l'activité au quotidien : organisation de la couverture du lundi au vendredi, répartition des demandes, suivi du backlog

  • Tenir nos standards de service : première réponse en moins de 5 minutes, satisfaction des cabinets supérieure à 98 %, délais de résolution maîtrisés

  • Traiter toi-même les cas complexes de paie et de DSN, et arbitrer les escalades vers l'Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN, l'équipe Juridique et l'équipe Tech

  • Faire progresser Alassio Intelligence : enrichir sa base de connaissances et analyser les demandes qu'il ne résout pas, pour qu'il réponde juste plus souvent

  • Construire les process : circuits d'escalade, réponses types, revues qualité, outillage Intercom

  • Porter la voix des cabinets : synthèse régulière des irritants et des demandes récurrentes pour l'équipe Métier et le Product

 

🔁 Tes rituels

  • Un point d'équipe hebdomadaire avec l'équipe Support

  • Un triage hebdomadaire avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), l'Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN et l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie : remontées des cabinets, corrections, priorités produit

  • Le demo day de toute l'équipe, chaque vendredi midi

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Rattachement : Hector (COO)

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), Ludivine (Resp. Juridique), l'équipe Tech et l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA)

  • Outils : Alassio, Alassio Intelligence, Intercom, Linear, Notion, Mintlify

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le produit, nos circuits d'escalade et nos indicateurs, et tu traites toi-même des demandes de chaque niveau

  • À 3 mois : l'organisation de la couverture et les rituels d'équipe sont en place, tes premières recrues sont intégrées, et tu partages ton rapport d'étonnement

  • À 6 mois : l'équipe tient nos standards de service à volume croissant, et la part des demandes résolues par Alassio Intelligence progresse

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • 4 à 6 ans d'expérience en paie, dont une expérience de support, de conseil ou de consultant(e) chez un éditeur de paie ou en cabinet

  • Maîtrise de la DSN : contrôles, anomalies et rejets, régularisations

  • Une première expérience d'encadrement ou d'animation d'équipe (management, référent(e), tutorat)

  • Le goût du pilotage par les indicateurs

Un plus :

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Pratique d'un outil de support (Intercom, Zendesk ou équivalent)

  • Intérêt pour l'IA appliquée au support

  • Le calme et l'organisation lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie mensuelles, mois de janvier)

Processus de sélection

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

  

Ce que nous offrons

Construire l'équipe Support d'un logiciel de paie nouvelle génération, en combinant expertise humaine et IA, au contact direct des cabinets et du produit.

title: LLM Scientist, AI for Science
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

We are hiring an LLM Scientist to push the boundaries of AI-driven scientific discovery. You will specialize in developing and optimizing large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and deep learning frameworks to solve open problems in the natural sciences: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and/or Materials Science. Your work will empower scientists with cutting-edge AI tools and accelerate research through:

  • Model-centric innovation: Improving LLMs’ capabilities to tackle complex scientific problems (e.g., literature synthesis, autonomous experimentation, rigorous derivations).

  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Partnering with Natural sciences domain experts to translate AI advancements into real-world scientific impact.

What you will do

  • AI/ML Research: Participate in end-to-end training of LLM-based solutions, with a focus on scalability, generalization, and scientific applicability.

  • Data creation: Design original workflows to accumulate high quality scientific data at scale, either through synthetic or crowd sourced pipelines.

  • Algorithm Design: Use and improve reinforcement learning, or agentic systems tailored to Natural sciences challenges (e.g., modeling resolution, material property prediction, advanced data analysis and coding).

  • Interdisciplinary Bridge: Work closely with domain scientists to identify AI opportunities and refine models based on feedback.

  • Tooling & Infrastructure: Contribute to company infrastructure to improve usability for model training in scientific contexts and open-source AI tools for science for non-AI experts.

  • Autonomous Innovation: Set a research agenda for AI in science, exploring high-risk/high-reward ideas.

 

What We're Are Looking For

  • AI/ML Expertise: Strong background in LLMs, deep learning, or agentic AI, with a track record of applying these to real-world problems (publications, open-source contributions, or deployed systems) – at the minimum extensive experience in computer science and ideally experience scaling synthetic data generation.

  • State-of-the-art Knowledge: Familiarity with the latest advancements in LLM architectures and post training.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX, model optimization, and scaling techniques (e.g., fine-tuning, RLHF).

  • Scientific Capability: Ability to understand 1 Natural Science domain at a high level (e.g., graduate level specialization + general undergrad knowledge) to design effective AI solutions.

  • Engineering Rigor: Proficiency in scientific computing (e.g., numerical methods, HPC) and software best practices.

  • Collaboration: Experience translating technical AI concepts for non-experts (e.g., scientists, engineers) and iterating based on user needs.

  • Mindset: Low ego, team player, and eager to tackle operational challenges (e.g., data pipelines, model deployment).

Motivational paragraph

When applying for the AI for Science team at Mistral, please describe in a short paragraph a potential project that you would like to contribute to the team, why it is challenging and interesting in general, and more specifically for Mistral. Please also highlight the specific skill set that you can bring to the team.

title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base. You’ll own the team’s post-sale operating model across onboarding, adoption, value realisation and expansion, while staying directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and growth opportunities.

  • Build practical playbooks, portfolio coverage models and operating cadences that improve customer outcomes, retention, adoption and expansion across payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Improve visibility and predictability across onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, expansion pipeline, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and retention.

  • Drive a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value.

  • Orchestrate complex level 2 customer issues with Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations, turning recurring friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

  • Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

Within the first 90 days, you’ll have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities, established the team cadence and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues. Within six to twelve months, priority accounts should have clear plans and stakeholder coverage, the core playbooks should be consistently used, leading indicators should improve against an agreed baseline, and the four Account Managers should show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

You'll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • Experience with KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Experience managing strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Experience in pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Experience in Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Manager (m/w/d) Bildung für die kommunale Beratung und Prozessbegleitung
descriptionHtml:
Die Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg ist eine von elf Metropolregionen in Deutschland. Als leistungsfähiger Standort und Heimat für talentierte und engagierte Menschen aus aller Welt entwickelt sie sich stetig weiter. 11 Kreisfreie Städte, 23 Landkreise sowie rund 170 Unternehmen und Kammern aus Nordbayern haben sich zusammengeschlossen. Diese Allianz aus Politik und Wirtschaft ist über den gemeinnützigen Verein EMN Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg e.V. organisiert. Die Geschäftsstelle hat ihren Sitz im Wirtschaftsrathaus in der Theresienstr. 9 in Nürnberg.

Mit Förderung des Bundesministeriums für Bildung und Forschung richtet die Metropolregion im Verbund mit dem Deutschen Jugendinstitut die „Regionale Entwicklungsagentur kommunales Bildungsmanagement (REAB) Bayern“ ein. Als Teil des bundesweiten Fachnetzwerks „Kommunales Bildungsmanagement“ berät die Agentur Landkreise und kreisfreie Städte zu einer strategischen Weiterentwicklung kommunaler Bildungslandschaften, sowohl organisational im Hinblick auf ein kommunales Bildungsmanagement, sowohl organisational im Hinblick auf ein kommunales Bildungsmanagement als auch thematisch-inhaltlich im Hinblick auf eine analog-digitale Vernetzung sowie in bildungsbezogenen Schwerpunkten.

Die Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg sucht einen Manger (m/w/d) Bildung im Bereich wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit für die kommunale Beratung und Prozessbegleitung, Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD. Die Stelle ist ab dem 01.01.2027 in Teilzeit mit 19,5 Wochenarbeitsstunden zu besetzen und bis 31.01.2028 als Elternzeitvertretung befristet. Beschäftigungsort ist Nürnberg.

Aufgaben

  • Strategie-, Change- und Organisationsberatung von Kommunen zur organisationalen und inhaltlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer kommunalen Bildungslandschaften und/oder

  • Fachberatung von Kommunen zu bildungsbezogenen Schwerpunkten (z. B. hinsichtlich Fachkräftesicherung, Bildung für nachhaltige Entwicklung, kulturelle und demokratische Bildung, Integration, Inklusion und Ganztagsbildung) sowie zu einer analog-digital vernetzten Bildungslandschaft

  • Prozessbegleitung von Kommunen beim Auf- und Ausbau von Strukturen für ein kommunales Bildungsmanagement

  • Konzeptionelle Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Moderation von Qualifizierungsworkshops, Arbeitsgemeinschaften und Fachkonferenzen

  • Auf- und Ausbau bildungsbezogener Kommunikations- und Netzwerkstrukturen

  • Beteiligung an Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Wissensmanagement der Entwicklungsagentur sowie im bundesweiten Fachnetzwerk kommunales Bildungsmanagement, inkl. Mitwirkung an fachbezogenen Publikationen

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master, Diplom oder vergleichbarer Abschluss) vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Organisationsentwicklung, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Pädagogik oder Politikwissenschaften

  • Erfahrung in der verantwortlichen Begleitung von Organisationsentwicklungsprozessen und/oder

  • Fachliche Erfahrungen in kommunal verantworteten Bildungsbereichen, z.B. Fachkräftesicherung, Bildung für nachhaltige Entwicklung, kulturelle und demokratische Bildung, Integration, Inklusion, Ganztagsbildung sowie analog-digital vernetzten Bildungslandschaften

  • Erfahrung in der Lehre und Qualifizierung, z.B. durch die verantwortliche Durchführung von Lehrveranstaltungen, Coachings oder Qualifizierungen

  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Kreativität, Konzeptionsstärke, eine selbstständige und effiziente Arbeitsweise sowie Kollegialität und Teamfähigkeit

  • Erfahrungen mit einem kommunalen Bildungsmanagement inkl. Bildungsmonitoring wünschenswert

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Betreuung von Netzwerken wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Verwaltungs- und Arbeitsstrukturen, bei Bildungsanbietern oder einschlägigen Forschungseinrichtungen wünschenswert

Benefits

  • Ein kollegiales und aufgeschlossenes Team

  • Vielseitige, spannende und herausfordernde Aufgaben sowie eine eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie mit der Möglichkeit von Homeoffice

  • Möglichkeit für mobiles Arbeiten im Ausland

  • Zuschuss bei Nutzung des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Bitte reichen Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse) bis spätestens 02.12.2026 über unsere Bewerbungsplattform Join ein.

Für fachliche Rückfragen zum Projekt „Regionale Entwicklungsagentur kommunales Bildungsmanagement“ wenden Sie sich bitte an den Projektleiter Florian Neumann, Tel.: 0911/231-10516.

Informationen zur Metropolregion finden Sie unter unserer Homepage.

Wegen der im Zusammenhang mit dem Bewerbungsverfahren zu erhebenden personenbezogenen Daten bitten wir Sie unsere Informationen nach Art. 13 und 14 Datenschutzgrundverordnung unter unserer Homepage zu beachten.

Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung vorrangig berücksichtigt. Die Europäische Metropolregion Nürnberg verfolgt eine Politik der Chancengleichheit und freut sich über Bewerbungen von Interessenten (m/w/d) unabhängig von ihrer Nationalität und Herkunft.

title: Manager Data & Strategie Nieuwsmedia
descriptionHtml:
Rotterdam - Als Manager Redactionele Strategie & Analyse ben je een analytisch zwaargewicht en verantwoordelijk voor de strategie en prioritering binnen het cluster. Je realiseert duurzame digitale groei door data-inzichten strategisch te verankeren binnen een specifiek cluster van titels. Je fungeert daarnaast als de onmisbare schakel tussen het centrale RI&G-team en de lokale redacties. Jouw rol focust zich op het Algemeen Dagblad (AD) en 7 regiotitels, zoals De Stentor of De Gelderlander.

Wie zijn wij?
Wij zijn de afdeling Redactionele inzichten & groei (RI&G). Binnen de divisie Nieuwsmedia & Magazines zijn wij dé strategische partner voor de redacties. We leveren niet zomaar losse adviezen of rapportages aan, maar we realiseren duurzame digitale groei door data-inzichten strategisch te verankeren binnen onze mediatitels.

We fungeren als de onmisbare schakel tussen het centrale expertisecentrum en de dagelijkse praktijk op de lokale redacties. Door complexe datasets te vertalen naar een helder, strategisch verhaal, maken we redactionele besluitvorming inzichtelijk en stevig onderbouwd. Zo helpen we de redacties om redactionele en operationele kansen in één oogopslag te signaleren en bepalen we samen de digitale koers van onze nieuwsmerken.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Cluster-regie & Prioritering: Je beheert de roadmap voor het gehele cluster en bepaalt welke projecten en centrale data-innovaties prioriteit krijgen.

  • Team Performance & Coaching: Je geeft direct leiding aan een team van lokale analisten, coacht hen in hun rol als strategisch partner voor titels en bevordert de zelfredzaamheid van de redacties.

  • Strategisch Filter: Je fungeert als de 'brug' en het filter voor ad-hoc vragen en distribueert deze efficiënt binnen het team om de focus op impact te bewaken.

  • Analytisch Expert: Je voert zelfstandig complexe, zwaardere clusterbrede analyses en strategische deep-dives uit die specifiek voor het cluster zijn bedoeld.

  • Netwerkfunctie: Je stemt clusteroverstijgende prioriteiten af met het centrale team, de andere leads en de verschillende hoofdredacties binnen jouw cluster.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

  • Je hebt een WO / HBO+ denkniveau en 10+ jaar ervaring in data-analyse en strategie mét grote affiniteit voor media.

  • Je beschikt over analytisch en strategisch meesterschap, waardoor je redactionele of operationele kansen signaleert en complexe datasets vertaalt naar een helder, strategisch verhaal.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het direct en indirect aansturen van een team en krijgt energie van coachend leiderschap om de effectieve samenwerking te bevorderen.

  • Je bent besluitvaardig en durft harde prioriteiten te stellen en keuzes richting hoofdredacties te verdedigen.

  • Je hebt een sterke communicatieve kracht en schakelt moeiteloos tussen de diepgaande taal van data-analisten en de strategische behoeften van hoofdredacties en directie.

  • Je bent hands-on en nog steeds zeer vaardig met analytische tools.

  • Jouw standplaats is Rotterdam en je bent bereid om te reizen naar de regionale titels van ADR.

Wat krijg je van ons?
💰 Een salaris passend bij jouw werkervaring.
📝 Een 36-urige werkweek.
💰 8% vakantiegeld en 4% persoonlijk keuzebudget.
🎓 Ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, zowel op de job als online via onze DPG Campus.
🎉 Mogelijkheid om je eigen culturele feestdagen af te stemmen.

Solliciteren, en dan?
Heb je interesse? Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem dan gerust contact op met Julia van EL: Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken
Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen.

We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquizteam of een sportteam is.

Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben. En, als je toch bezig bent, vind je ons ook op LinkedIn en Instagram.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

This is your chance to set the global standard for how we deliver customer value, keeping your own product skills razor-sharp in everything from advanced AI workflows to complex integrations.   • Embrace the Future: Hands-on experience building or testing AI agents, knowledge collections, or AI-powered workflows.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Taurus

Join the Next Global FinTech Success Story

Are you ready to be part of a bold entrepreneurial journey and help shape the future of finance? At Taurus, we're building the next-generation digital asset infrastructure, and we might just have the perfect opportunity for you.

Headquartered in Switzerland, Taurus is a leading financial technology company specializing in digital asset infrastructure. Our fully integrated, modular platform empowers financial institutions to manage the entire lifecycle of digital assets, including custody, tokenization, and trading. We are trusted by corporate & investment banks, private banks, asset managers, broker-dealers, custodians and crypto banks.

As we expand globally, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our team and help accelerate our growth. If you’re passionate about innovation, blockchain technology, and the future of finance, we want to hear from you.

Your role

Reporting to the CMO and working closely with the Head of Taurus-NETWORK Partnerships & Marketing, you will own Taurus's communication and events outside the US: PR, social media, design and collateral, and our worldwide events program. You will be the day-to-day lead for our PR and design agencies, and will work hand in hand with the marketing automation and US partnerships & events teams.

What you will do

From one of our offices in Paris, London, Istanbul, Vancouver or Sao Paolo:

  • PR & communication: manage our PR & communication agency day to day: press releases, announcements, media relations, interview and speaking opportunities, and the PR calendar

  • Coordinate corporate and partner announcements with internal stakeholders (product, partnerships, legal) to ensure accurate and compliant messaging

  • Social media: run Taurus's organic social media, primarily LinkedIn: editorial calendar, post production, community engagement, performance reporting and paid advertising.

  • Design & collateral: manage our design agency to deliver collateral, event materials, presentations and visual assets consistent with the Taurus brand identity

  • Brand & content: support the team on thought leadership, turning white papers, case studies, product launches and partner news into posts, articles, newsletters and event content

  • Events (worldwide, excl. US): own the events program end to end (conferences, trade shows, roundtables, client and partner events, webinars), from selection, sponsorship and budget through logistics, on-site delivery and post-event follow-up, with clear pipeline objectives for each event

  • Coordinate the global events calendar with the US events lead so that sponsorships, messaging and materials stay consistent across regions

  • Measure the impact of each event (meetings, leads, pipeline) and ensure leads are captured in the CRM and followed up, working with marketing automation and sales

  • Coherence & cadence: own a single integrated communication calendar that links content, company and partner news, client acquisition campaigns and events, so Taurus communicates regularly and with one consistent message.

Requirements

A successful candidate will have:

  • A strong background in marketing, communication and PR within a financial services and/or digital asset company

  • Expertise in Product Marketing is a plus.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree

  • 5+ years’ experience in communication, PR or events marketing, ideally in a high-growth B2B company

  • A proven track record of organizing international conferences and trade shows end to end, including vendor management and budget control

  • Experience managing PR and creative agencies

  • Hands-on social media experience, especially on LinkedIn; familiarity with design tools (e.g. Canva, Figma) and video tools.

  • A passion for blockchain-based software and financial technology is a strong plus

  • Obsessed with execution: driven to achieve goals

  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a team player

  • Strong writing and communication skills

  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

  • Willingness to travel regularly for events

  • Fluent in French and English

What we offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and finance

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts

  • A fast-paced learning environment, entrepreneurial spirit and team spirit

  • A great moment to join as the company grows and expands

  • State-of-the-art technology and IT infrastructure

  • Hybrid remote work and flexible working hours

  • Fun team events

  • RTT based on Syntec classification

Closing

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. As such, there will be significant growth opportunities for candidates with an open and deliver mindset. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We will not consider applications via agencies.

title: Member of Technical Staff – Infra, k8s, Dynamo

Your mission

You will make Lyceum's AI inference platform reliable, secure, and scalable - ensuring it performs under pressure as we grow to thousands of concurrent users. While others on the team expand what the platform can do, your job is to make sure it keeps working, fails gracefully, and gets faster over time.

Your focus

Scalability: Architect and implement the systems that allow our inference platform to scale to thousands of concurrent users. This includes request routing, load balancing, autoscaling, and resource scheduling across GPU clusters.

Reliability and observability: Build robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response tooling. Design for graceful degradation, automatic recovery, and minimal downtime.

Performance engineering: Profile and optimise the full inference path from request ingestion through model execution to response delivery. Identify and eliminate bottlenecks at every layer.

Infrastructure evolution: Evaluate and integrate open-source inference frameworks and tooling (Dynamo, vLLM, Triton, etc.) where they improve throughput, latency, or stability of the serving stack.

Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude!

Gemeinsam mit dem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team baust du täglich dein Kundennetzwerk aus und übertriffst deine Ziele. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und weißt, wie du unser Cybersecurity-Angebot positionierst und eine Lösung präsentierst, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können!

Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Pre-Sales, Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neue Geschäftsfelder voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle.

So trägst du zum Erfolg bei:

  • Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Mid-Market-Segment.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten

    Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und

    deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur

    Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline.

  • Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in

    enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern.

  • Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller

    Kunden, um den Mehrwert der SoSafe-Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend zu

    präsentieren.

  • Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation

    unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts.

Was dich auszeichnet:

  • 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus

    auf SMB- oder Mid-Market-Kunden.

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst die Initiative, behältst

    Ziele im Blick und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss.

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross-

    funktionalen Teams.

  • Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten.

  • Anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld

    flexibel zu managen.

  • Offen für Feedback und Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen und dich

    weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und

    LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Fließende Deutsch und Englisch- Kenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.

  • Standort: Köln/ deutschlandweit (Remote) - bei uns arbeitest du hauptsächlich remote und kommst für regelmäßige Teamtage nach Köln (z. B. monatlich).

Was wir bieten*:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

  • Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte

  • Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

*Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Über uns

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.

Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.

Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

title: Mid Market Account Executive - English Speaking
descriptionHtml:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible.

What will you be doing?

• Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution.

• Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals.

• Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

• Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity.

• Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning.

• Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings.

What are we looking for?

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals.

• A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.

• Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes

• Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood.

• The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers.

• Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

• Fluency in English

• Enthusiasm for our product and potential

What we offer:

descriptionHtml:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

MLOps Engineer (CDI)   About Mirakl   Mirakl is the leading provider of eCommerce software solutions. Mirakl's suite of solutions provides enterprises with a transformative way to drive significant growth and efficiency in their online business. Since 2012, Mirakl has been pioneering the platform economy, empowering retail and B2B enterprises with the most advanced, secure, and scalable technology to digitize and expand product assortment through marketplace and dropship, improve efficiency in supplier catalog management and payments, personalize shopping experiences, and boost profits through retail media.   In July 2025, Mirakl launched Mirakl Nexus, the first neutral infrastructure designed for agentic commerce. Built on Mirakl's 13 years of expertise and innovation, and powered by an ecosystem of more than 100,000 sellers, Mirakl Nexus connects merchants and AI agents to automate product discovery, payments, and after-sales service.   For more information: www.mirakl.com.   This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris, with 4 days on-site per week.  

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard, Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.  

2. Your Impact

  • Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control
  • Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)
  • Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team
  • Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics
  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment
  • Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems
  • Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem
  • Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks
  • Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)
  • Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences
 

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark  

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required) 
 

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 1 hour discussion with your futur manager 
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.
Want to learn more about how we build our AI infrastructure? Read our latest article: Open source at the core, proprietary where it counts: Mirakl's AI inference platform — by Jeanine Harb, Antoine Bourgault and Maxime Roodnejad, Senior Data Engineers at Mirakl.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. title: Move to New Zealand - Systems Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:

We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country. Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).

The Role:

We're looking for an experienced, AI-native Systems Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering Team. This team works alongside our core development teams to support existing operations, with a mandate for continuous improvement and the goal to create systems that are as "hands-off" as possible. You'll work with our delivery teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure systems delivered are scalable, robust, and supportable. You'll also work on optimising our software and infrastructure to improve reliability and decrease cost.

You are agentic-first. You reach for AI to diagnose, script, automate and document as a matter of course, and you are at home operating within an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

There is an element of working on support issues arising in real time while also participating in DevOps tasks to implement changes and investigate problems.

In both instances, the expectation is that AI does the first pass and you direct and verify it.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.


Role Responsibilities:
  • Working alongside core development teams to design cloud deployment architectures on Azure.

  • Assisting development teams to build continuous integration and deployment pipelines using toolsets selected for the particular technology stack.
  • Carrying out scheduled software releases in partnership with development teams where full automation has not yet been achieved.
  • Configuring monitoring and alerting tools, and integrate into support desk software.
  • Providing technical assistance to support ticket triaging and troubleshooting, while verifying the symptoms, impact and responsibility for further investigation.
  • Actively participating in the diagnosis and remedy of reactive support issues during business hours and on a shared on-call after hours basis.

  • Monitoring incident progress, and communicating status updates to clients.
  • Designing and implementing proactive continuous improvement programmes for our solutions to minimise the occurrence of support issues.
  • Automating first. When a task recurs, you build the automation rather than repeat it.
  • Documenting, with AI-assistance, system architecture and configuration/ deployment processes; proactively sharing technical knowledge with support developers across multiple teams.

    • Skills & Experience Required:
  • Previous experience as a Site/Systems Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer or equivalent role.
  • Agentic-first: you are very comfortable using AI to diagnose, script, automate and document, and to work within an AI-assisted delivery pipeline. This is central to the role.
  • Expertise developing scalable web applications.
  • Some proficiency in Rust, Java, .NET or Go. Experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, ReactJS, AngularJS or similar front-end frameworks.
  • Proven scripting experience using PowerShell, Ruby, Python, shell or other common scripting languages, including the use of AI tools to help construct these.
  • Strong experience in Microsoft Azure deployment architectures, Microsoft DevOps deployment pipelines, GitHub Actions, and Terraform.
  • System administration of Linux cloud-based server environments.

  • Good judgement about when to trust an AI-generated diagnosis and when to verify by hand.
  • A strong desire to learn and up-skill.
  • You must be Auckland based for this role. We offer a hybrid working model (working from home and working on-site), however office attendance is currently required three days per week on our dedicated teams in-office days, and occasionally as needed due to client and team requirements.

    • About Propellerhead:

    Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    How We Build Software:

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the future of music teaching in London

Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair, Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London.

We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice.

You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week.

About Matchspace Music

Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place.

Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London.

What you’ll do

As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll:

  • Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks.

  • Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice.

  • Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team.

  • Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch.

  • Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community.

This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week, starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments.

What you’ll bring

We’d like to hear from musicians who:

  • Are actively connected to London’s music community.

  • Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works.

  • Enjoy meeting people and feel comfortable starting conversations.

  • Can share thoughtful, constructive feedback.

  • Want to help shape how we launch in London.

  • Can commit four hours per week for six months.

A student or recent graduate of a London conservatoire, we’re starting conversations at RAM, RCM, Guildhall and Trinity Laban, and welcome ambitious musicians from across the city, in any discipline: strings, piano, voice, jazz, composition and beyond.

What you’ll get

  • Paid participation: £25 per hour.

  • Flexible scheduling around your studies or other commitments.

  • Direct access to the founder and opportunities to contribute to product discussions.

  • A voice in the UK launch, helping us understand and respond to musicians’ needs.

  • Lasting recognition as a founding ambassador.

title: Operations Agent – Call Center & Kundenservice (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind ein innovatives PropTech-Team aus Bonn und kümmern uns um etwas, das in Deutschland noch erstaunlich analog ist: Wer eine Immobilie kauft, verkauft oder finanziert, braucht Unterlagen von Ämtern, zum Beispiel Grundbuchauszug, Bauakte oder Baulastenauskunft. Die liegen bei vielen hundert Behörden, und jede tickt anders. Manches geht digital, vieles nur per Telefon, Mail, Fax oder Post.

DocEstate sorgt dafür, dass die Unterlagen vollständig und pünktlich ankommen. Digital, wo es geht. Mit Menschen, die dranbleiben, wo es nicht geht. Unsere Kunden sind vor allem Investoren, Wohnungsunternehmen, Hausverwaltungen und Kanzleien.

Deine Aufgaben

Behörden melden sich nicht immer von selbst. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Auskünfte trotzdem ankommen.

  • Du rufst bei Ämtern an, fragst nach dem Stand einer Anfrage und findest heraus, wer wirklich zuständig ist.

  • Du schreibst Nachfragen und Erinnerungen per Mail oder Fax, sachlich und so, dass sie bearbeitet werden.

  • Du klärst Rückfragen und sorgst dafür, dass fehlende Angaben schnell nachgereicht werden.

  • Du hältst jeden Kontakt in unserem System fest und behältst Fristen und offene Vorgänge im Blick.

  • Du merkst, wo es im Ablauf immer wieder hakt, und bringst Ideen ein, wie es besser geht.

  • Darüber hinaus sprichst du situativ auch direkt mit unseren Kunden, wenn es Rückfragen zu ihren Anfragen gibt.

So sieht dein Alltag wirklich aus

  • Viel Telefon: Behörden erreichst du am besten vormittags, etwa zwischen 8 und 12 Uhr. Das ist deine Zeit, unser Team mit deinen Skills nach vorne zu bringen.

  • Rund um die Telefonzeit schreibst du Nachfragen, dokumentierst und bereitest die nächsten Anrufe vor, so wie du das für richtig hältst.

  • Behörden sind nicht immer schnell. Manchmal wirst du zum dritten Mal vertröstet. Wer gern Dinge gründlich zu Ende bringt, ist hier richtig.

  • Du bearbeitest viele Vorgänge parallel. Ordnung im Kopf und mit System sind wichtigste Werkzeuge für dich.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast Bock, anzupacken, und willst Dinge erledigt sehen, nicht nur verwaltet.

  • Du drückst dich klar aus, am Telefon und schriftlich. Deine Mails können ohne aufwendige Nachbearbeitung rausgehen.

  • Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1).

  • Du bleibst freundlich, auch beim dritten Anruf zum selben Vorgang.

descriptionHtml:

title: Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Isembard

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Die Rolle

Steuere den Betrieb in Hamburg: von der Bestellung bis zur Auslieferung. Termin, Durchsatz, Material. Heute zwei Maschinen, im April sieben. Dazu Partnerfabriken der Gilde und Lieferanten, die uns nicht gehören. Du entscheidest, welcher Auftrag auf welcher Maschine liegt, was nach draußen geht und was wir zusagen.

Zerspanung, Engineering und Qualität sind eigene Teams auf Augenhöhe. Du führst sie nicht, du arbeitest mit ihnen. Dein Bereich ist Fertigungssteuerung, Wareneingang und Warenausgang, und du berichtest an den Head of Operations. Passend für jemanden, der einen Plan lieber verantwortet als kommentiert.

Was du verantwortest

  • Liefertreue und Durchsatz: Reihenfolge und Belegung über alle Maschinen, geplant in MasonOS.

  • Liefertermine setzen und halten, auch bei Schnellanfragen: Angebot in 12 Stunden, Lieferung in 3 Wochen.

  • Wareneingang, Warenausgang und Materialfluss, von Stangen und Rohteilen bis zum versendeten Teil.

  • Arbeit an Partnerfabriken der Gilde und qualifizierte Lieferanten routen und sie auf unserem Standard halten.

  • Taktzeiten, Auslastung, Ausschuss und Liefertreue: wöchentlich berichtet und abgestellt, nicht gesammelt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Operative Führung in der Produktion: hohes Tempo, lange Durchlaufzeiten, kleine Lose.

  • Termin- und Kapazitätsplanung selbst gemacht, nicht delegiert.

  • Lieferanten und Unterauftragnehmer gesteuert, inklusive Eskalation.

  • Du denkst in Systemen: Kapazität, Restriktionen, Reihenfolge, Durchsatz.

  • Deutsch und Englisch sicher: Die Halle läuft auf Deutsch, die Gruppe auf Englisch.

Schön wäre

  • Zerspanung oder ein anderes spanendes Verfahren.

  • EN 9100 oder ISO 9001.

  • Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung oder Energie.

  • Aufbau einer neuen Linie oder eines zweiten Standorts.

  • ERP oder MES, Lean oder Theory of Constraints.

Warum Isembard

  • Den Plan einer Fabrik verantworten, die schnell wächst.

  • Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Abläufe prägen, nach denen unsere deutschen Standorte arbeiten.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Equity.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg, täglich in der Halle.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

title: OT Network Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

ju:niz Energy entwickelt, baut und betreibt netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher in ganz Deutschland. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz, schaffen Flexibilität und ermöglichen den weiteren Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien. Wir investieren in unsere Batteriespeicherprojekte und behalten diese langfristig im eigenen Bestand.

Als OT Network Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass die Netzwerke und Infrastruktur unserer Batteriespeicheranlagen zuverlässig und sicher funktionieren. Gemeinsam mit unserem OT-Team betreibst du die technische Infrastruktur, sicherst die Kommunikation zwischen den Systemen und unterstützt die Anbindung neuer Anlagen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreibst und wartest unsere OT-nahen Infrastrukturkomponenten – von Netzwerken und Servern bis zu Endgeräten und Backup-Systemen.
  • Beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer OT-Netzwerke gestaltest du die Architektur, setzt Netzwerksegmentierung und DMZ-Konzepte um und sorgst für sichere Schnittstellen zwischen IT und OT.
  • Firewalls und Remote-Access-Lösungen administrierst du so, dass Fernzugriffe kontrolliert erfolgen und die Sicherheitsgrenzen unserer Systeme eingehalten werden.
  • Die sichere Anbindung von Edge- und IoT-Komponenten sowie das Endpoint Management im OT-Umfeld liegen ebenfalls in deinem Aufgabenbereich.
  • Gemeinsam mit unserem Cyber-Security-Team setzt du technische Standards, Systemhärtungen und ein abgestimmtes Patch-Management um.
  • Bei Störungen in Netzwerk, SCADA oder Energiemanagementsystemen analysierst du die Ursachen und koordinierst die Behebung in enger Abstimmung mit dem Digital OT Lead und dem OT-Team.
  • Neue Standorte und Anlagen begleitest du beim Infrastruktur-Rollout und unterstützt ihre Einbindung in unsere bestehende OT-Landschaft.
  • Durch eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation und einheitliche Konfigurationen schaffst du die Grundlage für einen verlässlichen Betrieb und die weitere Standardisierung unserer Infrastruktur.
  • Mit unseren Managed-Services-Partnern und dem Cyber-Security-Team arbeitest du bei Monitoring und Incident Response eng zusammen.

Dein Profil

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-/OT-Umfeld bildet die Grundlage deiner Qualifikation.
  • Im Betrieb von Netzwerk-, Server- und OT-Infrastruktur hast du bereits mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung gesammelt.
  • OT-Netzwerke, Netzwerksegmentierung und die sichere Integration von IT und OT gehören zu deinen fachlichen Stärken.
  • Mit der Administration von Firewalls und Remote-Access-Lösungen bist du vertraut.
  • Kenntnisse im Endpoint Management mit Microsoft Intune sowie im Microsoft-365-Umfeld sind von Vorteil.
  • Technische Probleme gehst du strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an; dabei behältst du die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit der Systeme im Blick.
  • Für Rollouts und technische Einsätze bringst du die Bereitschaft mit, zu unseren Anlagenstandorten zu reisen.
  • Für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team bist du regelmäßig für zwei bis drei Tage vor Ort in unserem Büro in Aschheim bei München.
  • Auf Deutsch(mindestens C2) und Englisch kannst du dich im Arbeitsalltag und zu technischen Themen gut verständigen.

Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung im Anlagenbetrieb: Deine Arbeit trägt unmittelbar zur sicheren Kommunikation und zuverlässigen Verfügbarkeit unserer Batteriespeicher bei.
  • Technischer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entwickelst unsere OT-Infrastruktur weiter und bringst eigene Lösungen für Standards, Sicherheit und Betrieb ein.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit: Im Austausch mit dem OT-Team, Cyber Security und externen Servicepartnern bearbeitest du technische Herausforderungen gemeinsam.
  • Beitrag zur Energiewende: Du arbeitest an der Infrastruktur von Anlagen, die das Stromnetz stabilisieren und erneuerbare Energien besser nutzbar machen.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

title: PMT Architect (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Central Systems Engineering and Processes, Methods, and Tools (PMT) team establishes the overarching systems engineering framework, technical guidelines, requirements guidance, and software toolchains used by project-specific engineering teams. We act as the central entity for standardization, ensuring all project-specific teams have the tools and methodologies required for efficient, compliant development.

YOUR MISSION

As the PMT Architect, you will be the lead architect driving the definition, governance, and rollout of our centralized Processes, Methods, and Tools (PMT) framework. You will design the foundational engineering lifecycle, integrate cutting-edge software toolchains, and standardize global engineering practices. In this role, you will bridge central methodology with execution, providing direct technical, process, and PLM guidance to embedded project teams and Configuration Managers across all active programs. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Process Architecture: Define and evolve end-to-end V-model development lifecycles to ensure consistency and compliance across all programs. 
  • Engineering Methods: Establish scalable organizational guidelines and standard practices, incorporating Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE). 
  • Toolchain Integration: Drive the integration, optimization, and governance of multi-disciplinary engineering software tools (3DEXPERIENCE, JAMA…) across the product development lifecycle. 
  • PLM & Configuration Support: Act as the central PLT expert (e.g., 3DEXPERIENCE) and technical anchor for project-embedded Configuration Managers. 
  • Enablement & Adoption: Partner with project leads to ensure smooth deployment, adoption, and daily operation of central engineering standards. 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • At least 3–5 years of experience in a Systems Engineering, PMT, or Engineering Toolchain role within complex product development environments 
  • Hands-on experience working within the V-Model product development lifecycle and MBSE methodologies. 
  • Strong working knowledge of enterprise PLM platforms (such as 3DEXPERIENCE / 3Dx) specifically for defining and managing end-to-end product specifications and configuration workflows. 

NICE TO HAVE

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate central technical guidance into actionable operational practices.
  • Are collaborative, problem-solver, and a confident communicator capable of driving consensus among diverse teams. 

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

  • Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

  • Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

  • Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently.

  • Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling

  • Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale.

About you

  • Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus.

  • Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling.

  • The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last

  • Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team.

  • A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job.

  • Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments.

  • Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment.

  • Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
