title: Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.

The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.
  • Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.
  • Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.
  • Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.
  • Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.
  • A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.
  • Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.
  • You can explain how tool calls and their results flow through each iteration, how context grows across turns and how you manage it, and how the loop decides to stop.
  • Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.
  • Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.
  • Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.
  • Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.
  • Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.
  • A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.
  • Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.
  • Practical Elasticsearch experience.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

Marketplace Highlights

  • Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

  • A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

  • Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

The Opportunity

As a Principal Economist at Relay, you'll:

  • Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

  • Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

  • Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

  • Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

  • Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

  • Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

  • Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

  • Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

  • Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Principal Engineer - Classical Cryptography & Architecture
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1892 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.

Responsibilities:

You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). You will define the hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.

  • Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical/PQC hybrid schemes
  • Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.

You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)
  • Practical knowledge of hybrid classical/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards

Preferred Qualifications:

You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.

What We Offer:

  • A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world
  • A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence
  • Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career
  • Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track
  • A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies
  • A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts
  • A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
 
We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
descriptionHtml:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

title: Product Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Product Marketing Lead

Reporting to: CMO

Location: London (hybrid, 4 days a week in the office)

Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + equity

About Electric Twin

Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence - a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. We build synthetic audiences: simulations of real groups of people, grounded in research data. Teams ask them questions, test ideas and explore how people might respond, and get answers in minutes that would otherwise take weeks.

The work is grounded, and the science is real. We've run over 40,000 evaluations across populations covering 155 countries. Independent academic research with Professor Michael Muthukrishna at the LSE found our outputs come back roughly 10,000x faster than traditional methods, at 95% accuracy. Customers including The Times, Sage, Virgin, Vodafone and Wingstop use Electric Twin to bring customer insight into decisions about campaigns, products, pricing and strategy.

Electric Twin was founded by Dr Ben Warner (former Chief Data Advisor to the UK Prime Minister) and our CEO, Alex Cooper (a former senior military commander and Director of Mass Covid Testing in the pandemic). We're backed by Atomico, LocalGlobe, Mercuri and angels including Marc Andreessen. We're a team of engineers, AI researchers, behavioural scientists and operators - careful with the science, careful with the responsibility.

The role

We're hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing at Electric Twin, from the strategy through to the sales deck.

Our ambition is to make understanding people a normal part of making decisions. Product marketing is central to that. It's how we decide who Electric Twin is for, what we compete against and why a buyer should choose us, and how that story reaches the market through our product, our website and our sales team.

Next year is a big one. We're launching in new markets, taking Electric Twin to more parts of a business, and bringing more products to market. We need someone who has operated at this level before, and who can join the dots between sales, marketing and product.

Product marketing here covers four areas: insights, storytelling, go-to-market and enablement. You'll own all four, and decide where to lean in as the company grows.

You'll work closely with our CMO, our VP Product and our sales team. Our Growth Lead runs the engine - the channels and programmes that reach and convert our audience. Product marketing and content provide the fuel. You'll own positioning and messaging. Our Content Lead will turn it into stories and get them out across every channel.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, and you'll also write the launch plan, the value proposition brief and the sales deck yourself.

What’s exciting - you’re the founding PMM and get to build out and lead this function as we expand.

What you'll do

Insights

  • Be the expert on our customer. We have strong customer research, a map of what customers want to use the product for and a regular round-up of the questions they ask. Build on it, keep it current and make sure the rest of the business uses it.

  • Understand the buyers we're growing into. Our buyer today is the insights team. Marketing, product and commercial teams come next. Speak to them, define who they are and work out what they need to hear from us.

  • Know the market. This is a fast-moving category, with research incumbents launching their own products and a new batch of innovators arriving. Track it, and keep a clear, committed point of view on how Electric Twin is different.

  • Bring an opinion to product strategy. Work with our VP Product on the value proposition, and bring the customer and the market into decisions about what we build.

Storytelling

  • Own our positioning and messaging. Keep one consistent way of describing what Electric Twin is, who it is for and why a buyer should choose it, used by sales, product and marketing.

  • Own the trust story. Trust is central to how buyers choose us. Own how we prove it: the evidence, the customer stories and the guidance for prospects who want to evaluate us for themselves.

  • Turn the product into language a buyer would use. Take what we build and describe it in the customer's words, across the website, the product and our sales materials.

  • Shape the story for new markets and buyers. Build and adjust the narrative for our new market launches, and for the teams beyond insight and research that we want to reach.

Go-to-market

  • Set the product narrative. Agree a product narrative each quarter with our VP Product, so every launch adds up to a bigger story.

  • Run our launches. Build a tiered launch process so the effort matches the size of the release, and run it with product, sales and marketing.

  • Take Electric Twin to new buyers and markets. Plan how we go to market in the US, in new verticals and with new teams inside our customers.

  • Improve the buyer journey on our website. Work with growth, content and design so the site shows the product and has something for visitors who aren't yet ready to talk to sales.

Enablement

  • Equip our sales team. A sales deck built on our positioning, battlecards for the alternatives that come up most, ROI material for the economic buyer and a pack our champions can take to their senior stakeholders.

  • Build a working relationship with sales. Agree priorities together, with one route in for requests and a short brief for each.

  • Train sales and CX. Run onboarding and regular training on our positioning, product, use cases and objection handling, so both teams can explain our value and help customers get the most from Electric Twin.

  • Build feedback loops across teams. Create regular workflows that bring sales objections, win/loss insights and CX feedback into product priorities, positioning and enablement. Take updates back to those teams and check whether they solve the problems raised.

  • Be an advocate inside the business. Present to the company, and represent the customer and the product in the conversations that matter. You need to be the central point between Sales, Marketing and Product and drive the strategy proactively to each - ultimately for the benefit of the customer.

  • Build our product marketing operating system. Bring our research, positioning and messaging into one managed source of truth that feeds the tools used across product, sales, customer success and internal comms. Use AI to build repeatable workflows on top of it and keep it updated.

Your first six months

  • Take our positioning and messaging and get it into the website, sales enablement and our core external-facing materials.

  • Agree the first quarterly product narrative with our VP Product, and get a tiered launch process running.

  • Rebuild sales enablement, with battlecards, ROI material and a pack for champions.

  • Define the marketing buyer and build the narrative for our new market launches.

  • Get the product marketing operating system up and running.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • At least five years in product marketing alone. You've done this role before, ideally growing a product in a similar space or selling to an enterprise audience.

  • You've owned positioning and messaging, and taken it through to a website and sales materials that people used.

  • You've run product launches with a product team, and worked closely with a sales team on what they need to win deals.

  • You've partnered with senior product and commercial leaders, and you're as comfortable having an opinion on product strategy as on sales and commercial strategy.

  • You understand the tools and techniques of the trade, including Jobs-to-be-done and know how to define messaging and positioning.

Skills and approach

  • Autonomous. You can own the strategy and ship the copy without much steering. .

  • A good writer, and strong at the content specific to product marketing, such as sales decks and value proposition briefs.

  • A strong communicator. You can present internally and be an advocate for the customer and the product.

  • Curious and proactive. You know what you don't know, you read up or ask for help, and you act on problems once you've spotted them.

  • You've used AI to build repeatable workflows, and you can judge when the output is good enough and when it isn't.

  • You can operate in a fast-paced environment that has ambiguity.

  • You work with a sense of urgency, you raise issues as they arise and you anticipate problems

  • Careful with the details. You're comfortable getting to grips with AI, research and technical subjects, you ask good questions and you check claims carefully.

What we offer

  • £80,000-£100,000 base

  • Meaningful equity in a high-potential seed-stage company

  • Unlimited leave. Take the time you need

  • Generous matched pension contributions

  • Private healthcare

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Ownership of product marketing, with real influence over how the function is built

  • Direct access to and collaboration with world-class founders

  • Hybrid working from our London office (4 days in office a week)

  • Flexible working around life commitments. We value outcomes over presenteeism

When you apply, please share examples of your product marketing work, such as positioning, a launch or sales materials, explaining your contribution and what it achieved.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner

Almere | 32-40 uur per week

Als Product Owner bij Infomedics ben jij de brug tussen business en IT. Je vertaalt ideeën en wensen van stakeholders naar concrete oplossingen die onze IT-services verbeteren. Met jouw werk draag je direct bij aan efficiëntere en veiligere processen in de zorg. Jij zorgt ervoor dat ontwikkelteams helder hebben waaraan gewerkt wordt en waarom, en dat onze IT-services toekomstbestendig en klantgericht blijven.

Wat ga je doen als Product Owner?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van de digitale strategie naar concrete producten en IT-oplossingen. Je begeleidt ontwikkelteams, bewaakt kwaliteit, en houdt stakeholders continu op de hoogte. Zo lever je direct impact op de organisatie en de kwaliteit van zorg die onze klanten kunnen bieden.

Wat zijn je belangrijkste taken/verantwoordelijkheden?

  • Ontwikkelteams faciliteren met duidelijke acceptatiecriteria en begeleiden van sprints (definition of ready).

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wie ben jij, en wat breng je mee?

  • Afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding relevant voor IT/management.

  • Ervaring met nearshore/offshore teams en softwareontwikkelmethoden zoals DevOps, Agile/Scrum, Microsoft Azure.

Infomedics is onderdeel van de MSPS Groep B.V. dat staat voor Medical Software & Processing Services. De groep bestaat uit bedrijven die samen de zorg efficiënter en menselijker maken. title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
descriptionHtml:
Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt.

We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.

Het team en de uitdaging
Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.

Hoe we werken
12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.

Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:

  • Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

  • PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.

  • Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.



De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.

  • Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.

  • Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.

  • Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?

  • Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.

  • Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.

  • Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.

  • Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.


Over 12Build
Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”

Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan?


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal vier jaar ervaring in B2B SaaS en een goed gevoel voor product. Dat kan als productmanager, of in een aanverwante rol van waaruit je de stap wilt maken. Eerdere ervaring met een marktplaats of een workflowproduct met veel documenten is een plus.

  • Je hebt eerder een productvisie en -strategie opgesteld en de mensen om je heen erin meegekregen.

  • Je kunt goed met mensen. Je bouwt snel vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega’s, luistert goed en brengt mensen met verschillende belangen samen achter één richting.

  • Technisch begrip. Je hebt nauw samengewerkt met developers, kent de gangbare termen en praat op niveau mee in een discussie met de lead developer.

  • Je denkt in data. Je voelt je thuis in productanalyse (Amplitude of vergelijkbaar), je kunt een experiment opzetten en je weet wanneer een getal te zwak is om een besluit op te baseren.

  • Praktijkervaring met agentic werken. Je gebruikt tools als Claude of Codex voor meer dan chatten, je hebt eigen workflows of skills gebouwd en je kunt ons er een laten zien. Je inspireert collega’s om anders te werken.

  • Je beoordeelt kritisch wat agents opleveren en staat achter wat onder jouw naam live gaat.

  • Je maakt je een nieuw domein snel eigen. Ervaring in de bouw helpt. Nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Wat bieden we?

  • Je kiest je eigen hardware: Windows, Mac of Linux.

  • Je werkt thuis en op kantoor. Voor de thuiswerkdagen krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Elke dag een gratis lunch op kantoor.

  • Een cultuur waar we echt in investeren, met teamdagen, uitjes, sprekers en workshops.

  • Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen.

title: Projekt Manager/in B2B SaaS (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:

Die ParkEfficient GmbH ist ein wachsendes B2B-Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Digitalisierung des Parkraum- und Arbeitsplatzmanagements spezialisiert hat.

Mit unseren SaaS-Lösungen ParkEfficient und OfficeEfficient unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Büro- und Parkflächen effizienter zu nutzen, Prozesse zu automatisieren und moderne Arbeitsumgebungen zu gestalten.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören führende Banken, Versicherungen und eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen, vom deutschen Mittelstand bis hin zu DAX-Unternehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit im Projektmanagement, die unsere Kunden bei der Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen begleitet und Implementierungsprojekte eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg führt.

Deine Aufgaben

Dabei übernimmst du insbesondere folgende Aufgaben:

  • Projektmanagement: Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst die Einführung unserer SaaS-Lösungen bei neuen Kunden – von der Projektinitialisierung bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.

  • Projektübergabe: Nach erfolgreicher Implementierung sorgst du für eine strukturierte Übergabe an unser Customer-Support- und Customer-Success-Team.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast idealerweise 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Softwareimplementierung, im IT-Consulting oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Tätigkeit.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und denkst lösungsorientiert.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Office- und Kollaborationstools wie Microsoft Teams und Microsoft 365.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Spannende Kundenprojekte: Du begleitest die Einführung unserer Software bei namhaften Unternehmen und erhältst Einblicke in unterschiedlichste Organisationen.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Projekte und kannst deine Arbeit aktiv gestalten.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest in einem engagierten Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direkter Kommunikation.

  • Metrology & Tool Matching Support: Assist engineers with metrology tool gating, tool matching activities, and quality verification tasks.

  • Knowledge Transfer: Train junior team members and provide first-level support to internal users regarding the document management system.

Your profile

Must Have  

  • Completed 3-year vocational training (e.g., as a Chemical Laboratory Technician / Chemielaborant, CTA, PTA, Physics Technician, or a comparable technical/scientific background).

  • Solid computer literacy, including intermediate skills in Microsoft Office (especially MS Excel for data evaluation).
  • Structured, detail-oriented working style with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a dynamic operations environment.
  • Willingness to complete a ~6-month hands-on training program in Taiwan during your onboarding to build core competencies and an international network.
  • Fluent English skills (written and spoken); basic German communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Basic knowledge of Mandarin is an asset.


Reasons to join ESMC
  • Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.

Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data. Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half. Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors. The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration. Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security. With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users.

About The Role

Due to significant growth and to address the evolving needs of our QA team, we are seeking a Quality Engineer.

You will join a structured QA community of about half a dozen engineers based across France and the United States, allowing you to share best practices and grow technically with your international peers. On a daily basis, you will be fully integrated into an Agile Product squad, working hand-in-hand with developers and product managers. You will report directly to the Manager of the Quality Engineering team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Test Case Design & Execution: Design comprehensive and efficient test cases based on product requirements and user stories. Execute tests (both manual and automated) to ensure product quality and functionality meet our high defined standards.

  • Test Automation: Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts to ensure long-term efficiency and scalability in our testing processes.

  • Collaboration & Leadership: Act as a leadership driving force within your squad. You will actively lead the collaboration between the Product Manager (PM) and Developers to define, clarify, and prioritize quality and testability requirements from the very start.

  • Bug Tracking & Analysis: Identify, document, and track defects in Jira, and work with the engineering team to prioritize and resolve them.

  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to streamline the release process.

  • Quality Culture: Act as an internal advocate for QA best practices, helping the whole team maintain high standards.

  • Participation in Agile Ceremonies: Actively contribute to all agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring a strong quality mindset throughout the development cycle.


    • Required Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Engineering degree or Master’s degree with 7 years of experience in a technical QA or development field.

title: Recruiter – Content, Netzwerk & Kandidatengewinnung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden.

Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben.

Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach.

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

descriptionHtml:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About this role:

We're hiring an Accounting Operations Manager to own the operational core of fal's finance function: payables, spend management, procurement, and the books of our subsidiaries. You will work in Pacific Standard Time zone, run the weekly cadence that keeps vendors paid and spend under control, and you will turn the processes behind it into documented, audit-ready controls as fal completes its first financial statement audit and moves to a new ERP.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building processes as much as running it.

What you’ll do

Spend management and AP oversight

  • Own Ramp administration and allocate and oversee workload carried by offshore supporting AP team

  • Act as the first point of contact for employee and vendor questions on spend, declined transactions, and payment status.

  • Review card transactions and reimbursements for policy compliance, receipt support, GL coding, and accrual cut-off, and follow up on exceptions until they close.

  • Run the weekly payables cycle end to end: invoice intake, matching to PO and receipt, GL and department coding, and approval routing.

  • Maintain the vendor master, including W-9 collection, bank-detail changes verified by call-back, and controls against payment fraud.

  • Prepare the weekly payment batch with a cash-requirements summary for finance leadership approval.

Procurement and purchase orders

  • Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Ops on scalable procurement processes, including approval thresholds by amount, department, and vendor risk.

  • Partner with Legal and budget owners so contracts, POs, and invoices tie out before payment.

Subsidiary accounting and intercompany

  • Keep the books for fal's subsidiaries under US GAAP, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and monthly close.

  • Record, settle, and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances each month.

  • Prepare elimination entries and support consolidation of entity financials.

  • Bring acquired entities onto fal's chart of accounts, close calendar, and control environment.

Audit readiness and systems

  • Document process narratives and controls for AP, treasury, and procurement, and prepare the evidence auditors request.

  • Help configure AP, procurement, and intercompany workflows in fal's new ERP.

  • Use AI tools and automation to remove manual steps from invoice processing, coding, and reconciliations.

1099 reporting, tax and close support

  • Own 1099 readiness year-round: vendor classification, TIN matching, and complete W-9 and W-8 files.

  • Prepare, review, and approve annual 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC filings, and handle corrections and IRS notices.

  • Support Tax function on ad hoc basis, including sales and use tax, and property tax.

  • Support the month end close process, including but not limited to reconciliations of prepaids, deposits, payables, accruals.

Qualifications/Nice-to-haves

  • 5+ years in accounting operations, accounts payable, or general accounting

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • Hands-on experience running AP and spend management in Ramp, Brex, or Bill.com, integrated with an ERP.

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Exposure to foreign subsidiaries, multi-currency accounting, or post-acquisition integration.

  • Direct experience preparing and filing 1099s.

  • A track record of designing internal controls: segregation of duties, approval matrices, and audit evidence.

  • Precise and organized, and comfortable owning a recurring cadence with hard deadlines.

  • Clear written communication with vendors, employees, and auditors.

  • Fluency with AI tools and workflow automation to scale finance operations.

  • Experience at a venture-backed, high-growth technology company, ideally through a first audit.

  • CPA, or progress toward licensure.

About the team

The Customer Success Architect team focuses on hands-on technical enablement, adoption, utilization, and maturity of the GitLab DevSecOps platform while maintaining strong, consultative customer relationships and business alignment. You’ll work as part of a globally distributed, all-remote team that collaborates asynchronously with Customer Success Managers, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support to act as a trusted advisor for customers. title: Senior Field Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Field Product Engineer, you will work directly with customers to help them adopt, integrate, and get value from Radiant’s cloud platform.

You’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, solutions, and the customer, working hands-on across APIs, infrastructure, integrations, developer tooling, and production workloads.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing role focused on solving real problems in the field, accelerating deployments, and feeding product insight directly back into the platform.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work directly with customers on technical discovery, onboarding, integration, and deployment.

  • Build prototypes, integrations, tooling, and reference implementations to unblock customer use cases.

  • Translate customer requirements and field feedback into clear product and engineering priorities.

  • Support complex workloads across compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, identity, and platform services.

  • Investigate and resolve technical friction across APIs, SDKs, automation, and infrastructure.

  • Partner with product and engineering on product gaps, usability issues, and new platform capabilities.

  • Create reusable solutions, documentation, examples, and best practices from customer engagements.

  • Support proofs of concept, technical evaluations, and early deployments.

  • Help ensure successful customer outcomes while avoiding one-off solutions that do not scale.

Qualifications:

  • Strong software or infrastructure engineering experience, ideally in cloud, platform engineering, developer tooling, or distributed systems.

  • Comfortable working directly with technical customers in high-trust environments.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, containers

    • Developer tooling: APIs, SDKs, CLIs, automation

    • Platform engineering: provisioning, IAM, observability, reliability

    • Distributed systems: failure handling, retries, queues, scaling

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application and infrastructure layers.

  • Comfortable moving from an ambiguous customer problem to a working technical solution quickly.

  • Able to identify what should become product, what should remain integration work, and what should not be built.

  • Strong communication skills and able to work effectively across customers, product, and engineering.

What you bring:

  • Customer empathy: You understand what customers are trying to achieve, not just what they ask for.

  • Builder mindset: You solve problems with working software.

  • Product instinct: You turn recurring field problems into scalable product improvements.

  • Technical breadth: You can move comfortably across APIs, infrastructure, and application workflows.

  • Pragmatism: You know when to prototype, when to productionise, and when not to build.

  • Ownership: You stay close to the problem from discovery through deployment and adoption.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously.

What You’ll Do

Product Development Support

  • Own the roadmap for one or more product lines (e.g., DeepPSMA, SelectPSMA, TrackPSMA), balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and business value.

  • Engage directly with clinicians, nuclear medicine physicians, and oncologists to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria.

  • Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision.

  • Navigate the regulatory landscape (FDA, CE marking) as a stakeholder, you do not need to be a regulatory expert, but you must understand how regulatory requirements shape product decisions and timelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, AI/ML, clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders, keeping a small team moving fast without sacrificing quality.

  • Contribute to go-to-market strategy, positioning, and customer enablement alongside commercial and clinical teams.

Analytics & Insights

  • Define and track meaningful product metrics; use data and user feedback to inform iteration and prioritization decisions.


What You Bring

  • 3-6 years of product management experience in a B2B or technical environment building products for specialized, professional users (not purely consumer products).

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex products where the user base has deep domain expertise, e.g., enterprise software, developer tools, scientific instruments, industrial platforms, or similar.

  • Strong conceptual and systems thinking. You can see the big picture, connect disparate inputs into a coherent product thesis, and reason about second-order effects. You don't just execute, you think.

  • Startup or high-growth experience. You have worked in an environment where speed, ambiguity, and wearing multiple hats were the norm, not the exception.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can write clearly, present a compelling argument, and facilitate productive discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort with technical depth. You do not need to write code, but you should be able to engage meaningfully with engineers and data scientists on architecture, data, and tradeoff discussions.

  • Intellectual curiosity and learning agility. You pick up new domains quickly and enjoy becoming a quasi-expert in areas you previously knew nothing about.

  • Fluency in English (native or professional proficiency required - C1 level or higher)

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare, medtech, health-AI, or a regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with medical imaging, oncology workflows, or clinical decision support.

  • Experience working with AI/ML-driven products where model behavior shapes the user experience.

  • Exposure to FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking processes for software as a medical device (SaMD).

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation.
