Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

When a customer pushes a change, they need their CI/CD jobs to start quickly and run reliably, even when demand spikes. You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.

As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you'll set technical direction across teams while continuing to write and operate production software in Go. You'll lead work across the runner control plane, worker provisioning, and job execution. Your primary focus will be GitLab.com, and you'll also provide technical leadership support for GitLab Dedicated Hosted Runners. You'll report to the engineering manager responsible for Hosted Runners.

Some examples of our projects:
  • Tuning autoscaling to reduce job wait times during demand spikes
  • Evaluating ways to isolate customer workloads
  • Improving how runner usage is measured for capacity planning and billing
What You'll Do
  • Lead architecture and delivery across teams. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.
  • Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.
  • Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.
  • Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.
  • Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.
  • Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.
  • Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.
What You'll Bring
  • Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. You've personally shipped code that handles challenges such as concurrency, retries, or resource cleanup.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or another systems language, with the ability to become productive in Go.
  • Deep Linux and networking knowledge. You can trace production failures across system layers and use measurements to validate fixes.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes in production, including diagnosing scheduling and resource issues and managing rollouts and recovery.
  • Experience building or operating autoscaled or dynamically scheduled compute, such as VM fleets, serverless platforms, or batch systems. You bring experience with public cloud and infrastructure automation or comparable fleet operations.
  • A working understanding of the CI job lifecycle and the implications of running customer-controlled code. You can bring that knowledge from outside a CI/CD team.
  • A record of leading technical initiatives across teams and personally contributing to implementation through production. You build agreement through clear writing and asynchronous collaboration, and mentor engineers to own what they build and operate.
About the team

Hosted Runners operates the compute behind customers' CI/CD jobs. You'll work with Runner Core to turn lessons from operating the fleet into improvements to the open-source GitLab Runner. You'll also work with Product and partner teams to agree on priorities and ownership for shared changes.

title: Software Engineer (Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers want to spend their time with clients, not digging through the books to find out what's changed. We're building the thing that does the digging for them.

It's called the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. Ask it anything about a client and it answers from that client's actual books. Don't ask, and it tells you anyway when something important changes.

Every one of those answers sits on data. Someone has to get that data in, shape it, define it and serve it, so the number the assistant quotes is the right one. That's you. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it.

This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems.

 

What You'll Work On

  • The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices.

  • The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer.

  • The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable.

  • The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does.

  • Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't.

You'll Probably Have

  • Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config.

  • Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now.

  • Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear.

  • An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it.

  • Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner.

  • Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one.

  • A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so.

  • AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build.

  • Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for.

  • Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark, Databricks or dbt; anything that puts data in front of an LLM.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how fast you're growing than in a perfect match.

 

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

title: VP Global Demand & Delivery
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

Uforce is scaling quickly, and our order book is beginning to outgrow site-by-site planning. We are hiring a Global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) / Demand Planning Manager to own the link between what we expect to sell and what our production network can build. This is a global role by design: rather than sitting inside any one facility, you will hold the bird's-eye view across our entire network — our Portugal operations, our Poole location, and the US sites we are building out — so that demand is matched to capacity wherever it makes the most sense.

What you'll do

You will own the bookings forecast on a regular cadence (initially weekly), looking out over the next several months to a quarter. You'll translate that forecast into a granular view of expected units — by platform, by drone/vessel type, and down to the configuration level — and keep it current as deals progress, slip, or change scope. You'll work closely with Sales to pressure-test the pipeline and with Finance and leadership to make sure everyone is operating from one shared number.

With that forecast in hand, you will map incoming demand against available capacity at each site and get ahead of it. For example, if the forecast shows an order for 12 boats landing in the next two months, you'll be the one flagging it early, determining where it should be built, and working with the Portugal team (or whichever site is best placed) to plan materials, labor, and schedule well before the PO arrives. You'll identify capacity gaps and bottlenecks across the network, recommend where to load or shift work between sites, and help inform where and when we need to add capacity as the US footprint grows.

Over time, you'll build the S&OP process itself: the regular forecast and capacity review rhythm, the planning tools and dashboards that support it, and the metrics (forecast accuracy, capacity utilization, on-time delivery) that tell us whether it is working.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with experience in demand planning, S&OP, or production planning at a hardware or manufacturing company, ideally one that scaled quickly across multiple sites. You're comfortable moving between a sales pipeline and a factory floor schedule, you're strong with data and forecasting models, and you can turn an uncertain forecast into clear, early decisions that site teams can act on. You communicate well across functions and time zones, and you're energized by building a process from the ground up rather than inheriting one. Experience in high-growth environments (automotive, aerospace, defense, robotics, or similar) is a strong plus, as is comfort with travel between our sites.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

title: Research Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

Explore your future career 🔭

We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML).

Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion.

Some of the questions you might explore :

- How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions?

- What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ?

- How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior?


Key responsibilities ✨

  • Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency.

  • Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation: Formulate falsifiable economic hypotheses, design quasi-experimental and experimental setups (Diff-in-Diff, Instrumental Variables, Fixed Effects), and isolate true causal mechanisms within complex, multi-sided platform interactions.

  • External Research & Flagship Thought Leadership: Co-author Malt’s research publications as well as macroeconomic barometers in close partnership with Marketing, translating raw platform telemetry into compelling public narratives for industry leaders and tier-1 media.

  • Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, ML, Marketing, and C-Suite stakeholders to identify high-impact research questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover underlying economic mechanisms.

  • Hands-On Data Engineering & Modeling: Write clean SQL on BigQuery and engineer robust, reproducible analytical pipelines in Python, leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to maximize research velocity.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Academic Foundation: PhD (or Master's degree with equivalent proven empirical research track record) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Social Sciences, or a related empirical discipline. Strong Quantitative and Research Background

  • Empirical Econometrics & Modeling: Proven expertise in microeconomic modeling, causal inference, and empirical identification strategies (e.g., panel data, Instrumental Variables, Diff-in-Diff, selection models).

  • Applied Research Mindset: You combine scientific rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving real-world economic problems. You know how to adapt your methods and the depth of your analyses to the question at hand.

  • Hands-On Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels, SciPy) and high-level SQL on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake).

  • Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to scope ambiguous problems, communicate complex econometric findings to non-technical leaders, and constructively challenge stakeholder assumptions.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

    • If you're excited about using unique marketplace data to explore meaningful economic questions, shape real-world decisions, and contribute to a deeper understanding of the future of work, we'd love to hear from you!


    How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with Luke our Tech Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and explore a few technical topics (45 mins)

  • Interview with Marc (Director of ML), your future manager, to discuss your experience, the role in more detail and ask you a few technical questions (60 mins).

  • Research discussion with your future colleagues to walk through two pieces of work: a research project of your choice, and one proposed by us. (90 mins)

  • Take-home coding test (2 hours or optional if you have enough open source projects online)

  • Final interview (45mins) with Claire (CTO)

title: Research Engineer - Robotics RL & Post Training
descriptionHtml:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

What you will work on

  • Train and refine RL policies for contact-rich manipulation, including precise assembly, insertion, and recovery from failures.

  • Develop rewards, curricula, and reset strategies for efficient policy learning.

  • Distill specialist capabilities into generalist policies through expert-generated data, imitation learning, and teacher–student methods.

  • Investigate direct RL post-training of vision-language-action models and world-action models.

  • Build data collection, filtering, sampling, and augmentation pipelines using demonstrations, autonomous rollouts, and human corrections.

  • Build scientifically sound evaluation pipelines across simulation and real robots, measuring success, precision, speed, robustness, and recovery.

  • Design controlled experiments and ablations that isolate the effects of algorithms, data, model changes, and training budgets.

  • Diagnose and reduce sim-to-real gaps in dynamics, sensing, timing, and control.

  • Build reliable, maintainable training and evaluation software with reproducible configurations, versioned data, and traceable results.

    What we are looking for

  • Strong practical experience implementing and debugging reinforcement learning for continuous control, ideally robotic manipulation.

  • Experience with imitation learning and policy distillation or teacher–student training.

  • Strong working knowledge of ML/DL fundamentals

  • Strong software engineering skills: clear interfaces, maintainable code, meaningful tests, systematic debugging, and reliable experiment infrastructure.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch or JAX skills, with the ability to own work from research implementation through real-robot evaluation.

  • Experience designing rigorous evaluation protocols: meaningful baselines, held-out test conditions, leakage prevention, repeated trials, and appropriate uncertainty estimates.

  • First-principles thinking: the ability to question assumptions, identify underlying mechanisms, and distinguish causal evidence from correlation.

  • Experience with sim-to-real transfer and a robotics simulation stack such as MuJoCo or Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab.

  • Evidence of substantial research contributions through publications at venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR, or equivalent demonstrated research and engineering work.

    Especially relevant experience

  • RL post-training of pretrained VLAs or WAMs.

  • Distilling multiple specialists into a shared generalist while preserving existing capabilities.

  • Visual RL, privileged-information teachers, and contact-rich manipulation.

  • Offline and online RL, human-in-the-loop learning, and learning from failures.

  • Diffusion or flow-matching action policies and temporally chunked actions.

  • Distributed training and large-scale rollout collection.

    What success looks like

    Reproducible improvements in real-robot performance, supported by controlled experiments that explain what helped, where it generalizes, and where it still fails.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Research Scientist - 3D Reconstruction & Novel View Synthesis
descriptionHtml:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We’re seeking a Research Scientist to push the state of the art in 3D reconstruction. You should have command of the latest scene representations, such as Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and of reconstruction methods across the full range, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. We are looking for someone who knows the field well enough to choose the right representation and method for a problem, and then improve on it. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already done reconstruction research across more than one representation.

Responsibilities

  • Advance the state of the art in 3D reconstruction, from research ideas to working methods.

  • Work across the full range of reconstruction problems (geometry, appearance, materials, lighting and dynamics, from sparse or incomplete observations), and novel view synthesis, including neural rendering and feed-forward view generators.

  • Design losses, priors, and optimization strategies that improve fidelity, robustness, and efficiency.

  • Build rigorous evaluations on public and internal benchmarks, and use them to drive decisions.

  • Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to bring successful methods into production systems.

Key qualifications

  • PhD in computer vision, graphics, or a related field; publications at top venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS).

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of modern scene representations, for example Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and the ability to weigh their trade-offs.

  • Research experience across the reconstruction spectrum, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models.

  • Deep understanding of multi-view geometry, camera models, and rendering.

  • Strong experience with deep learning frameworks.

title: Retention and Growth Project & AI Coordinator (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Purpose of Position

Our Retention & Growth Team is responsible for two keys areas;

  1. Customer Retention – ensuring long-term continuity and sustainability of our customer base. 
  2. Portfolio Growth – expanding revenue in line with Gross Profit (GP) and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets.

This team leads the migration of customers onto new MarTech commercial models and updated contracts as part of the company’s wider business transformation.

In parallel, the team drives revenue optimisation by:

  • Upselling customers to higher-value Platform Offers or Service Packages
  • Cross-selling additional services or add-ons
  • Expanding existing customers into new markets or programmes
  • Downgrading customers to more suitable Platform Offers or Service Packages where appropriate

The R&G Project & AI Coordinator is an assistant-level role responsible for providing operational, contractual and project support to the Retention & Growth Team. 

A key focus of the position will be supporting contract reconciliation and contract management activities, ensuring that customer agreements, Salesforce records, internal approvals and supporting documentation are complete, accurate and aligned.

The role will also support the team in identifying and implementing AI-based efficiencies. This may include improving administrative processes, supporting AI initiatives, testing new ways of working and identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort across contract management, reporting, account preparation and other R&G activities.

Where appropriate, the R&G Project & AI Coordinator may attend customer calls and support commercial or contractual discussions. This will initially be alongside an R&G Manager or the R&G Team Leader, with the opportunity to take greater ownership of suitable activities as their knowledge and confidence develop.

This is a temporary maternity leave cover position. The role is intended to provide flexible support across the R&G Team, with priorities determined by current workload, team capacity and business requirements.
The position reports directly to the local R&G Team Leader, who will provide day-to-day management, training and prioritisation. The role will work closely with R&G Managers and relevant teams across Client Services, Legal, Finance, Global Business Operations, Go-to-Market, InfoSec and Technology.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the reconciliation of existing customer contracts against Salesforce records, pricing information, programme configurations and internal documentation.
  • Review contract records to identify missing agreements, amendments, approvals, signatures or supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the preparation, processing and administration of opportunities, contracts, renewals, renegotiations, upgrades, downgrades and other contractual documentation.
  • Support the identification of activities that could be simplified, accelerated or improved through AI, automation or better use of existing systems.
  • Work with the R&G Team to understand time-consuming or repetitive processes and help develop more efficient ways of completing them.
  • Support the planning and delivery of R&G projects and operational initiatives.
  • Attend customer calls where appropriate to support R&G Managers with contract, renewal or account-related discussions.
  • Support straightforward customer communications and follow-ups under the guidance of an R&G Manager or the R&G Team Leader.

  • An interest in AI, automation and process improvement, with a willingness to test and adopt new ways of working.
  • Ability to identify repetitive or inefficient processes and suggest practical improvements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using Salesforce to manage customer communications and records.
  • Comfortable engaging with internal stakeholders and participating in customer conversations where appropriate.
  • Commercial awareness and an interest in developing knowledge of customer contracts, negotiations and retention
  • Good problem-solving skills and the confidence to highlight issues or inconsistencies.
  • Able to work independently while recognising when support or escalation is required.
  • A collaborative and flexible approach, with a willingness to support different priorities across the team.
  • Affiliate marketing experience is beneficial but not essential.

As an assistant-level position, the R&G Project & AI Coordinator will not initially have independent ownership of complex negotiations, high-risk contractual decisions or material commercial approvals.
Such matters should remain with the relevant R&G Manager, R&G Team Leader, Legal or authorised approver. Responsibility may be expanded gradually for suitable activities based on experience, training and business need.


Our Offer
  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.

  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
  • Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Tebi

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets.

You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team.

This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

Build the acquisition engine

  • Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot.

  • Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity in emerging markets not yet visible in HubSpot.

  • Build outbound plays and sequencing systems for sales-led and PLG motions, and run experiments to learn how best to reach customers.

  • Prototype and improve an AI outbound assistant that saves reps time, with a human in the loop.

Build the processes and automation behind onboarding, retention and expansion

  • Design and automate the Sales-to-Onboarding handover process across our toolstack, replacing manual steps and setting milestones, ownership and service levels from signed to live, with alerts when a merchant stalls.

  • Set up the retention signals and risk alerts that matter, each routed to a clear action and owner.

  • Design the expansion framework from scratch for sales-led (Account Manager-led) and PLG (automated, in-product or lifecycle) upsell, and build the plays, sequences and automation behind it in our toolstack.

  • Measure and refine these processes against pipeline, retention and expansion outcomes, and talk to reps, Account Managers and merchants about their pain points to turn what you learn into better workflows and systems.

  • Build and maintain the integrations across our toolstack, including HubSpot, BigQuery and the enrichment and outbound tools, and document system logic so it scales with the team.

What You’ll Need

  • Around 3 or more years of relevant experience in RevOps, sales operations or customer success operations, or an equivalent role in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on experience building enrichment flows, signal tracking and outbound systems.

  • Experience in high-velocity SaaS or an agency.

  • Good knowledge of Clay and other GTM tools, such as n8n, Make, Apollo, Instantly or similar, and comfort working with APIs and webhooks.

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond admin work: workflows, lifecycle stages, properties and reporting.

  • Proven experience building workflows, sequences and lifecycle automation end to end, for both sales-led and PLG motions.

  • Experience designing and automating onboarding or handover processes, and defining health, risk and expansion signals that turn into alerts and actions.

  • The ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into plays and systems that people use in their daily work.

  • Day-to-day experience building with AI, with real workflows, agents or automations you have shipped, and a habit of testing new tools to see what works.

  • An “everything is figureoutable” mindset: you start from a blank page, ship a first version fast, learn from what happens and adapt quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, Metabase or comparable analytics tools.

  • B2B SaaS experience in a growing company where systems and processes are still being built, ideally across multiple countries or markets.

  • Familiarity with hospitality technology, POS, payments or merchant services.

  • Experience applying AI to outbound and customer success workflows, with attention to data quality and human review.

We’re looking for an operator who thinks commercially, builds with AI every day and moves fast: building from scratch, learning by testing, and helping every merchant get live quickly and grow with us.

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch in the office

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: RF Electronics Engineer (GNSS)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As an RF Engineer (GNSS) in the Hardware (Electronics) team, you will own the radionavigation architecture of our products. Our systems need high-precision navigation and robust connectivity in contested, complex environments, and you will be the expert responsible for the RF subsystems, from antenna design to integration and compliance. You will design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules, extend them towards CRPAs for GNSS-denied operations, and see each design through simulation, lab validation and flight tests.

Based in Lausanne, Switzerland.

Responsibilities

  • Antenna Design: Design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules for our products, and extend the work towards CRPAs (Controlled Reception Pattern Antennas) for GNSS-denied environments.

  • Antenna Integration: Integrate all antennas (GNSS, radio link) into the drones, validating through simulation (gain diagrams) and real-life lab and flight testing.

  • GNSS Test Bench: Develop, maintain and configure the GNSS test bench to simulate satellite constellations and interference scenarios.

  • RF Measurement: Run hands-on characterization with network and spectrum analyzers, and simulate new antenna iterations with EM software.

  • Electromagnetic Compatibility: Lead EMC troubleshooting and pre-compliance testing, identifying and removing blockers early.

  • PCB Collaboration: Work with PCB designers to review routing, shielding and RF layout.

  • Architecture Ownership: Review and own the RF architecture across product lines, including link budgets and system-level RF performance.

  • Mentoring: Act as the team's RF subject matter expert, coaching junior engineers on RF layout principles and EMC mitigation.

Candidate Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field.

  • Experience: Proven track record taking complex wireless devices from concept to mass production, including clearing strict EMC compliance hurdles. Background in aerospace, commercial drones or GNSS products is a strong advantage.

  • GNSS: Solid grounding in GNSS, including hands-on use of a GNSS test bench to simulate edge-case environments, and an understanding of effects such as multipath.

  • Antenna Design: Experience designing custom antennas under tight mechanical and space constraints, with EM simulation tools.

  • RF & EMC: Strong command of RF fundamentals and measurement equipment (network and spectrum analyzers); comfortable working in an anechoic chamber.

  • Mindset: Analytical, meticulous, structured and resilient; a hands-on problem-solver who works autonomously and collaborates well.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals, from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Sales Support Executive
descriptionHtml:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe - over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. Last year we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

THE ROLE

As a Sales Support Executive for Carwow Leasey, your primary objective is to support the sales channel, specifically by processing order sign-offs. Additional duties include selling after-sales Maintenance packages, supporting the pricing team, and acting as the initial point of contact for Renewal customers.

The role involves building and maintaining strong relationships within Leasey, supplying dealers and Fleet Procure. Helping to drive results for Leasey.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Order Sign-offs: Process and manage all order sign-offs accurately, reliably and in a timely manner to effectively support the sales channel.

  • Fulfilment Team Support: Collaborate with and assist the Fulfilment team with operational data and support requirements.

  • Renewal Customer Contact: Conduct the initial outreach and prequalification of all customer renewals, passing that renewal lead on to the appropriate Leasing Consultant or ISM. Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound generic customer renewal enquiries.

  • Relationship Management: Maintain strong working relationships within Leasey, including with supplying dealers and Fleet Procure, to ensure seamless operations and drive results.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Proven track record in sales administration and order lifecycle management

  • Detail-oriented, highly organised, and process-driven mindset

  • Proficiency with sales support systems, CRMs, and administrative workflows

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for managing dealer and customer relationships

  • Proactive approach to supporting pricing teams and driving renewal service satisfaction

  • Ability to collaborate smoothly with internal teams, external dealers, and partners like Fleet Procure

  • Experience of Compliance (specific to industry)

  • Knowledge of vehicle leasing and motor industry

  • Approachable, Supportive, Assertive

  • Excellent Communication skills

  • Solutions focussed and proven ability to pro-actively determine a positive outcome

  • Computer literate. Must be a proficient user of Microsoft suite of packages including Word, Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint, where needed.

BONUS POINTS

  • Proven experience in sales support, order processing, or administrative roles within the automotive or leasing industry.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle customer service for renewals, upsell after-sales packages, and assist pricing teams effectively.

title: Scientist - Patient Stratification, Biomarkers, Translational Genomics
descriptionHtml:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

  • Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies.

  • Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology.

  • Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

Who You Are

Essential:

  • Solid foundations in statistics (e.g., modelling, regression), genetics and molecular biology, and statistical programming (e.g., Python or R).

  • Experience using at least one of the following statistical genetics approaches: GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores.

Preferred:

  • Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records.

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference.

  • Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding)

  • Experience building and running reproducible pipelines, e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow.

  • Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments, e.g., DNAnexus or Verily Workbench.

  • Experience with methods development within statistical genetics.

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Salary: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure competitive compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid Working (e.g., from our London or Oxford Office)

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

If this opportunity excites you, apply now!

We are dedicated to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)

  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Belonging at Samsara

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you’ll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise the value they get from Airwallex.

  • Build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets.

  • Own strategic account planning, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities.

  • Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities.

  • Coordinate escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements.

You'll work from our Munich office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8+ years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions.

  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders.

  • Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally.

  • Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage.

  • Native German and English fluency required.

Preferred

  • Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products.

  • Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders.

  • A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline.

  • Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Learn more about your team

Enterprise Business is about more than closing deals. This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system.

It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. If you want to work on high-consequence deals that genuinely change how large businesses operate financially, this is the place to do it.

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About us:

Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes.

We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making.

Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence.

We’re hiring AI engineers to help us transform research outcomes in biomedical sciences. We utilise generative AI and agents to help scientists find novel connections and insights from biomedical literature and datasets.

Delivering a faster research experience is not just a matter of picking the latest LLM model. Getting accurate, scientifically relevant, trustworthy and meaningful results relies on building trust with our users that comes from integrating proper levels of guardrails, biomedical curation, consistent update cycles and robust deployment practices that make our platform a one-stop shop for a researcher’s needs.

We’re looking for AI engineers who will champion this cause and help us apply AI to transform the way biomedical professionals carry out their research and day-to-day exploration.

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to scope work, align on success metrics, and incrementally ship improvements in user-facing features powered by AI.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions.

We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement shared security controls that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities and centralize enforcement across applications and services.

  • Partner with engineers on architecture and threat modeling, translating risks into concrete designs for authorization, service identity, tenant isolation, and data protection.

  • Build security controls and secure defaults into application frameworks, service templates, and infrastructure modules, making them straightforward for teams to adopt.

  • Develop automation that connects security tools with engineering workflows, adds context to findings, and automates remediation where appropriate.

  • Own vulnerability management across internal findings, automated tooling, external assessments, and researcher reports.

  • Review code, perform targeted security testing, and manage vulnerabilities through verified remediation. Use recurring findings to identify where a shared control or architectural change would prevent similar issues.

  • Support the compliance team by implementing technical controls, automating procedures, and validating that controls operate as intended.

  • Help investigate security incidents and use the findings to improve architecture, controls, and detection.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership.

  • Strong understanding of web, API, and distributed-system security, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and sensitive data handling.

  • Experience taking security controls from architectural design through implementation and adoption across multiple services or teams.

  • Ability to design defense in depth, establish clear trust boundaries, and limit the impact of compromised components or credentials.

  • Strong coding skills: you can review production code, contribute fixes, and build maintainable tooling and shared security components.

  • Experience integrating security tools into engineering workflows and using context and automation to reduce manual work.

  • Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the independence to take an ambiguous problem through to a working solution.

Why join us?

  • Work closely with engineers building AI systems used in critical enterprise operations.

  • Own substantial security projects and help shape a growing security program.

  • Have the autonomy to design solutions, implement them, and see their impact in production.

  • Join a company backed by leading investors.

  • Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. title: Senior Associate, Investor Services
descriptionHtml:
Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide

For further details please visit www.pantheon.com

Purpose of Position

Reporting to the Head of Global Investor Services, the Investor Services Senior Associate is a senior operational role responsible for improving the end to-end client experience and strengthening the effectiveness of the Client Solutions function. The role combines client service delivery, process ownership, data governance, systems improvement and line management of one Analyst within the Investor Services team. Working as part of the global client solutions team, the Senior Associate will act as a key coordination point between Investor Services, Client Solutions, internal specialist functions and external service providers. The role will require close collaboration across the business and with third-party partners to support client lifecycle activity, regulatory and tax documentation, due diligence, screening and process improvement. It will also contribute to the continued development and integration of client-facing and internal systems, including the CRM and Investor Portal.

Key Responsibilities

  • Represent Investor Services and client requirements in internal forums, working groups and cross-functional initiatives focused on improving global client processes and service delivery. 
  • Partner with the Head of Global Investor Services and the Change Office to identify, plan and deliver local and global projects that simplify, improve and automate client service activity
  • Support the development of the Investor Services Analyst by setting clear objectives, providing guidance and feedback, sharing knowledge, and helping to build capability across the team.

Client Process and Service Delivery

  • Manage and execute core client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, transfers of interest, fund extensions, fund terminations, tax repapering, KYC refreshes and World-Check activity.
  • Liaise with external fund administrators, tax consultants, and compliance service providers to coordinate client documentation, due diligence, screening and related process activity.
  • Maintain oversight of global client service activity to ensure processes are consistent, well controlled and aligned with business requirements.
  • Triage non-standard internal client data requests and client-related projects, ensuring priorities, ownership and next steps are clear.
  • Oversee ad-hoc client communications and administrative activity where central coordination is required.

Client Experience and Reporting

  • Drive improvements to global client processes, identifying opportunities to make the client experience more consistent, efficient and scalable.
  • Produce, maintain and coordinate delivery of the global client service plan.
  • Partner with Reporting to improve client support, maintain reporting standards and contribute to continued reporting development.
  • Automation of Tier 3 client support.

Systems, Data and Process Improvement

  • Partner with Technology teams and the Change Office to drive developments and integration of existing client facing and internal IR support systems
  • Identify Investor and Client Solutions processes for systemization and integration

Knowledge and Experience Required

  • Degree-level education (or equivalent experience) is essential
  • Strong knowledge of asset management and the private markets industry, including investor servicing, fund operations and the client lifecycle.
  • Direct experience in client service or investor-facing support, with a strong understanding of how to deliver a high-quality client experience.
  • Familiarity with client due diligence, KYC refreshes, tax documentation processes and screening tools such as World-Check would be advantageous.
  • Proven ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders and work effectively across functions and seniority levels.
  • Experience delivering short and long-term projects, with evidence of clear outcomes, strong execution and practical process improvement.
  • Experience supporting, coaching or managing team members, including setting objectives and providing constructive feedback.
  • High levels of professionalism, confidentiality, discretion and judgement when handling client, investor and business information.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work under pressure and deliver to deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Strong systems capability, including proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and CRM platforms; experience with investor portals or data management tools would be advantageous.

This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.

descriptionHtml:

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Automatisierung der Infrastruktur, der Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Pipelines und der Bereitstellung cloudnativer Services.
