  • Run the ROAS dial. Tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Translate cap-fill outcomes and retention targets into bid moves. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Catch problems before advertisers do. Know what each account should do next before they ask. Push budget increases, geo expansions, format tests on a schedule. Intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Translate between commercial and technical teams. When a partner reports cost-data drift, you debug, push our engineering teams for an ETA, and frame the response back to the partner.

  • Ship the playbook. Document improvements to the Growth team's standard operating procedures every week.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our Director or CEO. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Senior team treats you as the named owner. You're already covering for a peer's vacation. You've spotted at least one non-obvious revenue lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: Within a few years, the path runs from regional accounts to country ownership to multi-country or vertical leadership (gaming, non-gaming) to regional head (EMEA) or global.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not just collect a title.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. A 15% cohort revenue drop on a daily view? You spot it in under 30 seconds and you explain it in two sentences a non-technical listener gets.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

Bonus points if you:

  • Know your way around platform-marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, and ARPU. If you don't yet, you will by week 2 - we'll onboard you on the math.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have hands-on experience with MMPs like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular. You can read postbacks, navigate attribution disputes, and explain View-Through Attribution to a confused partner.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way, for example taking a €2M/yr account book to €8M/yr in 18 months.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up Senior Associate background. We hire the for right mindset. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €65K – €90K

title: Senior HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The HR Business Partner team at OpenAI supports managers and employees as teams grow, perform and adapt. We work alongside managers at all levels to resolve day-to-day people challenges, build management capability and create the conditions for teams to do their best work.

Our expertise spans team effectiveness, talent development, manager coaching, employee relations and change management, grounded in our Contributions & Impact (C&I) culture. We operate with urgency, empathy and sound judgment, valuing sincerity, collaboration and meaningful impact.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior HR Business Partner to support managers and teams across EMEA, with a primary focus on Go-to-Market and responsibility for selected other functions in the region. You’ll provide hands-on support to managers at all levels, owning day-to-day people work and helping teams grow and scale effectively.

Your GTM partnership will span teams such as Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships and Marketing. Across your portfolio, you’ll build a deep understanding of business priorities and use that context to prioritise and deliver practical people support.

As a hands-on partner to managers at all levels, you will use independent judgment to coach managers, resolve people issues and follow through on day-to-day work as teams scale. You will own delivery across your portfolio, working closely with the International HRBP Leader, Recruiting, Finance, Employment Legal and People centres of expertise, and involving specialist partners when needed.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the International HRBP Leader.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day HRBP support with a primary focus on GTM. Be a practical point of contact for managers on performance, employee relations, team changes and development. Prioritise issues, agree clear next steps and see them through to resolution as teams scale.

  • Support teams as they grow. Help managers put agreed team structures and workforce plans into practice, clarify roles and address capacity needs as teams enter new markets and scale existing operations. Coordinate with Finance and Recruiting to support hiring and team changes.

  • Build manager effectiveness. Coach managers at all levels, from first-time managers to experienced people managers, on feedback, difficult conversations, team dynamics and accountability. Help them address everyday people challenges with clarity and care.

  • Build capability and succession. Help managers identify skills and development needs across GTM teams. Partner on talent reviews, succession planning, internal mobility and development, with particular attention to roles essential to customer and business outcomes.

  • Drive performance and rewards decisions. Help managers set clear expectations, address underperformance and recognise contributions consistently. Partner with Compensation and Sales Compensation specialists on people implications of incentive structures, role changes and rewards decisions.

  • Lead through regional complexity. Guide organisational changes and sensitive employee matters across EMEA, partnering with Employment Legal and Employee Relations specialists. Balance business urgency, local requirements and fair, consistent treatment.

  • Use insight to act early. Combine workforce data, business context and employee feedback to identify emerging risks, test assumptions and recommend action. Track whether interventions improve capability, retention and team effectiveness.

  • Scale effective People practices. Partner with global HRBPs and centres of expertise to evolve performance, engagement and talent programmes for EMEA, ensuring regional needs inform global decisions and local delivery remains practical.

What You Bring

  • Substantial HRBP experience. Typically 7–10+ years in HR, including at least five years supporting managers and teams in high-growth, international or complex organisations. We value the scope and impact of your experience.

  • Commercial understanding. Experience supporting Sales and other go-to-market functions, with an understanding of enterprise sales cycles, customer-facing roles and the people implications of commercial operating models.

  • Hands-on manager partnership. A record of supporting managers at all levels, resolving day-to-day people issues and owning delivery across a busy portfolio. You can exercise independent judgment, challenge constructively and build trusted relationships.

  • EMEA experience. Experience across multiple EMEA markets, navigating cultural differences and varied employment environments, with sound judgment about when to involve specialist partners.

  • Organisational and talent judgment. Practical experience supporting team growth, workforce planning, manager coaching, performance management and talent development, including delivering change through ambiguity.

  • Analytical and execution strength. The ability to diagnose problems using data and context, make clear recommendations and follow through. You prioritise effectively, take ownership of complex people issues and stay close to the details through resolution.

  • Integrity and care. Discretion with sensitive matters, fairness in decision-making and a willingness to listen, adapt and act with conviction.

Workplace and Location

This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model with three days per week in the office and offer relocation support where appropriate.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Senior Incident Response & Readiness Consultant
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Incident Response & Readiness Consultant, you will serve as a trusted advisor, leading both proactive and emergency engagements with enterprise customers. Leveraging your comprehensive expertise in cybersecurity, you will help organizations prepare for and respond to cyber incidents, combining strategic readiness consulting with direct guidance through complex cyber incidents.

 

What You'll Do

  • Readiness

    o Conduct comprehensive reviews of incident response plans, identifying gaps and developing tailored strategies to strengthen organizational preparedness.

    o Design and deliver customized incident response playbooks to address specific threats and operational needs.

    o Facilitate training sessions on incident response fundamentals to build customer capabilities.

    o Lead workshops, tabletop exercises, drills, and functional simulations to evaluate and improve readiness.

    o Provide strategic guidance to customers on integrating readiness into broader security programs.

    o Contribute to the development of readiness methodologies and internal knowledge sharing.

  • Incident Response

    o Serve as a subject matter expert in digital forensics and incident response (DFIR).

    o Lead large-scale, complex investigations involving host, network, and cloud artifacts to determine the nature, scope, and root cause of cyber incidents.

    o Collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional incident response teams.

    o Guide containment, remediation, and recovery efforts to secure environments post-incident.

    o Maintain a professional, calming, and authoritative presence during high-pressure incidents.

    o Brief senior leadership and technical teams on findings, risks, and recommendations.

    o Support the development of incident response methodologies and contribute to internal capability building.

    o Participate in a 24x7 emergency response rotation which includes weekends.


What You'll Bring


Required

  • Comprehensive experience in both readiness and incident response.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to lead and mentor cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent communication skills, including executive briefings.

  • Proven ability to manage high-stakes engagements.

  • Experience with forensic tools and techniques (e.g., EDR, log analysis, malware analysis).

  • Familiarity with enterprise environments including Windows, Linux, Azure, AWS, and M365.

  • Strong understanding of attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) and modern detection and response strategies.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20%, including on short notice, to support on-site customer engagements.

Education and Experience

  • 8–12 years of experience in cybersecurity or related fields, with a focus on incident response and readiness.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead high-profile incidents and readiness initiatives.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., GIAC, CISSP, CISM, or similar) are a plus but not required; proven impact and expertise are primary qualifiers.

title: (Senior) International Marketing Manager (m/f/d) -Southern Europe
descriptionHtml:
GoLighter is scaling fast across Southern Europe — and we’re looking for a dedicated, hands-on operator to drive our regional growth. In this role, you will be the central marketing resource for our Southern Europe Success Team and take end-to-end ownership of marketing across the region.

You will be responsible for building and launching campaigns yourself, developing market-specific growth strategies, and orchestrating multi-channel product rollouts across Southern European markets. You will work closely with our performance marketing, commercial, and BI teams to identify growth opportunities, translate local market insights into action, and ensure that regional KPIs stay on track.

We are looking for a highly proactive builder who wants to establish something from scratch, understands the nuances of Southern European markets, and combines strategic depth with a strong operational and numerical mindset. You enjoy moving quickly, testing new ideas, and taking full ownership of business outcomes.

Your task will be…

  • Take full ownership of marketing activities and commercial results across Italy and Spain

  • Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta campaigns

  • Own the operational execution and performance of SEA and Paid Social activities

  • Collaborate closely with the Team Lead Performance Marketing and the Vice President of Commercial Development to ensure regional expansion plans and KPIs remain on track

  • Develop and execute high-impact pre-selling, lead-generation, and product-launch sequences for our upcoming portfolio, including the Wegovy® Pill pipeline

  • Identify untapped growth opportunities, channels, audiences, and campaign approaches

  • Formulate creative hypotheses, run rapid experiments, analyze results, and continuously improve performance

  • Monitor and optimize key growth metrics such as CAC, AOV, LTV, conversion rates, and overall funnel performance

  • Work closely with our internal Business Intelligence team to identify trends and translate data into actionable measures

  • Plan and launch TV and out-of-home campaigns across the South markets

  • Select, brief, coordinate, and manage external agencies while maintaining clear control over ROI, performance, and commercial outcomes

  • Coordinate multi-channel product rollouts and ensure consistent execution across digital and offline touchpoints

  • Build scalable marketing processes, guidelines, and structures for the South region


You will fit well when…

  • You have three to five years of proven experience in fast-scaling digital marketing roles

  • You have worked in e-commerce, digital health, D2C, subscription-based businesses, or similarly fast-paced environments

  • You have direct experience scaling marketing campaigns in Italy, Spain and France

  • You understand Southern market dynamics, regional differences, and local customer behavior

  • You have strong hands-on expertise in SEA and Paid Social, particularly Google Ads and Meta

  • You are comfortable working directly within advertising platforms and managing campaigns independently

  • You have experience planning and executing TV marketing campaigns

  • You have successfully managed external agencies with a clear focus on measurable commercial results

  • You can develop strategic expansion plans while remaining deeply involved in operational execution

  • You have a highly analytical mindset and confidently work with performance data, dashboards, budgets, and business KPIs

  • You take ownership of business outcomes rather than focusing only on individual tasks

  • You proactively create briefs, processes, and solutions instead of waiting for detailed instructions

  • You enjoy building new markets, testing new ideas, and working in a fast-paced environment

  • You are fluent in English

  • Professional proficiency in Italian, Spanish and/or French is a strong advantage

Important: Official correspondence regarding job applications will always come from an @wellsterhealth.com email address.

title: Senior International PR Manager
descriptionHtml:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

As a Senior International PR Manager, you are considered highly skilled and proficient in your discipline. You bring an autonomous work style, take full functional job responsibility, and handle the organization and planning of complex projects. You operate independently with wide decision-making latitude, driving our media strategy for the UK, Ireland and other markets while thinking content holistically across multiple channels. You are a true global citizen who thinks and lives internationality, bringing an international background and mindset to the team. You are always eager to immerse yourself in the cultures, trends, and media landscapes of new countries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement PR & Communications initiatives that enhance brand awareness and thought leadership, ensuring a consistent and credible media presence across the UK and Irish markets as well as across all relevant markets.
  • Media Relations: Actively build and maintain relationships with financial and consumer media to strengthen the company’s network and visibility, leveraging deep knowledge of the UK and Irish media landscape while demonstrating a strong passion and drive to dig deep into the media ecosystems of new and emerging international markets.
  • International Collaboration & Travel: Act as a bridge between our headquarters and global audiences by traveling to our target markets to build on-the-ground relationships with local media, agencies, and stakeholders.
  • Creative Storytelling: Come up with creative ideas, and data-driven narratives to engage existing media contacts and approach new ones in a meaningful and strategic way.
  • Content Creation: Draft and distribute high-quality press releases, media pitches, video scripts, visual assets, and other press materials tailored to relevant international audiences.
  • Agency Management: Lead, coordinate, and hold accountable external PR agencies to ensure high-quality output and optimal budget allocation.
  • Media Coordination & Representation: Coordinate media activities, including briefings and interviews, and serve as a spokesperson when needed.
  • Editorial Planning: Create and maintain a full editorial calendar to ensure consistent planning, alignment, and execution across all communication channels.
  • Monitoring & Risk Management: Monitor the financial media landscape and competitive activity to surface PR opportunities and proactively manage potential risks to reputation.
  • Team & Performance: Help set and track team OKRs, working collaboratively to ensure goals are delivered with attention to detail and follow-through. Offer support and perspective to colleagues at all levels, acting as a reliable sparring partner.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, gained either in a PR agency or in-house communications department. 
  • A genuinely international background and mindset, with strong intercultural competence and a proven passion for understanding different global market dynamics.
  • Vast, deep knowledge of the UK and Irish media landscape, with an established network of relevant journalists, editors, and financial commentators in these regions, paired with the curiosity and hands-on mentality to independently research and master new international media landscapes.
  • Willingness to travel internationally to foster relationships and oversee local market initiatives on the ground.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing PR strategies that deliver measurable results.
  • A creative storyteller who can think outside the box to craft compelling narratives and attention-grabbing headlines for target media.
  • Confident working with various content formats, including press releases, LinkedIn posts, media pitches, briefing documents, and visual/video assets.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, external agency partners, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Results-driven mindset with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to contributing to a high-performance culture.
  • Composed and effective under pressure, especially during crisis situations or fast-moving developments.
  • Native or professional fluency in English (especially written and spoken for the UK/Irish market).

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or a high-growth tech environment.
  • Hands-on experience with video editing tools and visual media production.
  • Practical experience in crisis communication and reputation management.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools for communications, content creation, and video generation.
  • Multilingual capabilities (i.e. Polish, Spanish or Dutch) are a strong advantage and highly valued given the international scope of the role.
  • Familiarity with PR tools and media monitoring platforms.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year.
  • Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock.
  • We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office.
  • We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year.
  • One day birthday leave to celebrate your birthday.
  • We offer you a company stakeholder pension with a minimum employer contribution of 5%.
  • The opportunity to experience our annual retreats in exciting European cities and other team building events.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
descriptionHtml:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

  • Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

Benefits & Culture

  • Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

  • Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making.

  • Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment.

  • Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications.

  • Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance.

  • Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise.

title: Senior IT Operations Engineer (Remote / SaaS )
descriptionHtml:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

About us:

We are Publitas! We’re a remote-first, fast-growing SaaS company helping brands turn static content into digital discovery experiences that drive results.

We’re not about busywork, hierarchy, or hand-holding. We hire sharp minds, trust them fully, and measure success by real results, not noise. If you thrive in autonomy, challenge, and high ownership, you’ll love it here.

This role is for you if you…

  • Get excited by taking ownership and figuring things out proactively

  • Thrive in a remote, async, fast-paced environment

  • Are striving to deliver impact, not just running tasks

  • Think in systems but execute with creativity

  • Are direct, collaborative, and have a growth mindset

This role is NOT for you if you…

  • Need layers of process or someone to constantly tell you what to do

  • Prefer “business as usual” over change

  • Want a team where mediocre is okay

  • Have never worked remotely and think async means “lonely”

  • Are waiting for permission instead of taking initiative

The work you’ll do…

As a Senior Internal IT Engineer at Publitas, you’ll build and scale the internal technology foundation that enables our distributed teams to work securely, efficiently, and without friction.
You’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with operational ownership and process thinking to improve the reliability and maturity of our internal IT environment.

You will:

  • Own and continuously improve our internal IT landscape, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable day-to-day operations across endpoints, SaaS tooling, identity, and access management.

  • Drive operational maturity by creating structure, improving workflows, and reducing manual or reactive support work across the organization.

  • Lead and coordinate internal IT projects, from onboarding automation and device management to security improvements and tooling rollouts.

  • Act as a trusted technical partner for employees and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, prioritization, and follow-through across distributed teams.

  • Improve our security posture by strengthening access controls, endpoint management, compliance processes, and operational best practices.

  • Manage and optimize our SaaS ecosystem, balancing usability, security, cost-efficiency, and maintainability.

  • Create scalable internal processes and documentation that enable autonomy, consistency, and operational resilience as the company grows.

  • Contribute to company-wide operational readiness initiatives, including audits, compliance efforts, and business continuity improvements.

What you bring…

  • 5+ years of experience in Internal IT, IT Operations, or Systems Administration within modern SaaS environments.

  • Strong experience with identity and access management, endpoint management, SaaS administration, and security best practices.

  • Hands-on experience managing distributed or remote-first environments.

  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills — you can independently drive initiatives from planning to execution.

  • A process-oriented mindset focused on scalability, automation, and operational clarity.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • The ability to balance hands-on execution with longer-term operational improvements.

What We Provide to Help You Win…

  • A competitive salary

  • 25 vacation days + your local national holidays

  • A top-tier MacBook and remote-ready gear

  • Monthly wellness budget to invest in your health

  • Co-Working allowance

  • Events, training, or courses that directly and primarily contribute to your work at Publitas

  • Free books on Kindle and Audible

  • Free Publitas Swag (merchandise)

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Corporate, M&A & Financing)
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Our Legal team is small, senior and hands-on. We do the work ourselves, cover each other's areas and use outside counsel only where local law or deal size genuinely requires it. You will be the group's lead lawyer on corporate structures, acquisitions and group corporate matters, working directly with the CLPO, the CFO and the founders.

This is a role for a corporate and finance lawyer who wants to run deals rather than manage them from a distance. You will draft, negotiate and close transactions yourself, bring rigour to how we manage the group structure across a growing number of markets, and use AI tooling to move faster and work smarter across every part of the brief.

What you'll build and own

  • Run acquisitions end to end - structuring, legal due diligence, sale and purchase agreements, disclosure, warranty and indemnity insurance, completion and post-completion integration - including targets that hold financial services licences.

  • Lead change-in-control approval processes with the FCA, the Central Bank of Ireland, the Bank of Canada, MTL regulators and others, coordinating closely with Compliance and the business.

  • Own the group corporate structure across the UK, Ireland, Norway, the US and other markets: capital injections, intra-group financing, debt-for-equity swaps and reorganisations.

  • Prepare board and shareholder resolutions, support board and committee meetings across group entities, and oversee entity management and company secretarial work.

  • Select, instruct and manage outside counsel on cross-border deals, agree fee estimates, challenge bills and keep deal costs within budget - pulling routine work in-house wherever it makes sense.

  • Support employee equity arrangements in close partnership with the People and Finance teams.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate first-draft work, due diligence review and research, so you can spend your time on the judgement calls that actually matter.

Your experience

  • Qualified solicitor in England and Wales or Ireland, or advokat in Norway (or equivalent), with at least 8 years' PQE.

  • Strong corporate, M&A and banking or finance experience, built at a leading law firm and ideally also in-house at a fintech, bank or regulated financial services business.

  • A track record of leading equity rounds, debt facilities and acquisitions from term sheet through to completion - you have been in the room, not behind it.

  • Experience with regulated entities and change-in-control processes across one or more of our key jurisdictions.

  • Comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and alongside founders, investors and lenders without needing hand-holding.

  • A hands-on, practical style: you write first drafts yourself, give clear commercial advice and do not hide behind caveats.

Nice to have

  • Experience with consumer credit funding structures such as warehouse facilities or forward-flow arrangements.

  • Familiarity with cap table tools such as Carta.

  • Fluency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Technology APAC
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Delivering that mission for our allies means being where they are. Corporate Technology International builds and runs the IT, infrastructure and security behind Anduril's growth in every market outside the United States. APAC is our largest region, with sites in Australia, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan

Based in Sydney, you'll run Corporate Technology in APAC and own the region's results, people and budget as a peer to the Senior Manager, EMEA.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Run APAC Corporate Technology

  • Lead the region's IT service, infrastructure, security engineering and reliability teams: more than a dozen people, through three direct reports.
  • Hire, performance manage and develop your managers, tech leads and engineers.
  • Work through the big architecture and design calls with your tech leads, across networks, identity, cloud, end-user computing and secure facilities.
  • Plan, advocate for and deliver the region's 12 to 24 month roadmap, budget and headcount plan as part of the Corporate Technology International plan, and approve hires and spend within it.
  • Be the first point of contact in APAC for business lines, divisions and site leadership, for escalations, priorities and new requirements.
  • Run a regular health review of the services your team runs in APAC. Take issues on systems other teams own to that team with the business impact, and track them until they're closed.
  • Hold the region to the standards set by global IT, Enterprise Systems, Infrastructure Engineering and Information Security, and work closely with Security and Trade Compliance. Where a country's laws or Defence customers need something different, agree the local approach with the owning team and keep everything else on the global standard.
  • Represent Corporate Technology to Australian Government customers and partners, and work with Security on Anduril Australia's Defence Industry Security Program obligations.

Support the expansions team

  • Help the expansions team build and improve its playbook, and use it on APAC office moves and expansions, so each one is quicker and cheaper than the last.
  • Bring the region's operating needs into each new APAC site's design before work starts, so your team can support it from go-live.
  • Release APAC people to work under the expansions team's direction on a deployments, and cover their day-to-day work while they're away.
  • Plan each go-live handover with the expansions team and the HQ teams that run each system, so your team takes the site over with support in place on day one.
  • Size what each APAC site and market needs to run, from local headcount to support from HQ, so leadership knows what a market costs before committing to it.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Led managers or tech leads across more than one discipline, including hiring, performance management and development
  • Extensive hands-on experience as an engineer in infrastructure, networks, cloud, security or enterprise IT. You can question a design and hold your own with tech leads
  • Set the plan for work across several teams, including work where you had to define the problem first, and were held to its milestones and results
  • Delivered technology change across more than one site or country, with the teams that own the systems and the infrastructure they run on
  • Changed the plans or priorities of senior leaders you didn't report to, and kept their trust
  • Been accountable for a service people use every day, with service targets, an escalation path and a budget
  • Represented your organisation to government customers or regulators, and written the plans and updates they worked from
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Australian citizen, eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in defence, national security or another highly regulated industry

title: Senior Manager, Global Compliance Strategy and Policies (UK)
descriptionHtml:
Crypto.com’s Compliance function safeguards the business and its customers by ensuring the group operates within applicable laws, regulations and industry standards across every market we serve. The function is organised around three core pillars: Regional Compliance, Compliance Advisory: Policies, Product and Governance, and Compliance Support and Oversight. Together, these teams partner with the business to enable responsible growth, uphold our regulatory obligations, and protect the trust our customers place in us.

The Regional Compliance team owns day-to-day compliance execution in-country: local licensing, regulator engagement, exams and audits, and acting as the first line of compliance partnership to the regional business.


About the Role

The Senior Manager, Global Compliance Strategy and Policies (UK) is a senior member of the central policy team, responsible for translating Crypto.com’s global compliance framework into operational policies, standards, and procedures with primary ownership of UK and EEA regulatory alignment. Working under the VP’s direction, you will draft, maintain, and drive adoption of policy to ensure that UK and EEA regulatory requirements are accurately reflected in the global framework.

This is a high-ownership individual contributor / small-team lead role with significant exposure to the CCO, regional compliance heads, and UK/EEA regulators. You will be the central team’s primary point of accountability for UK and EEA-facing policy content.


Key Responsibilities

Policy Development and Maintenance

  • Draft, review, and maintain assigned domains of the global policy suite — AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, travel rule, market abuse, financial promotions, and recordkeeping — ensuring consistency with group drafting standards and tiering.

  • Lead the UK overlay: own UK-specific annexes and local procedures that implement global policy in line with UK requirements (MLRs 2017, Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, OFSI sanctions regime, FCA Handbook including SYSC, and the UK cryptoasset financial promotions regime).

  • Conduct gap analyses of existing UK policies against evolving regulatory expectations; propose and execute remediation.

  • Coordinate policy approval workflows, version control, and periodic review cadence for assigned domains.


    • Regulatory Change Management (UK / EEA)

  • Run the UK and EEA regulatory change pipeline for the central team: monitor FCA, HM Treasury, OFSI, JMLSG, and where relevant EEA supervisors; assess impact on policy; drive updates through the change process.

  • Translate UK and EEA rulemaking, FCA policy statements, enforcement actions, and supervisory letters into policy requirements and implementation tasks.

  • Support horizon scanning input to the VP for UK and EEA-related strategic planning, licensing, and product launches, including FCA cryptoasset registration, UK stablecoin regime, and MiCA adjacency for EEA operations.


    • Regional Implementation and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with the UK and EEA Head of Compliance / MLRO and Legal, Risk, Product, and Operations teams to embed policy requirements into systems, onboarding flows, transaction monitoring rules, and product design.

  • Serve as the central policy team’s primary liaison to UK and EEA regional compliance; arbitrate first-line escalations where local practice diverges from global standard, escalating material conflicts to the VP.

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, and independent audits with policy evidence, drafting responses, and remediation tracking.

  • Contribute to UK and EEA regulatory filings, FCA registration applications, and gateway reviews from a policy-content perspective.

  • Contribute to policy training content and compliance culture initiatives in partnership with HR/Learning.


    • Requirements

    Required

  • 8+ years in compliance, financial crime, or regulatory affairs, with at least 2–3 years drafting or owning policy at a regulated financial institution (bank, payments, e-money, broker-dealer, or cryptoasset firm).

  • Deep working knowledge of UK AML/CFT and sanctions frameworks(MLRs 2017, POCA 2002, OFSI regime, JMLSG guidance), UK’s financial promotions regime, FCA regulations, and the MiCA framework. Practical experience with MiFID II is considered a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with the UK cryptoasset regime, and the MiCA framework

  • Demonstrated experience producing regulator-grade written work products (policy documents, FCA information requests, s.166 responses, registration applications).

  • Track record engaging with the FCA or other UK and EEA supervisors directly or through supervisory support.

  • Experience operating in a matrixed global organization; able to balance group standards with legitimate local tailoring.

  • Excellent written communication; able to draft board-grade and regulator-grade documents.

  • Crypto/digital assets experience: travel rule implementation, FCA cryptoasset registration, blockchain analytics tooling (Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic).

  • Exposure to EEA regulatory frameworks including MiCA, EU AMLR/AMLA — particularly where the firm operates across both UK and EEA entities.

title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do

  • Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
  • Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
  • Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
  • Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
  • Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer - Humanoid Head
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As a Senior Mechatronics Engineer, you join the early team and own the head of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. It is where perception, interaction and identity come together: a densely packed system of mechanics, electronics, sensing and human-machine interfaces, integrated seamlessly within surfaces defined by Industrial Design. Whatever your background in robotics, consumer electronics or automotive, you bring deep mechatronic integration expertise to every board, sensor and surface you touch, and you take pride in turning a striking design into a robust, manufacturable product.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Head Architecture: Own the full mechatronic architecture of the head - from package and layout concepts to production-ready CAD - balancing space, mass, thermal, EMC and serviceability requirements, and defining the head-to-body interface together with the adjacent engineering teams.

  • Electronics & Sensor Integration: Integrate PCBAs, sensors, displays and lighting into one coherent system, including mounting, alignment, sealing, cabling and connectors.

  • Industrial Design Implementation: Partner closely with Industrial Design to translate their shapes and Class-A surfaces into engineered housings, covers and transparent or translucent parts - without compromising design intent, function or manufacturability.

  • Functional Performance: Ensure the mechanical design enables peak performance of every integrated component, from sensing and interaction to thermal management.

  • DFM/DFA Excellence: Design every component for manufacturability and assembly at scale from day one, working closely with the workshop, suppliers and supply chain to eliminate late-stage redesigns.

  • Mentorship & Standards: Establish the organization's standards for electronics integration and surface-driven design, and mentor junior engineers in mechatronic integration best practices.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation - and who care as much about how a product looks and feels as about how it works.

Must have

  • Experience: 5+ years in mechatronic product development in robotics, consumer electronics, automotive (e.g. lighting, cockpit, ADAS sensors) or similar high-tech industries. A proven track record of shipping complex, densely integrated hardware products is essential.

  • Mastery of CAD & Surface Modeling: Expert level in CAD, including advanced surface modeling and the implementation of Class-A data from Industrial Design.

  • Electronics Integration: Hands-on experience integrating PCBAs, harnesses and connectors, including ECAD/MCAD collaboration and EMC-aware mechanical design.

  • Sensors, Displays & Audio: Proven experience integrating cameras, sensors, displays, lighting, microphones and speakers.

  • DFM/DFA Proficiency: Strong command of design for series production, focusing on manufacturing-driven design optimization, parts reduction, assembly-friendly tolerancing and cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) reduction.

  • Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You bridge design and engineering, defending design intent and engineering reality with equal conviction - and you design for the impacts, heat, dust and vibration a robot faces outside a rendering.

Nice to have

  • Thermal Management: A good understanding of passive and active cooling for compact, enclosed electronics.

  • Plastics & Housings: A good understanding of injection molding, two-component and transparent parts, surface finishes and textures, sealing concepts (IP rating) and snap-fit/fastening design.

  • Perception Integration: Experience packaging cameras and sensors for long-term calibration stability.

  • Human-Machine Interface: Experience integrating the interaction elements that give a product its presence and expression.

  • Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

descriptionHtml:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.

Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.

We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.


About this role:

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Ops Manager to build the operating structure around Asset Management as OEGEN continues to grow and manage increasingly complex assets.

This is a business-side leadership role within OEGEN’s Asset Management function. It is not responsible for operating power plants or acting as a technical authority; it is responsible for making sure the portfolio-management system around our assets is effective, consistent and able to evolve.

The role is about making sure the basics are done well and consistently, without problems repeatedly needing senior intervention. It will take ownership of important work that cuts across funds and functions, where standards already exist but are not consistently embedded, or where there is currently no clear owner.

The successful candidate will help ensure that OEGEN’s scale benefits investors: issues are identified earlier, suppliers are held to account, and lessons from one asset improve how we manage the wider portfolio. They will also support Asset Management leadership in the continual development of our high-performance culture.

The role will evolve with the business. As markets, grid arrangements, regulations, technology and operating models become more complex, the successful candidate will help ensure that the way OEGEN manages assets keeps pace. This may include developing the operating model for new platform businesses, IPPs, revenue functions and technology-enabled ways of working.


What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the core operating framework for Asset Management, including clear standards, ownership, governance and reporting across funds, assets and platforms

  • Oversee governance, directorships and other Asset Management governance arrangements

  • Act as the senior Asset Management representative for data and reporting systems, ensuring tools and processes meet business requirements and are adopted effectively. This is not a technical product-owner role

  • Drive consistent implementation of the supplier and contractor performance framework, including the contractor management standard, supplier reviews, competency assessment, PQQ and KYC processes

  • Oversee supplier onboarding and assurance processes, ensuring they are practical, proportionate and consistently applied

  • Own the Asset Management risk-management framework and consolidated risk reporting, improving visibility, escalation and follow-through on material risks

  • Lead the lessons-learned and continuous-improvement process, ensuring recurring issues are translated into changes to standards, guidance and working practices

  • Provide oversight of key central processes that rely on Asset Management input, including precedent contract management, assumption books and other investment or operational standards

  • Identify where changing market conditions, technology or operating models require Asset Management to adapt, and develop practical proposals to support that change


    • What You'll Need

  • 10–15 years’ experience in infrastructure investing, asset management, portfolio management or business transformation within an asset owner, fund manager or comparable investor-led business.

  • Strong commercial and financial understanding, including how investment cases, budgets, valuations and portfolio returns fit together.

  • Experience in asset management, followed by experience in a portfolio operations, transformation, operational excellence or COO-type role

  • A track record of building or improving portfolio-wide processes and operating frameworks - not solely managing individual assets

  • Demonstrable delivery of systems such as contractor governance, operational risk reporting, supplier assurance, management information or cross-functional improvement programmes

  • Strong understanding of how renewable assets are operated, including third-party asset management, key suppliers, contractual frameworks, operational risks and governance requirements

  • Experience working across technical, finance, legal, data, fund-management and investment teams, with the credibility to challenge and influence senior stakeholders

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

title: Senior Production Manager
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Manufacturing Operations / Production Manager to join our Production team in Sydney. Reporting to the Director of Operations, this role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and controlling manufacturing operations across our Sydney Maritime Production Facility.

This is a senior management role managing a team of 40-50 people across assembly, test, and integration operations for complex robotics and subsea hardware platforms. The role requires both strategic operations management capability and frontline technical leadership, placing you at the forefront of fostering team development and overseeing day-to-day delivery operations. Success in this pivotal position demands consistent achievement across team management, production operations, and financial goals, ensuring the delivery of world-class, mission-critical defence products.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Production Leadership & Execution

  • Lead day-to-day production operations across multiple product lines, ensuring efficient production and delivery of subsea robotics hardware.
  • Own the production plan and coordinate with program management, planning, and supply chain to align resources with build schedules and delivery commitments.
  • Strategically manage production scheduling by working closely with planning and manufacturing engineering teams to solve for desired production performance outcomes. Tactically direct daily operations to meet target on-time delivery goals.
  • Monitor production metrics (units completed, cycle time, rework rates) and drive corrective actions when performance deviates from targets.
  • Manage shift schedules, overtime, and workforce allocation to balance workload across the team and meet surge requirements when needed.
  • Ensure work orders are correctly executed, clear daily production blockers, and generate daily pass-down and quality reports reporting out across teams.

Test & Integration Oversight

  • Oversee system-level and subsystem test operations, ensuring test procedures are followed and test equipment is maintained and calibrated.
  • Drive yield improvements through collaboration with manufacturing engineering, design engineering, test engineering, and quality teams â including root-cause analysis and corrective actions to reduce retest cycles.

People Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, onboard, train, and retain a high-performing team of supervisors, coordinators, assembly and test technicians across a team of up to 50 people.
  • Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular reviews, and actively coach and mentor team members fostering professional growth, cross-training, and a culture of accountability on the production floor.
  • Identify skill gaps and coordinate technical training programs, working to continuously increase the capability and competency of the team, inclusive of system-level troubleshooting.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all production and test activities comply with applicable quality management system requirements, workmanship standards, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Support Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions, nonconformance investigations, and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) processes.
  • Lead cross-functional communication with engineering, supply chain, and quality teams to support root cause investigations and corrective actions.
  • Champion a culture of built-in quality, emphasising defect prevention over detection.

Safety & Environment

  • Maintain a safe production environment in compliance with WHS legislation and company policies.
  • Conduct regular safety walks, toolbox talks, and incident investigations; drive corrective actions to closure.
  • Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous materials and controlled substances used in production.
  • Enforce safety procedures and drive continuous improvement in safety performance.

Continuous Improvement & Process Excellence

  • Identify and lead Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives (5S, Kaizen, standard work) to increase efficiency and reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to refine work instructions, tooling, fixtures, and production processes.
  • Support new product introduction (NPI) and engineering change order (ECO) implementation on the production floor.
  • Leverage data-driven decision-making to establish KPIs and coach the production team to do the same.

Strategic Communication

  • Effectively communicate priorities, production progress, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and facilitate cross-functional collaboration with engineering, field operations, maintenance and international sites.
  • Conduct transactions and maintain accuracy across enterprise systems (e.g., Oracle, JIRA, MES).
  • Support the broader team to ensure inventory accuracy and clear supply chain coordination.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing or production operations within complex assembly environments.
  • 5+ years in a direct leadership role managing teams of 20+ people, with demonstrated experience scaling and managing teams of 40-50.
  • Proven expertise implementing Lean manufacturing principles, including 5S, Kaizen, and standard work methodologies with a constant desire to achieve continuous improvement.
  • Strong background in production scheduling, capacity planning, and shop floor management systems (MES/ERP).
  • Demonstrated success in employee development, coaching, and mentorship at scale.
  • Strong knowledge of production change management principles (NPI, ECOs)
  • Excellent leadership, organisation, and communication skills working across multiple business divisions.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active NV2 Security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in defence, aerospace, or similarly regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Experience in high-risk material handling using overhead cranes, stored energy and robotic systems.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 standards.
  • Experience scaling production from low-rate initial production (LRIP) to full-rate production (FRP).
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or rapid-scaling manufacturing environment.

title: Senior Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Sidetrade

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us.

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

The role

As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.

You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
  • Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
  • Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
  • Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
  • Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
  • Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
  • Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
  • Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
  • Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
  • Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.

What you will bring:

  • 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
  • A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
  • Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
  • Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
  • The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
  • The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
  • Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.

Why Sidetrade

  • AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
  • Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
  • Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Benefits

  • Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days
  • Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
  • Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs
  • Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays
  • Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support

Because when you thrive, we all succeed!

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.

If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know.

Agencies

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.
