We’re known for collaboration, deep expertise, and ability to unlock the full potential of Anaplan’s powerful connected planning platform. You’ll work with Anaplan’s industry-leading Hyperblock™ technology that delivers real-time data capabilities, and best in class planning and modelling capabilities. Grow your own skills while helping customers outpace disruption and outperform the competition—by planning smarter, faster, and more effectively.

Think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! 

Your Role

As an Architect, you are responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in some of our most important strategic accounts. 

  • Serve as the Architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions.
  • Work with customer teams to transform and optimise business process through the Anaplan Platform.
  • Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models.
  • Support scoping, estimations and customer presentations as part of a solution sales process.
  • Assist with knowledge management, mentoring and enablement across the Professional Services Teams.

Your Qualifications

We’re looking for smart, consultative professionals who love solving problems, building relationships, and pushing boundaries. We want you to bring your vision, experience, and passion to our team – helping our customers to out-predict, out-plan and outperform their competitors. 

  • Tenured experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions (Anaplan or similar).
  • Domain expertise in planning and modelling in Finance solutions.
  • Ability to lead and consult on complex projects.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

  

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

Au quotidien, tu :

  • échanges avec les clients dirigeants et leurs équipes ;

  • comprends et qualifies leurs demandes ;

  • les accompagnes sur les sujets liés au compte professionnel, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement ;

  • interagis avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les demandes et opérations liées aux services financiers ;

  • coordonnes les échanges entre les clients, les équipes internes et les partenaires concernés ;

  • analyses les situations et identifies les prochaines étapes ;

  • apportes une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée ;

  • formalises les informations utiles au traitement des dossiers ;

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Au démarrage :

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur Pennylane et ses services financiers.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu’avec les différents départements.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends progressivement en charge ton portefeuille de demandes.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu analyses les demandes, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches la solution la plus adaptée.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2012 konnten wir weit mehr als 50 Projekte durchführen, was ein stetiges Wachstum der STUPP-Prozessautomation GmbH zur Folge hat.

Zu unseren namhaften Kunden gehören unter anderem Coca- Cola, das Brauhaus Tegernsee, die Firma Apollinaris, die Zillertal Bier GmbH, die Brauerei Hacklberg in Passau, die Brauerei Ganter in Freiburg, die Brauerei Wittmann in Landshut und viele weitere. title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine leveraging AI and data to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

We are looking for a Staff Data Platform Engineer to join our Data Platform team. Our team builds and operates the shared foundation that powers analytics, machine learning, business intelligence and AI-driven experiences across the entire company. As a senior individual contributor, you will shape how we move, store, govern, and serve data at scale, enabling every downstream team to build faster and with greater confidence.

If you enjoy turning ambiguity into clear technical direction and durable solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

  

In this role, you will:

  • Design and evolve the architecture of KAYAK’s shared Data Platform, including near-real-time streaming, lakehouse storage, schema management, semantic layer, and distributed query infrastructure. Make thoughtful trade-offs between latency, correctness, cost, and long-term maintainability.

  • Deliver high-impact platform initiatives end-to-end — from problem framing and architecture design through implementation, rollout, and operational handoff.

  • Define and promote technical standards for data contracts, schema evolution, ingestion patterns, and production readiness across platform and domain teams.

  • Lead high-impact platform initiatives from problem framing and architecture design through implementation, rollout, and operational handoff.

  • Develop reusable patterns and reference architectures for streaming ingestion, compaction, retention, schema governance, observability, and other recurring data engineering challenges.

  • Establish reliable observability across the platform, including pipeline monitoring, consumer lag tracking, data quality checks, and alerting.

  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Security, Engineering, Data Engineering, and Data Science, and Analytics to evolve the platform, build cross-functional support, and ensure the platform meets the needs of its users.

  • Drive the semantic layer and metadata strategy that supports consistent and trusted self-service analytics and AI-driven data access.

  • Evaluate technologies and approaches across streaming, storage, query, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure, balancing scalability, operational complexity, cost, and maintainability.

  • Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and reusable technical guidance.

  • Own the most complex architectural and operational challenges on the data platform, including failure recovery, schema drift, partition management, and performance degradation.

 

Please apply if you have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with meaningful time spent at a senior or staff level with domain-wide technical scope.

  • Experience designing and operating lakehouse architectures at scale — including open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg), columnar storage (Parquet) and cloud object storage (e.g. S3)

  • Experience building and operating streaming data pipelines — including event-driven ingestion, exactly-once delivery semantics, consumer lag management, checkpoint and recovery strategies, and failure handling in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with data contracts, data governance, metadata, or semantic-layer systems.

  • Strong Python skills and a track record of writing maintainable, testable production code.

  • Experience deploying and operating data workloads on Kubernetes — including managing containerized infrastructure, resource tuning and health checks.

  • Proven ability to influence multiple teams, communicate architectural trade-offs, and drive adoption.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards through code reviews, documentation, and reusable patterns.

  • Comfort taking ownership of broad, ambiguous problem spaces.

To stand out:

  • Distributed query engines such as Trino.

  • Experience with Kafka, Flink, or comparable streaming technologies.

  • Workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.

  • Experience with AWS or an equivalent public cloud provider.

  • CI/CD and deployment automation (e.g., GitHub Actions).

  • Working knowledge of Java or another JVM-based language, given the JVM-based nature of several frameworks in this domain.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

    • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem – just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

title: Staff Engineer / Paris (W/M/X)
descriptionHtml:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.
🎯 Level & Domain

Level:

Staff Engineer is IC4 on our engineering ladder:

  • Has worked as a Senior Developer in at least two product teams.

  • Turns the tribe’s hardest, ill-framed problems into shipped business value.

  • Lands in any product fast, de-risks the complex, and raises the bar across teams.

    • The Fastline:

    Each domain has its own Fastline: a small team of Staff Engineers working across all the products of the domain, in a highly agile, commando mode.

    The Fastline is transverse to the domain’s products: it is not attached to one product, but deployed wherever a domain needs senior engineering firepower the most.

    The Fastline takes on three kinds of work:

  • Complex features in existing products: deliver features too risky, cross-cutting or technically hard for a product team to absorb alongside its committed roadmap.

  • Legacy decommissioning: retire legacy systems safely, migrate their capabilities and data, and switch them off for good.

  • IS simplification: reduce the complexity of the tribe’s information system, remove duplication, and make the architecture easier to run and evolve.

    • Fastlines are attached to the Domain Lead, who sets their priorities based on business value, in coordination with the domains’ Lead ITs. Missions are short and outcome-driven: you join a topic, deliver, hand over to the owning product team, and move on to the next one.


    🎯 TASK

    Strategic & Hard Problems

  • Take on the domain’s most difficult and strategic topics: legacy decommissioning, IS simplification, complex features in existing products.

  • Contribute, with the Architects, to the decommissioning of legacy systems end to end: map dependencies and data flows, design the migration path, run it without business disruption, and switch the legacy off.

  • Drive the simplification of the tribe’s information system: identify redundant components, unnecessary coupling and dead code, and remove them.

  • Deliver complex, cross-cutting features inside existing products, working hand in hand with their product teams.

    • Fast Onboarding & Delivery

  • Land in any product or codebase of the domain and become productive in days, not months.

  • Quickly understand the business context, the architecture, the constraints and the people involved in a topic.

  • Deliver early and often: integrate end to end first, sequence work from most unknown to least worrisome, and show tangible progress quickly.

  • Hand over cleanly to the owning product team: documentation, tests, runbooks and knowledge transfer, so that the team can run what you built.

    • Problem Framing & Business Partnership

  • Take ill-defined, poorly framed problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.

  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Orin, or similar embedded-compute platforms.

title: Staff Robotics Engineer, AV Core
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Core Model Safety Team

The Core Model Safety team builds foundational capabilities for assisted and automated driving, including collision avoidance, model understanding, and robustness under failure. It's a small, high-impact team with strong ownership, access to large-scale training and fleet data, and close partners across research, simulation, evaluation, and applied engineering. The work here is central to making driverless autonomy possible: detecting and preventing collisions, developing emergency-driving behaviours from limited data, and making sure the vehicle responds safely when something goes wrong.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Set the technical strategy and roadmap for fault detection and fallback, including its behavioural scope, operating envelope, system interfaces, and measurable acceptance criteria

  • Design and train fault detection mechanisms using the methods best supported by evidence, to enable robust driverless operation

  • Collaborate across functions and expertise areas, including machine learning, inference optimisation, and software engineering

  • Lead integration into the shared driving stack, align technical decisions across teams, and raise the bar through architecture reviews, mentoring, and clear communication of risks, trade-offs, and evidence

  • Use your judgement and expertise to improve the overall robustness of the robot system, beyond just fault detection and fallback

🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • Fault detection and fallback systems that let the vehicle respond safely when something goes wrong, from strategy through to deployment on the car

  • Collision avoidance, model understanding, and robustness under failure: the foundational capabilities this team owns for assisted and automated driving

  • Fault detection methods chosen on the strength of evidence, built to hold up under real driverless operation

  • Integration into the shared driving stack, working closely with machine learning, inference optimisation, and software engineering partners

  • Large-scale training and fleet data, with close partners in research, simulation, evaluation, and applied engineering

👤 You should apply if:

  • Proficient in developing, implementing, and troubleshooting robotics solutions, backed by practical, real-world experience

  • A track record of staff-level technical leadership: setting direction for ambiguous programmes, aligning multiple teams, and carrying work from research through production deployment

  • Strong technical judgement and communication, able to make safety-relevant trade-offs explicit and lead without relying on formal authority

  • Comfortable working in Python and C++ for robotics

  • Experience deploying and maintaining fleets of robots or vehicles at scale under real-world conditions

  • Bonus if you've built tooling to triage and debug robotic systems, or set up cloud-based monitoring for large-scale fleets

  • Familiarity with embedded or real-time systems, or hands-on machine learning and inference optimisation experience, is a plus

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

📋 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Hiring manager interview (30 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews ( Tech Leadership, Domain, Programming; 3 hours)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

We'll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What's in it for you (Location dependent):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on:

  • Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

  • Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

  • Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

  • Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

  • Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

We primarily use Node.js with TypeScript, with Java and Kotlin as a nice to have. Above all, strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.

title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.

The role

As a Staff Software Engineer, you are the technical counterpart to our founders. You look beyond a single product area: you shape the architecture across the platform, make the decisions that are expensive to reverse, and make sure we scale from one country to many without rewriting the core.

You stay hands-on and write a lot of code – but your impact is measured by what the whole engineering team ships.

What you’ll own

  • Technical direction: Define architecture and tech strategy across the platform; write and drive RFCs for the decisions that matter.
  • Core systems: Own the foundations every product area builds on – the domain model for tax and accounting logic and the integration layer to third-party systems.

  • Partner to the founders: Translate business strategy into a technical roadmap and spot where technology creates leverage.

Our tech context (greenfield)

Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.

Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …

Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.

You will decide how this stack evolves as we scale.

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years building and operating production systems, including several years in a technical leadership role (Staff, Lead, Principal or equivalent)

What success looks like after 12 months

  • Our architecture is ready for the next country without a rewrite.

What you’ll get

descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a highly autonomous Staff Systems Administrator to serve as the accountable technical owner for enterprise IT infrastructure and end-user computing within a dedicated, security-sensitive entity environment. This senior individual contributor will design, implement, operate, secure, and continuously improve on-premises systems, cloud platforms, identity services, networks, and endpoints while preserving required legal, operational, information-security, and access boundaries.

The role combines deep infrastructure ownership with hands-on service delivery. The successful candidate will translate security and compliance requirements into durable technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, drive equipment and endpoint hardening, and deliver resilient support to engineering and business teams with minimal oversight.

What you'll do:

  • Infrastructure Ownership (On-Prem & Cloud)

    • Own and operate on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup platforms, identity services, core network services, and enterprise applications.

    • Administer Azure and/or AWS environments with responsibility for availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, secure configuration, backup, and disaster-recovery readiness.

    • Define technical roadmaps, identify operational risks, and independently drive modernization, standardization, scalability, and resilience improvements.

    • Maintain accurate architecture diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, recovery documentation, configuration records, and service ownership information.

    • Plan and execute infrastructure changes using disciplined change, testing, rollback, and post-implementation review practices.

    Firewalled Entity and Segmented-Environment Support

    • Operate technology services for a dedicated legal or operating entity with explicit separation of systems, identities, data, administration, suppliers, and access from other corporate environments where required.

    • Implement and maintain approved trust boundaries, network segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote access, administrative tiers, and controlled cross-entity connectivity.

    • Ensure data, devices, accounts, cloud resources, and third-party access remain within authorized entity, contractual, regulatory, and data-residency boundaries.

    • Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and corporate IT teams to translate entity-specific obligations into practical controls, operating procedures, and evidence.

    • Document and periodically validate boundary controls, data flows, privileged access paths, exceptions, and intercompany dependencies; escalate gaps and drive remediation to closure.

    • Support local business continuity and operational autonomy while aligning with approved global architecture, security standards, and governance.

    Security, Compliance, and Systems

    • Establish, implement, and maintain secure configuration baselines for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, network devices, cloud services, and endpoint-management platforms using recognized frameworks and vendor guidance.

    • Own patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows, including asset coverage, risk-based prioritization, remediation timelines, exception documentation, validation, and status reporting.

    • Administer and validate endpoint protections such as full-disk encryption, EDR/XDR, host firewall, secure boot, application controls, device compliance, removable-media controls, and least-privilege configurations.

    • Harden identity and administrative access through role-based access control, multifactor authentication, privileged-access separation, conditional access, service-account governance, and periodic access reviews.

    • Maintain logging, alerting, time synchronization, configuration monitoring, backup protection, and security telemetry needed for detection, investigation, and auditability.

    • Collect and maintain audit-ready evidence; support internal and external audits, control assessments, security reviews, customer requirements, and remediation plans.

    • Participate in incident response, containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for infrastructure and endpoint security events.

    • Manage technical risks and policy exceptions transparently, including compensating controls, accountable owners, expiration dates, and closure plans.

    Identity, Endpoint, and Service Delivery

    • Administer Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms, including user and group lifecycle, authentication, authorization, federation, and policy enforcement.

    • Manage Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints through Intune, Jamf, or equivalent tooling, ensuring secure provisioning, configuration compliance, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and timely retirement.

    • Lead onboarding and offboarding activities, including device provisioning, access configuration, license assignment, asset recovery, and compliance validation.

    • Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for employees, engineering systems, lab environments, collaboration services, and secure connectivity.

    • Own IT asset lifecycle, software licensing, vendor coordination, procurement support, warranty management, and secure equipment disposal.

    • Use scripting and automation to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and provide meaningful operational and compliance reporting.

    • Contribute reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, and documentation that can scale across comparable international entity environments.

Required qualifications:

  • 8 + years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, enterprise IT operations, or a closely related discipline.

  • Demonstrated success independently owning production IT infrastructure and end-user environments in a complex, regulated, segmented, or security-sensitive organization.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Windows, macOS, and Linux; server administration and virtualization; Azure and/or AWS; and Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Practical experience implementing system and endpoint hardening, configuration baselines, patch management, vulnerability remediation, encryption, endpoint detection and response, and least-privilege controls.

  • Experience supporting security or compliance programs and producing evidence for audits, assessments, or customer and regulatory requirements.

  • Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, network segmentation, firewall policy, and secure remote access.

  • Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or equivalent, including compliance policy and device lifecycle management.

  • Experience implementing and testing monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities.

  • Excellent documentation, prioritization, risk communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive outcomes under limited supervision.

  • Ability to support time-sensitive operational needs and participate in planned after-hours maintenance or incident response when required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting a firewalled, ring-fenced, subsidiary, joint-venture, sovereign, or otherwise separately governed entity environment.

  • Experience supporting engineering, R&D, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other mission-critical technical teams.

  • Working knowledge of recognized security and compliance frameworks such as CIS Controls and Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, or equivalent local and contractual standards.

  • Experience with security tooling such as SIEM, vulnerability-management platforms, privileged-access management, data-loss prevention, certificate management, or network-access control.

  • Experience supporting isolated, air-gapped, export-controlled, or data-residency-restricted systems.

  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, infrastructure as code, or configuration-management tooling.

  • Familiarity with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD environments, and secure engineering workflows.

  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, AWS, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, GIAC, ITIL, or equivalent.

descriptionHtml:

Tour-opérateur réceptif (DMC) indépendant, nous concevons et organisons des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités en famille, en liberté ou accompagnés.

Du Canal du Midi aux Pyrénées, en passant par les Cévennes, l'Aubrac et la Catalogne, nous invitons nos voyageurs à découvrir les territoires autrement, à leur rythme et au plus près de la nature.

Notre ambition ? Développer une autre façon de voyager, plus respectueuse de l'environnement et des territoires, en privilégiant les mobilités douces, les expériences authentiques et les rencontres locales.

Ton stage s'articulera autour de deux missions complémentaires : le marketing digital (80 %) et le conseil et la vente de voyages (20 %).

1. Marketing digital – 4 jours par semaine

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Computer Vision pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, l'analyse visuelle en magasin représente un levier majeur pour optimiser l'excellence opérationnelle et mieux comprendre l'expérience client.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de concevoir et prototyper des solutions innovantes basées sur la vision par ordinateur en exploitant différents flux visuels (images et vidéos), dans le strict respect des normes de confidentialité (RGPD).

L'enjeu : allier recherche algorithmique de pointe et impact concret sur le terrain, à travers des cas d'usage variés tels que l'analyse automatisée des rayons (détection de ruptures, conformité de mise en rayon) et la compréhension des parcours en magasin (estimation de pose, cartes de chaleur).

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la démonstration de valeur :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les dernières approches en Computer Vision (détection d'objets, segmentation, estimation de pose, modèles de fondation visuels).
  • Détection et analyse de rayons : Développer des algorithmes de détection d'objets, de segmentation et de classification pour analyser les photos de linéaires (identification d'articles, détection de ruptures visuelles, conformité de mise en rayon et supports de communication).
  • Analyse de flux et estimation de pose : Prototyper des modèles d'estimation de pose pour modéliser les dynamiques et parcours en magasin, tout en garantissant le strict respect du RGPD.
  • Exploration de données et entraînement : Préparer des jeux de données complexes (images et vidéos) et entraîner ou adapter des modèles de l'état de l'art (ex. YOLO, ViT, modèles de fondation, MediaPipe).
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes avancées et résultats à travers des visualisations et des démonstrations (PoC) auprès des équipes techniques et métiers.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, OpenCV, modèles & librairies de Computer Vision (ex. YOLO, ViT, Foundation Models, MediaPipe)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Computer Vision, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en Machine Learning, Deep Learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) et Computer Vision (ex. OpenCV, YOLO, ViT).
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes d'images/vidéos en environnement réel.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

descriptionHtml:

32-40 uur

Een stage bij BERG is allesbehalve saai! Je krijgt de kans om jezelf zowel creatief als professioneel te ontwikkelen, wordt onderdeel van een gezellig team en werkt aan projecten die je straks met trots aan je portfolio kunt toevoegen.

Du solltest bereits in einer Agentur oder selbständig einige Websites erstellen haben. Dein Auge für Design sollte ausgeprägt sein und idealerweise hast du ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Design oder Informatik abgeschlossen (oder dich gerade darin befinden).

title: Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) - London
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

 

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German ( desirable), depending on territory.

Location: London - Hybrid

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

title: Supply Chain Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


Supply Chain Programme Manager

🛠️ About our Supply Chain Team

The Supply Chain Programme Manager is a critical cross-functional role responsible for owning end-to-end supply chain execution across assigned programmes and product builds at Wayve. This includes prototype development, new product introduction (NPI) and supporting fleet launches.

You’ll serve as the primary Supply Chain lead for your programmes, ensuring programme deliverables, supplier compliance and seamless coordination across Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing and external partners. You’ll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Finance, Legal and Suppliers, while partnering closely with global upfitters and third-party integration partners across the US, UK and other regions to ensure vehicle and programme timelines are met.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll own end-to-end material readiness across assigned programmes, translating engineering requirements and demand into procurement plans and identifying supply risks early in the product lifecycle.

You’ll operate as the strategic liaison between hardware engineering and procurement, coordinating internal teams, suppliers, upfitters and integration partners to keep builds moving. This role combines strategic programme ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, hardware-driven environment.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Acting as the primary Supply Chain lead for assigned programmes and internal product builds, including prototypes, NPI and subassemblies.

  • Owning end-to-end material readiness to support programme milestones across R&D, Engineering, Operations and Manufacturing.

  • Collaborating with Engineering, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Finance and Suppliers to align supply chain activities with programme timelines.

  • Acting as the strategic liaison between hardware engineering and procurement teams, including managing demand aggregation.

  • Translating engineering BOMs and aggregated Technical Programme Manager demand into procurement plans.

  • Identifying long-lead items and critical-path components early in the product lifecycle.

  • Tracking material status throughout build phases and proactively escalating gaps and risks.

  • Serving as the primary programme manager for upfitter and partner relationships, ensuring alignment across stakeholders.

  • Driving upfitter and partner activities to ensure vehicles meet overall programme timelines and quality standards.

  • Proactively identifying and resolving issues affecting vehicle build readiness, coordinating between internal teams and external partners.

  • Maintaining clear communication cadences with upfitters and stakeholders, tracking milestones and escalating risks as needed.

  • Defining, tracking and reporting key supply chain performance metrics, including material availability, total cost savings and inventory cycle count accuracy.

  • Establishing programme-level supply chain dashboards and reporting cadences to provide leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with visibility.

  • Analysing KPI trends to identify root causes of supply chain underperformance and driving corrective actions with suppliers and internal teams.

  • Using KPI insights to continuously improve supply chain processes, reduce waste and increase overall programme efficiency.

  • Collaborating with Supply Chain Team Leads to ensure direct purchasing, indirect purchasing and logistics suppliers meet compliance requirements, including legal, environmental, regulatory requirements such as TISAX and ISO, and ethical sourcing standards.

  • Partnering with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate supplier agreements, NDAs and risk controls are in place.

  • Developing contingency plans for supply disruptions and actively managing supply chain risks.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain programme management, NPI and hardware operations.

  • You have a strong understanding of BOM management, material planning and procurement processes.

  • You have demonstrated experience managing cross-functional programmes across Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain.

  • You bring strong analytical, problem-solving and risk-management skills.

  • You have excellent communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.

  • You are able to travel internally as needed.

  • Experience in the automotive, consumer, hardware or robotics industries is preferred.

  • Familiarity with supplier compliance frameworks, including TISAX, ISO standards and ethical sourcing requirements, is preferred.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 – Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time, office-based role located in London, depending on the candidate’s place of residence.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our offices and workshops with focused time working remotely. We also operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  1. Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  2. Competency interviews (Hiring Manager Interview) (45 mins)

  3. Deep-dive interviews (Team and Cross-functional Interviews) (3 hrs)

  4. Final interview (30 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.


What’s in it for you:

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Systemanalyst:in/Entwickler:in mit dem Schwerpunkt Kernsysteme im Bereich IT
descriptionHtml:
Über die Stelle:

Du möchtest in einer innovativen Genossenschaft die nachhaltige Energieversorgung der Zukunft vorantreiben? Du suchst nach Aufgaben, die dich erfüllen und die einen echten Beitrag zum Klimaschutz leisten? Green Planet Energy versteht sich als Lotse der Energiewende. Entstanden aus einer Kampagne der Umweltschutzorganisation Greenpeace e.V., engagieren wir uns aus tiefster Überzeugung für eine Energieversorgung aus umweltfreundlichen Quellen – ohne Kohle und Atom. 

Authentisch, politisch engagiert und gemeinschaftlich. Werde auch du jetzt Teil unseres Teams.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir in Voll- oder Teilzeit (mind. 32 Wochenstunden) eine:n Systemanalyst:in/Entwickler:in mit dem Schwerpunkt Kernsysteme im Bereich IT. 


Deine Aufgaben:
  • Du entwickelst unsere Backend-Systeme weiter, auch mit Hilfe von KI-Werkzeugen
  • Du gestaltest Geschäftsprozesse gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen und analysierst Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zuverlässig zwischen Systemen ausgetauscht werden
  • Du automatisierst Abläufe und reduzierst manuelle Arbeitsschritte
  • Du verantwortest deine Anwendungen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus und bringst neue Funktionen sicher in den Betrieb
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den internen Fachbereichen Kunden- und Mitgliederservice sowie Marktkommunikation & Abrechnung zusammen
  • Du bist im engen fachlichen Austausch mit anderen Software-Teams und unserem Team für Prozessmanagement

Dein Profil:
  • Du hast Freude an Teamarbeit – inklusive üblicher Methoden wie Collective Code Ownership, Pair Programming, Peer Reviews und Tech Talks
  • Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit fundierter Praxiserfahrung: Wichtig ist, dass du solide Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringst und komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen kannst.
  • Du besitzt Kenntnisse in objektorientiertem Software-Engineering (idealerweise in PHP (Laravel-Framework), Groovy, Python und SQL); Kenntnisse in Low-Code-Entwicklung mit BPM sind von Vorteil
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Continuous Deployment und automatisierten Entwicklungsprozessen mit
  • Idealerweise kennst du auch bereits die Energiebranche oder besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Interesse daran, technische und fachliche Themen zusammen-zubringen
  • Du begeisterst dich für sauberen Code und nachhaltige Lösungen – und gleichzeitig dafür deinen Code möglichst schnell in Produktion sehen zu wollen 
  • Du möchtest Verantwortung für Systeme und Prozesse übernehmen

Was wir bieten:
  • Wir leben eine hybride Arbeitskultur - Du kannst einen Großteil deiner Arbeitszeit von zu Hause erbringen. Dazu erhältst du von uns die technische Ausstattung sowie einmalig eine monetäre Bezuschussung für deinen heimischen Arbeitsplatz.
  • Gleitzeit
  • Die Bezuschussung des Deutschland- bzw. Klimatickets  oder eines geleasten Fahrrads mit 50 EUR mlt.
  • Bezuschussung zur VWL und BAV
  • Bezuschussung einer Wellpass-Firmenfitnessmitgliedschaft mit einem Eigenanteil i.H.v. 25 EUR mtl.
  • Bei uns sind der 24. und 31. Dezember arbeitsfrei, ganz ohne Urlaubstag
  • Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen bei unseren Kooperationspartnern
  • Teamevents und gemeinsame Aktionen mit den Kolleg:innen

Dir liegt die Energiewende genauso am Herzen wie uns? Du willst dabei sein, wenn wir mit frischem Wind unseren Marktanteil unter den ökologischen Energieanbietern ausbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und Verfügbarkeit. Die Bewerbung von Schwerbehinderten Menschen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht. 

Bei Fragen steht dir gern Kristina Rübsam zur Verfügung.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d) – Germany 🇩🇪
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du den Arbeitsalltag von Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Frankreich und Europa aktiv mitgestalten?

Fühlst du dich in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld wohl?

Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein, und du könntest perfekt zu dieser Rolle passen 🙂

Unsere Vision

Wir möchten das beliebteste Financial Operating System für europäische KMU werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmer:innen, den zeitaufwendigen Aufwand rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu reduzieren. Gleichzeitig erhalten sie Zugang zu wichtigen Informationen, die sie dabei unterstützen, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Auch Steuerkanzleien profitieren davon. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit in die Beratung und Begleitung ihrer Mandant:innen investieren.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen in Frankreich, und wir beschleunigen derzeit unser Wachstum in Deutschland 🇩🇪

Seit unserer Gründung vor sechs Jahren ist es uns gelungen:

💻 Uns als wegweisende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien zu etablieren

💰 Insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro aufzunehmen, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Von sieben Gründer:innen auf mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeitende zu wachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und bieten zudem zahlreiche Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6/5.

🌍 Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und einer stark remote-freundlichen Kultur aufzubauen. Bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten von verschiedenen Orten in Europa aus.

🤝 Das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien zu gewinnen und hervorragende Bewertungen zu erhalten

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien in Frankreich dabei zu unterstützen, Pennylane zu nutzen

Über die Rolle

Du möchtest mehr tun, als nur offene Stellen zu besetzen? Du möchtest dabei helfen, ein Team aufzubauen und das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland mitzugestalten?

Deutschland ist unser Startup im Startup: Wir sind seit rund einem Jahr auf dem Markt, haben etwa 40 Mitarbeitende und ambitionierte Pläne für 2027. Dafür suchen wir dich, eine erfahrene Person im Business Recruiting mit Drive, klarer Haltung und Lust, etwas von Grund auf aufzubauen.

Du wirst Teil unseres deutschen Recruiting-Teams, das derzeit aus einer Teamleiterin und zwei Freelance-Recruiter:innen besteht. In dieser Festanstellung als Individual Contributor übernimmst du deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und gestaltest mit, wie wir in Deutschland Talente gewinnen und einstellen.

Dein Beitrag

  • Verantworte deinen eigenen Bereich: Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess, vom Briefing und proaktiven Sourcing bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Sales, Customer Success, Partner Success, Onboarding und Deployment. Je nach Business-Bedarf unterstützt du auch die Bereiche Marketing, People und weitere Support-Funktionen.

  • Sei Sparringspartner:in: Du verstehst die Ziele deiner Hiring Manager:innen, bringst wertvolle Marktkenntnisse ein und hinterfragst Erwartungen konstruktiv. Gemeinsam trefft ihr fundiertere Einstellungsentscheidungen.

  • Aufbauen, testen und verbessern: Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse und Interviewstrukturen weiter, probierst neue Ansätze aus und machst aus guten Ideen funktionierende Lösungen.

  • Verbinde Geschwindigkeit mit Qualität: Du priorisierst deine Recruiting-Aktivitäten auf Grundlage der Business-Anforderungen und Pipeline-Daten. Gleichzeitig stellst du sicher, dass sich Kandidat:innen während des gesamten Prozesses gut informiert und wertgeschätzt fühlen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Idealerweise mehr als fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Full-Cycle-Recruiting, mit einer klaren Spezialisierung auf Business- und Go-to-Market-Rollen sowie Erfahrung in der Besetzung von Sales- und/oder Success-Positionen.

  • Du weißt, wie du Talente proaktiv gewinnst, Recruiting-Prozesse eigenständig steuerst und Hiring Manager:innen berätst, auch dann, wenn ihr nicht sofort einer Meinung seid.

  • Du hast Lust, etwas aufzubauen, statt ein fertiges Playbook abzuarbeiten: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt Ideen in die Tat um und bleibst handlungsfähig, wenn sich Prioritäten ändern. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up ist ein Plus.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nutzt Daten und Recruiting-Tools sinnvoll und teilst dein Wissen sowie deine Learnings mit dem Team.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Du führst Interviews sicher in beiden Sprachen und arbeitest souverän mit Stakeholdern auf Deutsch und Englisch zusammen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Weil du hier nicht einfach einen bestehenden Prozess übernimmst. Du hilfst dabei, unser deutsches Team weiter auszubauen, mit einem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, engem Austausch mit dem Business und Raum für Projekte, die langfristig Wirkung zeigen.

Du hast Lust, anzupacken, Dinge besser zu machen und gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen? Dann lass uns sprechen.

Was wir tun, um deinen Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern

🏢 Diese Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt und beinhaltet die Präsenz vor Ort an einigen Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43–45.

💻 Die neueste Apple-Ausstattung

🤝 Unser Bewerbungsprozess

  • Intro-Call: Erstes Gespräch mit Thomas, Recruiter, 30-minütiger Video-Call

  • Manager-Interview: Gespräch mit Leona, Business Lead Financial Services & International Hires, 45 bis 60 Minuten per Video-Call

  • Case Study: Praktische Übung mit zwei Mitgliedern des Talent-Acquisition-Teams, 60-minütiger Video-Call

  • Abschlussgespräch: Gespräch mit Ursula Piscitelli, Head of Talent Acquisition, und Marine Bustarret, VP People, 45 bis 60 Minuten per Video-Call

Wir arbeiten schnell und effizient. Insgesamt dauert unser Bewerbungsprozess in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen.

Wir haben dir möglichst viele Informationen über den Zweck, die Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position gegeben. Jetzt bist du gefragt: Zeige uns, ob du dich in dieser Position sowohl wohlfühlen als auch einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen leisten kannst.

Vielfalt macht uns zu einem besseren und spannenderen Ort zum Arbeiten.

Als konkretes Beispiel für unser Engagement haben wir vor Kurzem den Pacte Parité der French Tech unterzeichnet. Damit setzen wir uns konkrete Ziele für einen noch besseren und inklusiveren Arbeitsplatz in den kommenden Jahren.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive, both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our talent acquisition partner, you will help build Ben as it scales, hiring bar-raising talent across the business. You'll partner with hiring managers, getting under the skin of what each team needs to grow, and you will equally contribute towards building a best-in-class hiring process.

We're heavily invested in agentic tooling and already run agents and workflows built with Claude, Ashby and other platforms. You'll work with our Strategic Talent Business Partner to keep building and iterating on them, and we want you to think boldly about what an agentic talent function can do.

This is a great role for someone early in their recruitment career who wants to learn fast and grow in a scaling ai-native business.

Things you will be working on…

  • Hire bar-raising talent across the business: you’ll hire for a range of IC roles, from implementation, support and technical account management to commercial and engineering, bringing in the people who’ll take Ben forward as we scale.

  • Be a true partner to hiring managers: work with hiring managers to agree what we need, when we need it and why, using data to guide those decisions.

  • Bring our employer brand to life: help elevate how Ben shows up, from events to the careers page, so candidates get a real sense of what it’s like to work here.

  • Build AI into how we hire: trial and build agents and workflows that give hiring teams better tools and free up time for the work that matters.

  • Make our hiring process best in class: gather quantitative and qualitative feedback from candidates and hiring managers, spot what’s slowing us down, test changes and keep what works.

You will love this role if you have…

  • A hunger to grow: you’re early in your recruitment career, with agency experience or a year or two in-house, ideally hiring for customer, product, sales or engineering roles. You’ve owned roles from intake to offer, and you’re ready for a bigger remit.

  • A sourcing track record: you love sourcing and thinking creatively about hiring. You enjoy engaging passive candidates, and you can walk us through a search you're proud of.

  • Stakeholder backbone: you've managed demanding hiring managers, prioritised competing requests and pushed back when a brief or a process wasn't working. You can point to a time you changed a hiring plan because of what the business needed, and you keep several roles moving at once.

  • A real excitement about AI: You’ve got strong opinions on where it’s taking talent, you’re already trying the tools, and you want to help build a talent team where agents run the repetitive work and people spend their time on candidates and collaborating with hiring managers.

Why join us?

Ben already helps hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries get benefits that actually work for them (pensions, insurance, allowances, payroll), at companies like Mondelez, Zalando, Octopus Energy, BA and more. We're now scaling further into the large enterprise space, and this next stage is the most exciting one yet.

You’d be the second person in the talent team, working on finding the bar-raising talent who will take us to the next level, with real influence over how Ben hires as we scale, and the room to grow your role and remit as we do.

We’re all in on building a truly AI native talent function, so you’ll be given the time to learn, experiment and help build the agents and tooling that change how we find and hire great people. If you want to help shape that, we’d love to hear from you.
